tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /chos mngon pa mdzod kyi bshad thabs kyi man ngag ngo mtshar gsum ldan zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /chos mngon pa mdzod kyi bshad thabs kyi man ngag ngo mtshar gas
༄༅/ /chos mngon pa mdzod kyi bshad thabs kyi man ngag ngo mtshar gsum ldan zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /chos mngon pa mdzod kyi bshad thabs kyi man ngag ngo mtshar gas

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /chos mngon pa mdzod kyi bshad thabs kyi man ngag ngo mtshar gsum ldan zhes bya ba bzhugs so// chos mngon pa mdzod kyi bshad thabs kyi man ngag ngo mtshar gsum ldan zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha mchog mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag mtshal lo/ /'jig rten mes po gdong bzhi ldan pa dang / /skabs gsum dbang po mig stong ldan pa sogs/ /srid na dregs pa'i nga ro cher sgrogs shing / /thor tshugs cod paṇa mtho bar rloms rnams kyis/ /gang gi zhabs pad mdzes pa'i stegs byas pa/ /'jig rten rnam 'dren go'u tam lha yi lha/ /mi mjed zhing gi ston pa shākya'i gtso/ /sras dang slob mar bcas la gus phyag mtshal/ /snying gi dkyil 'khor dbus su rnam bsam nas/ /rgyun du gsol ba 'debs pa'i yi dam lha/ /'jam dpal 'jam dbyangs 'jam pa'i rdo rje yis/ /lhan skyes yid kyi mun pa sel bar mdzod/ /blo gros rab tu gsal ba'i khang bzang dbus/ /gzhung lugs 'bum sde dgu bcu go dgu yi/ /nor gyis gtams pa'i mdzod la dbang 'byor pa/ /kun mkhyen gnyis pa de la phyag 'tshal nas/ /grub mtha' dang po'i ri mo rnam bkra zhing / /ma lus gzhung la khyab pa'i 'gros bzhi ldan/ /brgal dka' gnad kyi ri las brgal ba yi/ /legs bshad ngo mtshar sum ldan brtsam par bya// //'di la don gsum ste/ bshad pa sngon 'gro rgya stag khra bo'i ri mo/ dkyus kyis bcad pa rus sbal rgya bo'i bzhi 'gros/ dka' ba'i gnas la dpyad pa gangs seng dkar mo'i mchong stangs so/ /dang po la lnga ste/ rtsom pa po slob dpon gyi che ba/ des bstan bcos ji ltar brtsams pa'i tshul/ brtsams pa'i bstan bcos kyi mtshan don/ mtshan ldan gzhung gi dgos 'brel/ dgos ldan bstan bcos spyi'i rnam gzhag go /dang po ni/ bstan bcos 'di'i mdzad pa po ni kun mkhyen gnyis pa dbyig gnyen yin la/ 'di'i che ba'i yon tan la/ rigs su 'khrungs pa'i yon tan/

skyes thob dang sbyangs pa'i yon tan/ lung bstan brnyes pa'i yon tan dang gsum/ dang po ni/ ston pa mya ngan las 'das nas bka'i bsdu ba rim pa gsum byung ba'i rjes su theg pa chen po'i bstan pa dar bar gnas pa na chos mngon pa la dgra lan gsum dar nas theg pa chen po'i mngon pa cung zad nub pa'i tshe/ bram ze mo gsal ba'i tshul khrims kyis chos mngon pa dar bar bzhed nas/ rgyal rigs gcig dang lhan cig 'dus pa las 'phags pa thogs med dang / bram ze'i rigs gcig dang lhan cig 'dus pa las slob dpon dbyig gnyen sku 'khrungs te/ chung ngu'i dus nas lce la gi wang gi dhīḥyig bri ba la sogs pa blo rno ba'i thabs mang du byas so/ /gnyis pa ni/ skye ba lnga brgyar bar ma chad du paṇ+ḍi tar sku 'khrungs pas skyes thob kyi blo gros mtshungs pa med pa dang ldan cing / rigs pa'i gnas lnga'i pha rol tu son pas gzhung lugs 'bum sde dgu bcu go dgu thugs su chud de/ brgyad stong pa la rgyun du zhal 'don byed pa zhig go /gsum pa ni/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ de 'og rnam par grags pa ni/ /lho yi phyogs su bram ze ni/ /yi ge dang po ba bstan pa/ /ston pa'i bstan la de gtso byed/ /mchod rten kun dga' rwa bar gnas/ /ston pa'i gzugs brnyan yid 'ong gis/ /sa ni rgya mtsho gnyis mthar thug /thams cad kyi ni rgyan du byas/ /zhes gsungs pas bstan to/ /gnyis pa ni/ bye brag tu smra ba rnams na re/ chos kyi phung po shā ri'i bus/ /gdags pa'i bstan bcos mau 'gal bus/ /khams kyi tshogs ni gang pos bsdus/ /rnam shes tshogs ni lha skyid kyis/ /ye shes la 'jug ka t+ya'i bus/ /rab tu byed pa dbyig bshes kyi/ /'gro ba'i rnam grangs gsus po ches/ /zhes pa ltar chos mngon pa sde bdun po 'di ston pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gnas tha dad du gang zag so so la thor bu thor bur gsungs pa de nyid dgra bcom pa bdun gyis bsdus pas bka' yin te/

gzhan du na mdo las dge slong sde snod gsum pa can zhes gsungs pa'i sde snod gsum ma tshang bar 'gyur ro zhes zer ro/ /mdo sde pa na re/ mngon pa sde bdun sangs rgyas kyi bka' ma yin te/ de las 'dus ma byas rdzas su grub pa la sogs pa rigs pa dang 'gal ba du ma snang la/ sangs rgyas ni chos rnams kyi rang spyi'i mtshan nyid phyin ci ma log par thugs su chud pas rigs pa dang 'gal ba gsungs mi srid pa'i phyir/ des na dgra bcom pa bdun gyis rang dgar brtsams pa yin zhing / bka' la sde snod gsum ma tshang ba'i skyon yang med de/ 'dul ba dang mdo sde'i nang du chos rnams kyi rang spyi'i mtshan nyid ston pa'i cha rnams mngon pa'i sde snod yin pa'i phyir zhe'o/ /snga rabs pa kha cig mdo sde pa ltar na/ de bka' min yang tshad mar khas blangs dgos te/ dgra bcom pa de dag la zag med kyi shes rab mnga' bas 'khrul ba med pa'i phyir/ zhes zer ba ni ma nges ste/ zag med kyi shes rab mnga' yang nyon mongs pa can ma yin pa'i mun pa ma spangs pas shin tu lkog gyur la 'khrul pa srid pa'i phyir ro/ /de lta bu'i mngon pa sde bdun gyi dgongs pa 'grel ba la paṇ+ḍi ta lnga brgya 'dus nas bye brag bshad mtsho chen mo zhes bya ba sh+lau ka 'bum yod pa zhig brtsams/ de'i tshig don rgya che bas dbang po rtul po rnams kyis bde blag tu rtog par ma nus nas kha che 'dus bzang gi dus su slob dpon dbyig gnyen tshig don la mkhas par grags pas de'i tshig don bsdus pa'i bstan bcos brtsam par gsol ba gdab pas chos mngon pa mdzod kyi tshig le'ur byas pa 'di brtsams so/ /'di'i nang du lo grags zer gsum gyi tshig byung ba la/ 'ga' zhig slob dpon rtsom pa la mkhas pas tshig rgyan yin zer/ la la zur za yin zer te yid ma ches te/ slar yang 'grel pa brtsam par gsol bas lo grags zer gsum gyi thad du bye brag smra ba'i 'dod pa bkag nas rang nyid mdo sde pa'i grub mtha' ltar mdzad pa'i rang 'grel brtsams so/

/gsum pa ni/ chos mngon mdzod kyi bstan bcos rab bshad bya/ /zhes gsungs na ci'i phyir/ chos dang / mngon pa dang / mdzod dang / bstan bcos zhes bya zhe na/ chos ni rnam bshad rig par/ chos ni shes bya lam dang ni/ /mya ngan 'das dang yid kyi yul/ /gsung rab tshe dang bsod nams dang / /'byung 'gyur nges dang chos lugs la'o/ /zhes don bcu la 'jug par gsungs pa las/ 'dir ni mngon pa'i yul la 'jug na/ shes bya tsam la chos zhes bya/ chos dang mngon pa'i gzhi mthun la 'jug na/ lam dang gsung rab la chos zhes bya ste/ don dam pa'i mngon pa ni lam yin zhing / brdar btags pa'i mngon pa la lam dang gsung rab gnyis ka yod pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa mngon pa la/ dbye ba/ grangs nges/ so so'i ngo bo/ nges tshig dang bzhi las/ dang po la kha cig mngon pa la lam gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i shes rab dang gsung rab gnyis su grangs nges par 'dod pa ni mi 'thad de/ zag med kyi shes rab don dam pa'i chos mngon par 'jog pa'i tshe/ rjes 'brang dang bcas na phung po lnga char yang chos mngon par 'jog dgos pa'i phyir te/ chos mngon shes rab dri med rjes 'brang bcas/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ mchims kyis brgyad stong don bsdur/ shes rab pha rol phyin gnyis med/ /ye shes de ni de bzhin gshegs/ /bsgrub bya de don sbyor ba yi/ /gzhung dang lam la de sgra yin/ /zhes pa ltar/ mngon pa la gzhung lam 'bras bu'i mngon pa gsum du dbye zhes gsung yang lung de dang mi mthun te/ lung des ni sher phyin mtshan nyid pa sangs rgyas kyi sa kho nar bzhag nas gzhung lam gnyis sher phyin btags pa bar bstan la/ 'dir ni mngon pa la gsum du phye ba'i tshe/ lam dang mngon pa mtshan nyid pa'i gzhi mthun yod pa'i phyir te/ mthong sgom gyi lam bzhin no/ /gal te 'bras bu mngon pa ni zag med kyi shes rab dang / lam mngon pa ni zag bcas kyi shes rab la 'jog pas skyon med do snyam na/

de ltar na 'bras bu mngon pa mtshan nyid pa dang / gzhan gnyis btags pa bar grub mod/ sher phyin la gsum du dbye ba dang dpe don mi 'grig ste/ de'i tshe 'bras bu sher phyin sangs rgyas kyi sa kho nar bzhag la/ 'dir ni 'bras bu mngon pa slob pa'i rgyud la yang yod par 'dod dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /'thad pa'i phyogs ni 'di yin te/ spyir chos mngon pa zhes bya ba'i sgra 'jug pa tsam la dbye na don dam pa'i chos mngon pa dang / brdar btags pa'i chos mngon pa gnyis/ dang po la/ sa mtshams kyi sgo nas mthong sgom mi slob pa'i lam gsum/ de re re la yang gtso 'khor gyi sgo nas phung po lnga lnga'o/ /gnyis pa la brjod bya rjod byed gnyis/ dang po la/ skyes thob/ thos byung / bsam byung / sgom byung gi shes rab 'khor dang bcas pa ste bzhi/ gnyis pa la bka' dang bstan bcos gnyis so/ /gnyis pa grangs nges ni/ mngon pa la don dam pa'i chos mngon pa dang / brdar btags pa'i chos mngon pa gnyis su nges te/ thob bya mngon pa mtshan nyid pa dang / thob byed mngon pa btags pa ba gnyis su nges pa'i phyir/ dang po la mthong sgom mi slob pa'i lam gsum du nges te/ chos mngon pa'i gtso bo ni zag med kyi shes rab yin la/ de ni lam de gsum du nges pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa la brjod bya rjod byed gnyis su nges te/ don dam pa'i chos mngon pa de thob par byed pa'i lam dang / de gnyis brjod byar ston pa'i gsung rab gnyis su nges pa'i phyir ro/ /dang po la'ang bzhir nges te/ skyes thob dang / sbyor byung gnyis su nges shing / phyi ma la thos byung / bsam byung / sgom byung gsum du nges pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa dbye ba so so'i ngo bo la gnyis las/ dang po don dam pa'i chos mngon pa ni/ zag med kyi shes rab rjes 'brang dang bcas pa ste/ 'di la lam gang gis bsdus pa/ sa gang la brten pa/ rten dang brten pa'i don/ 'khor dang bcas na phung po du yin pa/

gtso 'khor go log pa'i rtsod pa spong ba/ mngon pa mtshan nyid par 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan dang drug las/ dang po ni/ mthong sgom mi slob pa'i lam gsum gyis bsdus te/ 'di'i gtso bo ni zag pa med pa'i shes rab yin la/ de ni lam de gsum gyis bsdus pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ mthong lam gyi ngo bor gyur pa ni bsam gtan sa drug dang / sgom lam dang mi slob lam gyi ngo bor gyur pa rnams ni de'i steng du gzugs med dang po gsum ste zag med sa dgu la brten pa yin te/ 'dod pa ni ma zhi ba dang / srid rtse ni sems kyi rgyu ba mi gsal bas zag med kyi shes rab kyi rten du mi rung ba'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa ni/ skad cig snga phyi la rten dang brten par bzhag pa/ dus mnyam ngo bo gcig pa la rten dang brten par bzhag pa/ dus mnyam rdzas tha dad la rten dang brten par bzhag pa gsum las dang po ni/ sbyor lam gyi sems rten sa drug la brten nas mthong lam skyes pa'i tshe mthong lam de sbyor lam gyi sems rten la brten zhes pa lta bu ste/ de gnyis sems rten ris mthun gcig la brten pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ mthong lam de bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi la brten pa'i tshe mthong lam gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i ting nge 'dzin de bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhir song stobs kyis de dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems sems byung thams cad bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhir song la/ mthong lam gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i shes rab de don dam pa'i chos mngon par song stobs kyis de dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems sems byung thams cad don dam pa'i chos mngon par song bas na de lta bu'i sems sems byung thams cad bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi dang / don dam pa'i chos mngon pa'i gzhi mthun yin pa lta bu'o/ /gsum pa ni/ mthong lam de bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi la brten pa'i tshe/ des bsdus pa'i zag med kyi sdom pa gzugs can dang /

de'i thob pa dang / mtshan nyid skye sogs zag med rnams bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi de dang dus mnyam rdzas tha dad yin pa lta bu'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ chos mngon pa de bsam gtan sa drug la brten pa'i tshe phung po lnga pa yin te/ gzugs phung ni zag med kyi sdom pa gzugs can/ tshor ba ni bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi tsam po dang gnyis pa la brten pa'i tshe yid bde/ gsum pa la brten pa'i tshe bde ba dang po'i nyer bsdogs dang / dngos gzhi khyad par can dang / bzhi pa la brten pa'i tshe gtang snyoms yin la/ 'du shes ni zag med kyi yid kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i 'du shes dang / 'du byed la mtshungs ldan 'du byed dang / ldan min 'du byed gnyis las/ dang po ni/ tshor 'du gnyis ma gtogs sems kyi sa mang brgyad/ dge ba'i sa mang bcu/ bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi tsam po man rtog dpyod gnyis dang nyi shu/ ldan min 'du byed ni de dag gi thob pa dang mtshan nyid skye sogs rnams so/ /rnam par shes pa de dag dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i gtso sems so/ /gzugs med dang po gsum la brten pa'i tshe gzugs phung med pas phung po bzhi'o/ /der zag med kyi sdom pa'i thob pa yod pas mi 'thad do snyam na/ zag med kyi sdom pa'i thob pa yod pa ni 'du byed kyis phung po yin la sdom pa gzugs can mngon gyur pa med pas skyon med do/ /lnga pa ni/ zag med kyi shes rab gtso bor byas nas 'khor dang bcas na phung po lngar bzhag pa ni gtso 'khor go log pa'i skyon yod de/ sems byung la gtso bo dang gtso sems la 'khor du bzhag 'dug pa'i phyir zhe na skyon med de/ sems sems byung gi gtso 'khor 'jog pa'i tshe sems la gtso bo dang sems byung la 'khor du 'jog la/ 'dir mngon pa'i gtso 'khor 'jog pa'i skabs yin pas/ zag med kyi shes rab la gtso bo dang / de dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems sems byung thams cad 'khor du bzhag pa'i phyir/

dper na yul gyi mi'i gtso 'khor 'jog pa'i tshe rgyal po gtso bo yin yang yig mkhan gyi gtso 'khor 'jog pa'i tshe yig dpon gtso bo yin pa bzhin no/ /de bzhin du dran pa nyer gzhag 'jog pa'i tshe dran pa shes rab gnyis la gtso bor byas nas de dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems sems byung thams cad la 'khor du 'jog pa sogs dang / sems bskyed la 'dun pa dang sems pa gtso bo dang gzhan rnams 'khor du gzhag pa'ang shes par bya'o/ /drug pa ni zag med kyi shes rab rjes 'brang dang bcas pa chos can/ chos mngon pa mtshan nyid pa yin te/ chos rnams rang dang spyi'i mtshan nyid mngon du gyur pa'i blo yin pa'i phyir/ de dag gi thob pa dang mtshan nyid skye sogs dang / zag med kyi sdom pa gzugs can rnams chos can/ de yin te/ zag med kyi shes rab de'i stobs kyis chos mngon par song ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa brdar btags pa'i chos mngon pa la mngon pa thob pa'i phyir du zhugs pa dang / de 'thob par byed pa'i thabs brjod byar ston pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ don dam pa'i chos mngon pa thob pa'i phyir zhugs pa'i zag pa dang bcas pa'i shes rab rjes 'brang dang bcas pa ste/ 'di la lam gang gis bsdus pa/ khams gang na yod cing sa gang la brten pa/ 'khor dang bcas na phung po du yin pa/ mngon par btags pa bar 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan dang bzhi'o/ /dang po ni/ skyes thob/ thos byung / bsam byung gsum ni lam ma zhugs nas sbyor lam chos mchog man chad na yod cing / sgom byung ni tshogs sbyor kho nas bsdus so/ /gnyis pa ni/ skyes thob ni khams gsum char na yod cing / sems rten sa dgu ka la brten te/ 'dod sems kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i skyes thob yod pa nas/ srid rtse'i ngo bor gyur pa'i skyes thob kyi shes rab kyi bar rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ thos byung ni 'dod gzugs gnyis na yod kyi gzugs med na med de/ sgra nyan pa med pa'i phyir dang /

gang zag phan tshun yul du mi 'gyur ba'i phyir/ sems rten ni 'dod pa dang bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs la brten no/ /bsam byung ni 'dod pa kho nar yod de/ khams gong na sems long med par ting nge 'dzin du 'gyur ba'i phyir/ sems rten ni khams gsum sa dgu la brten no/ /sgom byung ni khams gsum char na yod cing / sems rten ni bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs nas srid rtse'i bar brgyad la brten no/ /gsum pa ni/ dang po gsum ni phung po bzhi pa can yin la/ sgom byung ni phung po lnga pa can yin te/ bsam gtan gyi sdom pa gzugs can yod pa'i phyir/ 'o na dang po gsum yang phung po lnga pa can du 'gyur te/ so thar gyi sdom pa gzugs can yod pa'i phyir zhe na/ mi mtshungs te/ so thar ni skyes thob sogs gsum gyis thob pa ma yin par cho gas thob pa yin la/ bsam gtan gyi sdom pa ni sgom pa'i stobs kyis thob pa yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ de rnams chos can/ chos mngon pa zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ mngon pa mtshan nyid pa de'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir/ btags pa la dgos pa yod de/ mngon pa mtshan nyid pa de thob par 'dod pas khyod la 'jug dgos so zhes shes pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa de brjod byar ston pa la bka' dang bstan bcos gnyis/ 'di la kha cig mdo sde pa ltar na/ sgra dang mtshan pa dang / de dag gi mtshan nyid skye sogs rnams ldan min 'du byed yin pas/ gzhung mngon pa ni phung po gnyis par 'dod/ bye brag smra bas/ de dag ming yin pas 'du byed kyi phung por 'dod ces pa'ang mi 'thad de/ sgra rang mtshan la thob pa brtsir med pa'i phyir dang / de dag gi mtshan nyid skye sogs rnams gzhung mngon par mi 'dod pa'i phyir/ kha cig mngon pa sde bdun gyi nang nas ye shes la 'jug pa gtso bo/ gzhan drug 'khor du 'dod pa dang / gzhan dag bka' gtso bo dang / bstan bcos phal ba zhes pa'ang mi 'thad de/

'dir 'khor dang bcas na phung po du yin dpyad pa'i skabs gyi gtso 'khor tsam dpyad pa min pa'i phyir/ des na gzhung mngon pa ni brjod bya don gyi mngon pa brjod byar ston pa'i bka' bstan bcos gnyis yin la/ de yang mdo sde pas tshig yin pas gzugs phung dang / bye brag tu smra bas ming yin pas 'du byed kyi phung por 'dod de/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri dag /gang rnams thub pas gsungs de dag /tshig gam ming yin de dag ni/ /gzugs dang 'du byed dag tu bshad/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa sgra don ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/ mngon du'i phyir dang yang yang dang / /zil gnon rtogs phyir mngon pa'i chos/ /zhes gsungs te/ mngon pa'i skad dod du a bhi zhes 'byung ba la mu kha bsnan pas a bhi mu kha ni mngon du byed pa'i sgo zhes pa ste/ myang 'das mngon du byed pa'i sgo yin pas mngon pa zhes bya'o/ /k+ṣa ṇa bsnan nas a bhi k+ṣa ṇa ni yang yang mngon du byed pa zhes pa ste chos re re'ang zag bcas zag med/ thogs bcas thogs med/ bstan yod bstan med sogs kyi sgo nas yang yang bstan pas na mngon pa zhes bya'o/ /bhu ta bsnan pas a bhi bhu ta ni mngon du zil gyis gnon pa zhes pa ste/ gzhung 'di'i tshig don rgya mtsho lta bu'i pha rol tu son pas phas kyi rgol ba zil gyis gnon pas na mngon pa zhes bya'o/ /sa ma ya bsnan pas a bhi sa ma ya ni mngon par rtogs pa zhes pa ste/ 'di la brten nas mdo sde'i sde snod mngon par rtogs par byed pas na mngon pa zhes bya'o/ /gsum pa mdzod ni/ 'dir de'i don du yang dag chud phyir ram/ /'di yi gnas de yin pas chos mngon mdzod/ /ces gsungs te/ gnas brgyad pa can gyi bstan bcos 'dir chos mngon pa sde bdun po chud pa'i phyir na 'di la mdzod ces bya'o/ /de yang tshig ma lus pa chud pa min gyi don yin la don gyi yang gces pa rnams chud pa'i phyir de skad ces bya ste/

rgyal po'i nor gces pa chud pa'i khang pa la rgyal po'i mdzod ces pa bzhin no/ /yang na 'di gang nas phyung ba'i gnas mngon pa sde bdun po de yin pas na 'di la'ang mdzod ces bya ste/ ral gri gang nas phyung ba'i gnas shub yin pas ral gri la'ang ral gri'i shub ces brjod pa bzhin no/ /mchims na re/ de ltar du 'jig rten na ma grags pas rgyal po'i mdzod nas byung ba'i nor la mdzod ces pa dper bya'o/ /zhes gsungs mod/ 'di la snga ma grags che ste/ shub dang bcas pa'i ral gri len par 'dod pa na/ ral shub 'on cig ces pa 'jig rten na mthong ba'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pa bstan bcos la ngo bo/ nges tshig dbye ba/ rnam grangs/ ldang tshad/ brtsam pa'i dgos pa/ brtsam pa'i rgyu dang bdun las/ dang po ni/ spyir grub mtha' smra ba bzhi char gyis ming tshig yi ge'i tshogs su snang ba la 'dod par mtshungs la/ khyad par ni bye brag smra bas ming tshig yi ge'i tshogs kyi bsdus pa/ yid kyi rnam shes kyis gzung bya/ ldan pa min pa'i 'du byed/ phung po gzhan bzhi las rdzas gzhan pa zhig la 'dod de/ des don dngos su go bar byed pa'i phyir te/ rjod byed kyi sgra rang mtshan rna bas thos pa'i rjes su yid kyi rnam shes la ming tshig yi ge'i rnam pa snang zhing / de las don dngos su go ba'i phyir/ rjod byed kyi sgra rang mtshan pa dang / yig 'bru'i gzugs rnams bstan bcos btags pa ba yin te/ 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan ni don brgyud nas go bar byed pa'i phyir/ btags pa'i dgos pa ni don go ba la rjod byed kyi sgra rang mtshan rna bas nyan pa dang / yig 'bru la mig gis blta dgos zhes rtogs pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ dngos la gnod byed ni don dngos su ston byed min pa'i phyir/ mdo sde pa'i lugs ni kha cig rtogs pa la snang ba'i sgra spyi la 'dod pa ni mngon pa smra ba'i mdo sde pa'i lugs min te/ de gzugs phung mi rung ba'i phyir ro/

/des na 'di'i lugs ni rjod byed kyi sgra rang mtshan yin pas gzugs phung du bshad la/ tshad ma smra ba'i mdo sde pa ltar na snga ma ltar 'dod pas bstan bcos rdzas su ma grub pa ni khyad par ro/ /de'i rgyu mtshan yang bstan bcos don dngos su rjod byed la 'dod la/ dngos kyi brjod bya rjod byed don spyi dang sgra spyi zhen pa'i brjod bya rjod byed don dang sgra rang mtshan la 'dod pa'i phyir dang / rtsom byed ming tshig yi ge gsum yang rdzas su ma grub na des brtsams pa'i bstan bcos rdzas su grub pa 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /sems tsam pa'i lugs ni khyad par bzhi dang ldan pa ste/ ngo bo'i khyad par yid shes la ming tshig yi ge'i tshogs su snang ba'i rnam rig rnam pa'i khyad par tshigs bcad dam lhug par gnas pa/ byed las kyi khyad par gdul bya'i blo gros gong nas gong du 'phel bar byed pa dang / rang rang gi 'dod pa'i don go bar byed pa/ rgyud kyi khyad par nyan pa po'i rgyud kyis bsdus pa'o/ /'o na de rtsom pa pos ci ltar brtsams shing 'chad pa pos ji ltar 'chad ce na/ rtsom pa pos rang la snang ba'i rnam rig de nyid brtsams shing 'chad pa pos rang la snang ba'i rnam rig de nyid bshad pas nyan pa pos rang gi rnam rig de nyid go ba yin te/ nyi shu pa las/ gcig la gcig gi dbang gis na/ /rnam par rig pa phan tshun 'gyur/ /zhes dang / 'bri la sogs pa'i yid dbang gis/ /dran pa nyams sogs 'gyur ba bzhin/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa nges tshig ni/ bstan bcos kyi skad dod du/ shāsatra zhes pa yod la/ shā sa ni 'chos pa ste/ gdul bya'i sems rgyud bslab pa gsum ldan du 'chos pa dang / tā ra ni sgrol ba'am skyob pa/ de ngan 'gro dang srid pa'i sdug bsngal las skyob pa ste/ de skad du rnam bshad rigs par/ nyon mongs dgra rnams ma lus 'chos pa dang / /ngan 'gro srid las skyob byed gang yin pa/ /'chos skyob yon tan phyir na bstan bcos ste/

/gnyis po 'di dag gzhan gyi lugs la med/ /ces gsungs so/ /gsum pa rab tu dbye ba ni/ gtan la dbab pa bsdu ba las ming gi sgo nas dgu dang / rdzas kyi sgo nas gsum du gsungs pa las/ dang po ni/ don med don log don dang ldan/ /ngan g.yo brtse bral sdug bsngal spangs/ /thos rtsod sgrub pa lhur len pa/ /bstan bcos drug bral gsum du 'dod/ /ces pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ dgu po de dag kyang phyi rol pa'i rig byed kyi gsang tshig snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa dang / sangs rgyas pa dang rtsod pa smra ba'i bstan bcos dang / sangs rgyas pa'i thar pa thob pa dang rjes su mthun pa'i bstan bcos gsum du 'dus par gsungs so/ /bzhi pa rnam grangs ni/ slob ma'i sems rgyud 'chos par byed pas na bstan bcos dang / mdo'i don gsal bar byed pas na mdo sde'i rgyan dang / skabs su bab pa'i don gsal bar byed pas na rab tu byed pa zhes bya ba ni rnam grangs yin la/ 'on kyang mdo sde'i rgyan ni bstan bcos bye brag dang / rab tu byed pa ni bstan bcos kyi nang tshan la 'jug pa yang yod do/ /lnga pa ldang tshad ni/ yi ge du ma 'dus pa las ming / ming du ma 'dus pa las tshig tshig du ma 'dus pa las phung khams skye mched re re rdzogs par ston pa ni rab byed/ de gsum char rdzogs par ston pa ni bstan bcos/ yang na ci lta ba dang ci snyed pa gang rung re re rdzogs par ston pa ni rab byed dang / gnyis ka rdzogs par ston pa ni bstan bcos so/ /yang na dmigs pa'i rab dbye/ spang bya'i nyon mongs/ spong byed kyi gnyen po/ spong ba'i gang zag spangs pa'i 'bras bu rnams las gang rung re re rdzogs par ston pa ni rab byed dang / de thams cad rdzogs par ston pa ni bstan bcos so/ /bstan bcos 'di la don gsum char tshang ngo / /drug pa brtsams pa'i dgos pa ni/ gtan la dbab pa bsdu ba las/ /don mang mos 'jug nyams pa gso/

/'thor sdud zab dgrol mdzes pa bskyed/ /ces drug gsungs pa las don mang ba ni bstan bcos brtsams pa la brten nas yi ge 'bri mchod sbyin pa la sogs chos spyod bcu'i mang po 'byung ba'o/ /mos 'jug ni de la brten nas gdul bya mos pa rnams 'jug pa'o/ /nyams pa gso ba ni bka' gang gi dgongs 'grel du bshad pa las gang zag gi cha rkyen nyams pa gso ba'o/ /'thor ba sdud pa ni bka' gang gi don du bshad pa las brjod bya'i don phyogs gcig tu bsdu bar 'os pa rnams 'thor nas gnas pa phyogs gcig tu bsdu ba'o/ /zab mo dgrol ba ni/ pha dang ma ni gsad bya zhing / /rgyal po gtsang sbra can gnyis dang / /yul 'khor 'khor dang bcas bcom na/ /mi de dag pa nyid du 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i don/ las dang sred pa spang bya zhing / /sbyor ba'i rnam shes mchog 'dzin gnyis/ /skye mched spyod yul bcas bcom na/ /mi de dag pa nyid du 'gyur/ /zhes par 'chad pa lta bu'i bka'i nang du don gzhan du bsgyur nas 'chad dgos pa rnams bstan bcos kyis kyang 'chad pa'o/ /drug pa mdzes pa bskyed pa ni/ bstan bcos su snyan ngag dang tshig rgyan la sogs pa bkod pas tshig dang don mdzes par 'gyur ba'o/ /de ltar drug las kha cig bstan bcos 'di la dang po gsum tshang ba dang / gzhan dag drug char tshang bar bzhed kyang / nyams pa gso ba dang / zab mo dgrol ba gnyis tshang bar dka' zhing / gzhan bzhi char nges par tshang ngo / /bdun pa brtsam pa'i rgyu ni/ tshig don phyin ci ma log par rtogs pa'i shes rab dang snying rje ni rgyu'i gtso bo yin no/ /yang na gtan la dbab pa bsdu ba las sngon gyi slob dpon la nga mi rgyal ba dang / rang gi grags pa mi sgrogs pa dang / chos mthun la byams pa dang / sems can la snying brtse ba bzhi dang ldan na bstan bcos brtsams par gsungs pa ltar ro/ /bzhi pa mtshan ldan gzhung gi dgos 'grel ni/ chos rnams rab tu rnam 'byed med par nyon mongs rnams/

/gang phyir nye bar zhi bar bya ba'i thabs med la/ /nyon mongs pas kyang 'jig rten srid mtsho 'dir 'khyams te/ /de bas de phyir 'di ni ston pas gsungs so lo/ /zhes pas bstan te/ 'di la dgos sogs chos bzhi ngos gzung ba dang / de gzhung gis ji ltar bstan pa'i tshul gnyis las/ dang po ni/ brjod bya'i gtso bo ni lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa ste/ chos mngon pa'i sde snod rnams kyis lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa brjod bya'i gtso bor ston pa'i phyir ro/ /zag bcas zag med kyi chos gzhan rnams ni brjod bya tsam yin te/ lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa gtan la 'bebs pa la de'i yul gtan la dbab dgos pas de'i sgo nas brjod byar 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /dgos pa ni bstan bcos 'di la brten nas skyes pa'i chos rab tu rnam 'byed kyi shes rab bo/ /nying dgos ni chos rab tu rnam 'byed kyi shes rab nyams su blangs pa la brten nas zag med kyi shes rab kyi nyon mongs spangs pa'i myang 'das so/ /'brel pa ni spyi dang mthun no/ /gnyis pa ni/ chos rnams zhes pas brjod bya tsam dngos su bstan nas/ brjod bya'i gtso bo don gyis bstan no/ /dgos pa ni/ rab tu rnam 'byed ces dang / de phyir zhes pas bstan te/ chos rab tu rnam 'byed kyi shes rab bskyed pa'i ched du 'di brtsam par bstan pa'i phyir ro/ /nying dgos ni/ med par zhes pa nas de bas zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan te/ dngos su chos rab tu rnam 'byed kyi shes rab med par nyon mongs spong ba'i thabs med/ nyon mongs ma spangs na 'khor bar 'khyams pa bstan nas shugs la chos rab tu rnam 'byed kyi shes rab la brten nas nyon mongs dang 'khor ba spangs pa'i myang 'das thob par bstan pa'i phyir/ 'brel pa ni/ med par zhes pas bstan te/ dngos su dgos pa med par nying dgos mi 'byung bar bstan nas shugs la bstan bcos dang / brjod bya dang /

dgos pa dang / nying dgos rnams snga ma snga ma la brten nas phyi ma phyi ma 'byung bar bstan pa'i phyir ro/ /lnga pa dgos ldan bstan bcos spyi'i rnam gzhag la/ gnas brgyad kyi grangs nges dang / go rim nges pa gnyis las/ dang po la snga rabs pa rnams chos mngon pa mdzod kyi gnas de la brgyad du grangs nges te/ thar pa don gnyer gyi gang zag gi cha rkyen la dmigs pa'i yul/ nyams len gyi spyod pa/ nyams su blangs pa'i 'bras bu gsum du nges shing / de dag ston pa la gnas brgyad las mang mi dgos shing nyung na mi 'du ba'i phyir/ gang zag gi cha rkyen la gsum po der nges te/ yul ma bstan na nyams su len mi shes/ nyams su ma blangs na 'bras bu mi thob/ 'bras bu med na nyams su len pa dgos pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum po de dag gnas brgyad kyis ci ltar ston na/ dmigs pa'i yul la ci snyed pa dang ci lta ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ phung khams skye mched yin la/ de ni gnas dang pos bstan/ de'i nang nas 'dus byas chos kyi nang tshan/ de dag skye tshul rnams gnyis pas bstan/ ci lta ba ni 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi yin la/ de la sdug bsngal gyi bden pa ni/ sems can skye ba dang skye ba'i gnas kyis bsdus pa yin pas gnas gsum pas bstan/ kun 'byung bden pa ni zag bcas kyi las dang / nyon mongs pa yin pas gnas bzhi pa dang lnga pas bstan/ 'gog bden dang lam bden so sor brtags pas 'gog pa gang zhe na/ zag med lam gyi bden pa dang / /zhes pas bstan/ yang na 'gog bden ni phra rgyas kyi mjug tu yongs shes dang / lam bden ni/ bden pa mthong dang sgom pa las/ /zhes pa'i mthong sgom gnyis kyis bstan la/ bden pa bzhi char yang de'i bden pa zhes pa'i tshig gis bsdus nas bstan to/ /nyams len gyi spyod pa ni/ tshul gnas thos dang bsam ldan pas/ /sgom pa la ni rab tu sbyor/ /zhes pa'i tshul gyis gnas drug pas bstan/

'bras bu zag med kyi ye shes ni gnas bdun pas/ yon tan gyi khyad par 'ga' zhig ni gnas brgyad pas bstan to zhes bzhed do/ /gang spel gyis/ zag bcas zag pa med chos rnams/ /zhes pa'i tshul gyis 'di'i brjod bya'i gtso bo ni zag bcas zag med kyi chos gnyis yin te/ thar pa don gnyer gyi blang dor gyi gtso bo ni/ dor bya nyon mongs kyi chos dang / blang bya rnam byang gi chos gnyis su yod pa'i phyir/ de gnyis so sor mi phye bar thun mong du ston pa ni gnas dang po gnyis te/ phung khams skye mched dang / dbang po nyer gnyis mtshungs ldan 'du byed 'dus byas kyi chos kyi skye tshul rnams ni nyon mongs dang rnam byang thun mong gi chos yin pa'i phyir/ so sor ston pa la kun nas nyon mongs pa ni/ gang kun nas nyon mongs na 'gro ba ris lnga/ gang du na snod kyi 'jig rten du/ tshul ji ltar na rten 'brel bcu gnyis dang / skye gnas bzhi'i tshul gyis so zhes pa ni gnas gsum pas bstan/ gang gis kun nas nyon mongs na zag bcas kyi las dang / nyon mongs kyis so zhes pa ni bzhi pa dang lnga pas ston/ rnam byang gi chos la gang rnam par byang na zhugs gnas brgyad/ gang du na/ 'dod pa gsum thob tha ma ni/ /gsum du 'o zhes pa'i tshul gyis khams gsum du/ tshul ci ltar na/ tshul gnas thos dang bsam ldan pas/ /sgom pa la ni rab tu sbyor/ /zhes pa'i tshul gyis so zhes pa ni gnas drug pas bstan no/ /gang gi rnam par byang na zag med kyi ye shes dang / de'i sems rten snyoms 'jug gis so zhes pa ni gnas bdun pa dang brgyad pas bstan to zhes bzhed do/ /'on kyang theg pa gsum gyi lam bgrod tshul dang sbyar na 'di ltar yin te/ spyir bye brag tu smra ba'i lugs la/ tshul gnas thos dang bsam ldan pas/ /sgom pa la ni rab tu sbyor/ /zhes pa'i tshul gyis/ bden pa mthong dang goms pa las/ /zhes pa'i skabs kyi mthong sgom gyi lam gnyis bskyed de/

nyon mongs spangs pa zhes bshad pa zhes pa'i skabs kyi mthong spang nyon mongs dang / sgom spang nyon mongs spangs nas mi slob lam thob pa ni theg pa gsum gyi lam bgrod tshul thun mong ba yin la/ de dag gi khyad par ston pa la gnas brgyad du nges te/ de la dmigs pa yul gyi khyad par/ spang bya sgrib pa'i/ bgrod byed gang zag gi bgrod tshul lam gyi/ nyams len spyod pa'i/ 'bras bu thob dus kyi/ thob 'bras yon tan gyi khyad par dang bdun las/ dang po ni/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi dmigs yul khams gsum snod bcud kyi 'jig rten sdug bsngal du shes pa tsam gyis grol ba thob pas de ni gnas gsum pas bstan/ theg pa chen po pas de'i steng du yang ji snyed pa mkhyen pa ye shes kyi rgyur phung khams skye mched kyi rab dbye ma lus pa shes dgos la/ de ni gnas dang po gsum gyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi spang bya zag bcas kyi las dang nyon mongs pa spangs pa tsam gyis byang chub thob pas de ni gnas bzhi pa dang lnga pas bstan/ theg chen gyi byang chub thob pa la nyon mongs can ma yin pa'i mun pa yang spang dgos pas de ni phung khams skye mched kyi shugs la bstan pa'am/ mchod brjod kyis dngos su bstan no/ /gsum pa ni/ theg pa chen po dang rang rgyal ni tshogs lam gyi gnas skabs su tshogs thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byas nas srid pa tha ma pa'i dus su drod nas mi slob lam gyi bar gyi rtogs pa rnams bsam gtan bzhi pa la brten nas stan thog gcig la bgrod pas zhugs gnas kyi rnam gzhag med la/ nyan thos kyi de ltar byed mi nus pas zhugs gnas kyi rnam par bzhag pa yod cing / de ni gnas drug pa'i gang zag bstan pas bstan/ bzhi pa ni dbugs dbyung rngub dang mi sdug pa sgom pa la brten nas dang por zhi gnas bskyed/ de nas lhag mthong dran pa nyer gzhag bskyed nas tshogs rdzogs par byed pa ni theg pa gsum ka'i lam bgrod tshul thun mong ba yin la/

dri ma dang bral ba'i khyad par ni nyan thos rnams kyis mthong lam thob rjes su yang 'dod par skye srid bcu bzhi len pa dang / gzugs su bcu drug len pa dang / gzugs med du bzhi len pa sogs yod cing / bse ru lta bu'i rang sangs rgyas dang theg chen pa rnams drod nas mi slob lam gyi bar stan gcig la bskyed pas mthong lam thob rjes su de lta bu'i skye ba len tshul gyi dbye ba med la/ de ni gnas drug pa'i lam bstan pas bstan no/ /lnga pa ni lus 'du 'dzi las bsring ba dang / sems rnam rtog las bsring ba ste bsring ba gnyis dang / bsod snyoms dang / gnas mal dang / chos gos ngan ngon tsam gyis chog shes pa dang / spang ba dang sgom pa la dga' ba'i spyod pa ni theg pa gsum char gyi thun mong gi nyams len spyod pa yin la/ de ni gnas drug par/ bsring gnyis ldan chog mi shes dang / /zhes pas bstan to/ /theg pa chen po pas de'i steng du yang bskal pa grangs med gsum du sangs rgyas 'byung ba mnyes par byed cing / mgo dang rkang lag gtong ba sogs sbyin sogs phar phyin bcu rdzogs par byed cing / 'tshang rgya ba la bskal pa brgya lus pa'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' nges gnas su gyur pa nas phyir mi ldog pa'i byang sems tshogs lam pa des mtshan gyi rgyu sgrub par byed la/ de ni gnas bzhi par/ gang nas byang chub sems dpa' yin/ /zhes sogs kyis bstan to/ /drug pa ni/ nyan thos rtog pa bul bas ni/ sangs rgyas 'od srung gi bstan pa la lam du zhugs/ shākya thub pa'i bstan pa la dgra bcom thob pa dag kyang yod la/ brtson 'grus myur bas tshe gsum la dgra bcom thob pa yang yod/ rang sangs rgyas ni tshogs lam gyi gnas skabs su bskal pa brgyar tshogs bsags nas drod nas mi slob lam gyi bar stan thog gcig la mngon du byed/ theg chen pas ni tshogs lam du bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags nas drod nas mi slob lam gyi bar stan thog gcig la mngon du byed pa yin la/

de dag ni/ myur ba srid pa gsum gyis thar/ /zhes dang / bse ru bskal pa brgya yi rgyus/ /zhes dang / de grangs med gsum la sangs rgyas/ /zhes sogs kyis bstan to/ /bdun pa ni/ sgom lam rdo rje lta bu'i rjes su zad mi skye shes kyi ye shes mngon du byed pa ni theg pa gsum char gyi byang chub thob tshul thun mong ba yin la/ de ni/ de zad thob dang zad par shes/ /de tshe de mi slob dgra bcom/ /zhes dang / gnas bdun pa'i zad mi skye shes kyi ye shes ston pa'i gzhung rnams kyis ston to/ /yon tan de la shes pas bsdus pa dang / ma bsdus pa gnyis/ dang po la/ thun mong dang / thung mong ma yin pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ nyon mongs med pa dang / smon gnas mkhyen pa dang / so sor yang dag rig pa bzhi dang / mngon shes drug sogs yin la/ de ni gnas bdun pas ston cing / gnyis pa ni/ stobs bcu/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi/ dran pa nye bar bzhag pa gsum/ thugs rje chen po ste sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad yin la/ de yang gnas bdun pas ston/ shes pas ma bsdus pa'i yon tan ni/ bsam gtan bzhi/ gzugs med bzhi/ rnam thar/ zad par/ zil gnon rnams yin la/ de ni gnas brgyad pas ston no/ /de ltar na theg pa gsum gyi lam bgrod tshul thun mong ba dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam gzhag ston pa'i dbang du byas nas brgyad du nges pa yin no/ /gnyis pa go rim nges pa ni/ thog mar don gnyis phun tshogs mnga' ba'i sangs rgyas la/ /gang zhig kun la mun pa gtan bcom zhing / /zhes sogs rkang pa gsum gyis mchod par brjod nas las su bya ba ci byed zhe na/ chos mngon mdzod kyi bstan bcos rab bshad bya/ /zhes bshad par dam bcas pa'o/ /ci'i phyir chos mngon mdzod ces bya zhe na/ chos mngon shes rab dri med rjes 'brang bcas/ /zhes sogs sh+lau ka gcig gis chos mngon pa dang mdzod kyi sgra don bstan no/ /'o na chos mngon pa de dgos pa gang gi ched du thog mar su zhig gis gsungs pa yin zhe na/

nyon mongs pa spang ba'i phyir du dang por ston pa sangs rgyas kyis gsungs so/ /zhes pa ni/ chos rnams rab tu rnam 'byed med par/ /zhes sogs sh+lau ka gcig chos rnams rab tu rnam 'byed ces pa'i 'byed rgyu'i chos de gang zhe na/ zag bcas zag med kyi chos gnyis so zhes pa ni/ zag bcas zag pa med chos zhes pas bstan/ zag bcas zag med kyi mtshan gzhi dang / zag med kyi nang gses kyi dbye ba dang bcas pa ni/ lam ma gtogs pa'i 'dus byas rnams/ /zhes sogs rkang pa bcu gcig gis bstan/ lam ma gtogs pa'i 'dus byas rnams/ /zhes pa'i 'dus byas de gang zhe na/ gzugs sogs phung po lnga po zhes phung po gtso bor ston cing / zhar la khams dang skye mched rnams kyang ston pas phung khams skye mched gsum ston pa ni/ 'dus byas chos rnams de dag kyang / /zhes pa nas gnas dang po ril gyis so/ /gnas dang por/ bcu gnyis nang gir bshad dbang por/ /zhes dbang po'i ming tsam dang / 'dus byas chos kyi rnam bzhag rgyas par bshad kyang / de dag gi skye tshul dang / rgyu rkyen 'bras bu dang bcas pa ma bstan pas dbang po'i rnam bzhag dang 'dus byas kyi skye tshul dang / rgyu rkyen 'bras bu dang bcas pa rim pa bzhin ston pa ni gnas gnyis pa'o/ /gnas dang por khams kyi rnam pa'i rab dbye'i skabs su khams gsum gyis bsdus tshul dang / gnas gnyis par dbang po nyer gnyis dang mtshungs ldan 'du byed kyi skabs su yang khams gsum gyis bsdus tshul dang / de ma thag rkyen gyi skabs su khams gsum gyis bsdus pa'i shes pa bcu dang / zag med kyi shes pa gnyis te shes pa bcu gnyis gang gi mjug thog tu gang 'byung ba gsungs kyang sdud byed khams gsum gyi rnam bzhag ma gsungs pas de dag rgyas par ston pa ni gnas gsum pa'o/ /gnas gsum par/ bdag med phung po tsam nyid do/ /zhes byed pa po'i bdag med par gsungs shing / snod bcud kyi 'jig rten gyi rnam bzhag gsungs pa la phyi rol pa kha cig

byed pa po'i bdag med pa mi 'thad de/ snod bcud kyi 'jig rten bdag gis byas pa'i phyir/ zhes dang / kha cig gtso bos byas pa dang / kha cig dbang phyug gis byas pa dang / kha cig rgyu med du byung zhes 'dod pa bsal nas zag bcas kyi las las byung bar ston pa ni gnas bzhi pa'o/ /las de nyid gang las byung zhe na/ phra rgyas las byung zhes pa ni gnas lnga pa'o/ /phra rgyas bstan pa'i thog mar mthong spang dang sgom spang gi rnam bzhag dang / mjug tu spyir gnyen pos spong tshul dang / spangs pa'i 'bras bu yang shes bstan pa las 'phros nas/ gnyen po mthong sgom gyi rang bzhin de'i dmigs yul bden pa bzhi dang / bden pa gnyis kyi rnam gzhag dang / lam de la 'jug pa'i tshul dang / de la gnas pa'i gang zag gi rnam gzhag dang / de'i thob bya 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag rnams rim pa bzhin ston pa ni gnas drug pa'o/ /gnas drug par bzod pa dang / shes pa dang lta ba zhes pa mang du gsungs pa las 'phros nas bzod shes lta ba'i khyad par dang / bye brag tu shes pa la bcur dbye ba dang / shes pas bsdus pa'i thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i yon tan ston pa ni gnas bdun pa'o/ /de dag las 'phros nas 'o na shes pas ma bsdus pa'i yon tan yang yod dam zhe na/ shes pas ma bsdus pa'i yon tan ni bsam gtan bzhi/ gzugs med bzhi/ tshad med bzhi/ rnam thar/ zad par/ zil gnon rnams yin no zhes pa ni gnas brgyad pas bstan to/ /dpal shes rab grags kyis sbyar ba las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ thar pa 'dod nyid la/ /thar pa thob bya ni/ /phra rgyas spang dgos te/ /phra rgyas spong ba la/ /gnyen po lam bskyed 'tshal/ /gnyen po lam bskyed la/ /dmigs la rten bskyed pas/ /dmigs pa shes par bya/ /dmigs pa rnam gnyis te/ /zag bcas zag med chos/ /de nyid bstan pa'i phyir/ /phung po skye mched dang / /khams rnams rab ston pa'i/ /mdzod nyid dang por bstan/

/khams bstan mdzod nyid las/ /dbang po'i ming tsam smos/ /de yi dbye ba dag /rgyas par dpyad phyir dang / /gzhan yang de nyid las/ /'dus byas chos rnams kyi/ /mtshan nyid so sor bstan/ /de dag skye ba'i tshul/ /rgyu dang rkyen rnams dang / /'bras bur bcas pa dag /rab tu bstan pa'i phyir/ /dbang po bstan pa'i mdzod/ de yi 'og tu bstan/ /dbang po'i mdzod nyid las/ /khams gsum nges pa yi/ /sems dang sems byung dang / /dbang po'i dbye ba byas/ /khams gsum ma bstan pas/ /de nyid bstan pa'i phyir/ /'jig rten bstan pa'i mdzod/ /de yi 'og tu bstan/ /mu stegs log rtog kyis/ /sems can 'di ltar rtog /gal te bskyed pa'i rgyu/ /bdag cig yod lta na/ /phyi nang snod bcud kyi/ /'jig rten sna tshogs dag /de las skye 'gyur na/ /byed pa'i bdag med na/ /de dag ci las skye/ /snyam du the tshom za/ /de phyir de dag gi /the tshom bsal phyir dang / /mngon pas mdo 'chad pas/ /mdo las byung ba yi/ /las rnams bstan pa'i phyir/ /shun bcas 'bras sogs kyis/ /'dul ba las bstan mdzod/ /de yi 'og tu bstan/ /de dag de lta bu'i/ /las de'i rnam smin gyis/ /yang srid phyi ma yi/ /rnam smin 'grub nges pa/ /phra rgyas dbang gis byung / /de bas phra rgyas kyi/ /mtshan nyid bstan pa'i phyir/ /klu la sogs pa dang / /'dra ba'i phra rgyas mdzod/ /de yi 'og tu bstan/ /phra rgyas mdzod nyid las/ /bden pa rnam bzhi'i don/ /mthong dang sgom pa yis/ /mthong spang sgom spang gnyis/ /rim bzhin spong bar bshad/ /mthong sgom lam nyid kyi/ /rang bzhin ma bstan pas/ /de nyid bstan pa'i phyir/ /gang zag bstan pa'i mdzod/ /de yi 'og tu bstan/ /lam dang gang zag dag /bstan pa'i mdzod nyid las/ /shes pa rnam bzhi bshad/ /de yi dbye ba dag /rgyas par bshad pa'i phyir/ /ye shes bstan pa'i mdzod/ /de yi 'og tu bstan/ /ye shes mdzod nyid las/ /de bzhin gshegs pa la/

/yon tan rnam gnyis bstan/ /thun mong yon tan dang / /thun mong ma yin pa'o/ /thun mong yon tan ni/ /nyon mongs med smon shes/ /so so yang dag par/ /rig pa rnam bzhi dang / /mngon par shes pa dang / /bsam gtan gzugs med dang / /tshad med rnam thar dang / /zad par la sogs pa/ /de dag bstan pa'i phyir/ /snyoms 'jug bstan pa'i mdzod/ /de yi 'og tu bstan/ /zhes so/ /bshad pa sngon 'gro rgya stag khra bo'i gzhung ris bshad zin to// //da ni dkyus kyi sa bcad pa rus sbal rgya bo'i bzhi 'gros bshad par bya ste/ 'di la gsum/ sgyur byed dam pa'i klad kyi don/ /rtsom byed dam pa'i gzhung gi don/ /bsgyur ba mthar phyin mjug gi don to/ /dang po la gnyis/ mtshan gyi don/ rgya gar/ 'gyur gyi phyag go 'jam dpal/ /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ gzhung don la 'jug pa'i yan lag gzhung don chos mngon pa'i yul bshad pa/ gzhung don yongs su rdzogs pa'i bya ba'o/ /dang po la bzhi ste/ mchod par brjod pa/ gang zhig bshad par dam bca' ba/ chos mngon/ bshad bya'i mtshan don/ mtshan ldan gzhung gi dgos 'brel lo/ /gsum pa la gnyis te/ chos mngon pa'i don/ chos mngon/ mdzod kyi don/ 'dir de/ bzhi pa la gnyis te/ dgos 'brel dngos/ chos rnams/ dang por sus bstan pa'o/ 'di ni/ /gnyis pa gzhung don chos mngon pa'i yul bshad pa la gnyis te/ mdor bstan/ zag bcas/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /'di la gsum/ zag bcas bshad/ lam ma/ zag med bshad/ de dag gtan la dbab pa'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ zag med spyir bstan/ zag med/ 'dus ma byas bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ de la/ /gsum pa la gnas brgyad las/ dang po khams bstan pa'i gnas la gsum ste/ 'dus byas phung por bstan pa rnam grangs dang bcas pa/ phung khams skye mched rgyas par bshad pa/ khams kyi rnam pa'i rab dbye bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/

dbye ba/ 'dus byas/ rnam grangs so/ /'di la gnyis te/ 'dus byas spyi'i rnam grangs/ de dag bye brag zag bcas kyi rnam grangs so/ gang dag /gnyis pa la lnga ste/ phung po gtso bor byas pa'i chos gsum gyi rnam bzhag chos gsum so so'i sgra don/ spung dang / chos gsum bstan pa'i dgos pa/ rmongs dbang / de dag nges pa'i rgyu mtshan/ ming can gzhan yang der bsdu ba'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ so sor bshad pa/ gsum du bsdu ba/ phung po/ mig la sogs/ khams mang bar thal ba spang ba'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ gzugs phung gtso bor byas pa'i chos gsum/ phung po bar pa gsum gtso bor byas pa'i chos gsum/ rnam shes kyi phung po gtso bor byas pa'i chos gsum mo/ /dang po la gnyis te/ gzugs phung gi ngo bo/ dbang don/ de las phyungs te gzugs can gyi khams dang skye mched du bzhag pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ mdor bstan/ gzugs ni/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /'di la gsum ste/ dbang po lnga mtshan nyid kyi sgo nas bshad/ de dag don lnga dbye ba'i sgo nas bshad/ gzugs rnams/ rigs byed min pa ngo bo'i sgo nas bshad pa'o/ /'di la gnyis te/ dngos kyi don/ g.yengs dang / zhar la rgyu 'byung ba bshad pa'o/ /'di la bzhi ste/ dbye ba/ 'byung ba/ byed las/ 'dzin pa/ mtshan nyid/ sra gsher/ 'byung ba dang khams kyi khyad par ro/ 'jig rten gyi/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ phung po bar pa gsum gyi ngo bo/ tshor ba/ de gsum/ de dag gzhan dang bcas te chos kyi khams dang skye mched du bzhag pa'o/ /gsum pa la gnyis te/ rnam shes kyi phung po'i ngo bo/ rnam shes/ de las phyungs te sems kyi skye mched dang khams su bzhag pa'o/ yid kyi/ /bzhi pa de dag nges pa'i rgyu mtshan la bzhi ste/ sems byung las tshor 'du phung po logs su ston pa'i rgyu mtshan/ rtsod pa'i/

'dus ma byas phung por mi 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan/ phung po/ phung khams skye mched kyi go rim nges tshul/ gzugs dang chos kyi skye mched gnyis bye brag la bzhag pa'i rgyu mtshan no/ bye brag /gsum pa la gnyis te/ phung po'i go rim/ rim ni/ skye mched dang khams kyi go rim mo/ da lta'i/ /lnga pa ming can gzhan yang der bsdu ba la gsum ste/ phung po'i ming can phung por bsdu ba/ phung khams skye mched kyi ming can gzhan yang bsdu ba/ de bzhin/ zhar la khams gnyis kyi ngo bo'o/ bu ga /dang po la gnyis te/ chos phung gzugs dang 'du byed du bsdu ba/ chos kyi/ zhar la chos phung gi tshad bstan pa'o/ kha cig /gsum pa khams kyi rnam pa'i rab dbye bshad pa la bdun te/ gnyis tshan/ gsum tshan/ bcas ma bcas/ gzugs can gyi dbye ba/ byung ba gsum/ thob pa'i khyad par/ mig dang / phyi nang la sogs pa'i dbye ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ bstan yod bstan med/ bstan yod/ thogs bcas thogs med do/ thogs dang / /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ dge sogs gsum gyi khyad par/ lung ma/ khams gsum gyi khyad par ro/ 'dod khams/ /gsum pa la gsum ste/ zag bcas zag med/ de gsum/ rtogs bcas dpyod bcas/ rtogs/ dmigs bcas dmigs med do/ dmigs bcas/ /bzhi pa la bzhi ste/ zin ma zin/ ma zin/ 'byung ba 'byung 'gyur/ reg bya/ bsags ma bsags/ gzugs can/ gcod byed gcad bya sogs so/ gcod byed/ /lnga pa la gnyis te/ spyir btang / rnam smin/ dmigs kyis bsal ba'o/ rdzas dang / /bdun pa phyi nang sogs kyi dbye ba la bdun/ phyi nang gi dbye ba/ nang gi rten bcas de mtshungs/ chos zhes/ mthong spang sogs kyi bye brag lta ba lta min gyi bye brag rnam shes gang gis shes par bya ba/ gnyis kyi/ rtag mi rtag gi dbye ba/ 'dus ma/

dbang po yin min gyi dbye ba'o/ gang dag /gsum pa la gnyis te/ dngos dang / bcu ni/ rtsod pa spang ba'o/ nyon mongs/ /bzhi pa la gnyis te/ dngos dang / mig dang / de las 'phros pa'o/ /'di la bdun te/ sgo lnga'i shes pa lta bar 'dod pa dgag rnam shes/ rten bcas kyi mig lta bar bsgrub/ mig gis/ dbang pos yul 'dzin pa'i tshul/ rten gyi dus nges pa/ tha ma'i/ dbang po rten du 'jog pa'i tshul/ de dag dbang shes brten par 'dod pa'i rgyu mtshan/ de phyir/ rten sogs bzhi'i sa mtshungs pa'i khyad par ro/ /gsum pa la gsum ste/ mig gnyis kas mthong ba/ mig ni/ phrad ma phrad kyi 'dzin tshul/ mig dang / mnyam mi mnyam gyi 'dzin tshul lo/ sna la sogs/ /bdun pa la bzhi ste/ mig sogs bzhi'i khyad par/ lus la/ rna ba'ang de dang mthun par bstan pa/ rna ba'ang / sna sogs gsum gyi nges pa/ gsum ngag yid ma nges par bstan pa'o/ yid ma/ /gnyis pa dbang po bstan pa la gsum ste/ skabs don dbang po'i rang bzhin/ 'dus byas chos kyi skye tshul/ skyed byed rgyu rkyen 'bras bu dang bcas pa'o/ /dang po la drug ste/ dbang po'i rnam gzhag rnam pa'i rab dbye/ rnyed pa'i tshul/ 'dod par/ gtong ba'i tshul/ gzugs med/ dge sbyong tshul gyi 'bras bu dbang po dus 'thob pa/ 'bras bu/ dbang po'i ldan tshul lo/ /dang po la gsum ste/ dbang sgyur ba'i sgo nas ngo bo bshad/ dbang bsgyur bya'i sgo nas grangs nges bshad/ skabs su bab pa'i dbang po bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ bye brag tu smra ba'i lugs/ lnga po/ mdo sde pa'i lugs so/ rang gi /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ bye brag tu smra ba'i lugs/ sems kyi/ yang na/ mdo sde pa'i lugs so/ /gsum pa la gnyis te/ tshor ba lnga'i ngo bo/ lus tshor/ dri med gsum gyi ngo bo'o/ mthong sgom/

/gnyis pa la drug ste/ zag bcas zag med/ gsum ni/ rnam smin yin min/ srog ni/ rnam smin dang bcas ma bcas/ de gcig ni/ dge sogs gsum gyi khyad par/ dge ba/ khams gsum gyi khyad par/ dri med/ spang bya dang spang bya ma yin pa'i dbye ba'o/ yid dang / /drug pa la gsum ste/ nges ldan btang snyoms/ nyung ldan/ dge med/ mang ldan no/ mang por/ /gnyis pa 'dus byas chos kyi skye tshul la gnyis te/ gzugs can gyi skye tshul dang / 'dod na/ gzugs can ma yin pa'i skye tshul lo/ /'di la gnyis te/ mdor bstan/ sems dang / rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /'di la gnyis te/ sems dang mtshungs ldan gyi skye tshul/ mi ldan pa'i 'du byed kyi skye tshul lo/ /dang po la bzhi ste/ nges pa las brtsams pa'i sde tshan/ ma nges pa dang bcas pa'i mtshungs ldan/ gcig pa lta bu'i tha dad/ tha dad lta bu'i gcig pa'o/ sems dang / /dang po la gnyis te/ mdor bstan/ sems byung / rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /'di la lnga ste/ sems kyi sa mang po pa/ tshor dang / dge ba'i sa mang po pa/ dad dang / nyon mongs pa'i sa mang po pa/ rmongs dang / mi dge ba'i sa mang po pa/ mi dge nyon mongs chung ngu'i sa pa'o/ khro ba/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ 'dod pa'i mtshungs ldan/ 'dod pa'i/ khams gong ma'i mtshungs ldan no/ de las/ /gsum pa la bzhi ste/ ngo tsha med pa dang khrel med kyi khyad par/ ma gus/ dga' ba dang gus pa'i khyad par/ dga' ba/ rtog pa dang dpyod pa'i khyad par/ rtog dang / nga rgyal dang rgyags pa'i khyad par ro/ nga rgyal/ /gnyis pa mi ldan pa'i 'du byed la gsum ste/ mdor bstan/ mi ldan/ rgyas par bshad pa/ chos kyi khyad par gzhan bstan pas mjug bsdu ba'o/ de bzhin/ /gnyis pa la bdun te/ thob ma thob/ skal mnyam/ skal mnyam/

'du shes med pa/ 'du shes/ snyoms 'jug gnyis/ srog srog mtshan nyid/ mtshan nyid/ ming gi tshogs la sogs pa rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ thob ma thob kyi ngo bo/ thob dang / de dag gang gi yin pa/ thob dang / de dag gi chos kyi khyad par ro/ /'di la gnyis te/ thob pa'i chos kyi khyad par/ dus gsum/ ma thob pa'i chos kyi khyad par ro/ ma thob/ /bzhi pa la gnyis te/ ngo bo so sor bshad/ rten thun mong du bstan pa'o/ gnyis ka /dang po la gnyis te/ 'du shes med pa'i snyoms 'jug 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug go /dang po la bdun te/ dgag bya/ de bzhin/ sa/ bsam gtan/ yid byed/ 'byung 'dod/ ngo bo/ dge ba/ myong 'gyur/ skye gnas/ gang zag 'phags pa'i/ thob tshul lo/ dus gcig /gnyis pa la bdun te/ dgag bya/ 'gog pa/ yid byed/ 'di gnas/ sa/ srid rtse/ ngo bo/ dge ba/ myong 'gyur/ gnyis su/ gang zag 'phags pa'i/ thob tshul lo/ sbyor bas/ /bdun pa la gnyis te/ tshogs gsum gyi ngo bo/ ming gi chos kyi khyad par ro/ 'dod dang / /gsum pa skyed byed rgyu rkyen 'bras bu dang bcas pa bshad pa la gnyis te/ rgyu 'bras bshad pa/ rkyen bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ rgyu drug bshad pa/ 'bras bu lnga bshad pa/ rgyu 'bras thun mong gi chos so/ /dang po la gsum ste/ dbye ba/ byed rgyu/ so so'i rang bzhin/ dus nges pas mjug bsdu ba'o/ kun 'gro/ /gnyis pa la drug ste/ byed rgyu/ rang las/ lhan cig 'byung ba'i rgyu/ lhan cig skal mnyam gyi rgyu/ skal mnyam/ mtshungs ldan gyi rgyu/ mtshungs ldan/ kun 'gro'i rgyu/ kun 'gro/ rnam smin gyi rgyu'o/ rnam smin/ /gnyis pa 'bras bu lnga bshad pa la gnyis te/ mdor bstan/ 'dus byas/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/

/'di la gnyis te/ rgyu gang gi 'bras bu gang yin pa/ rnam smin/ 'bras bu lnga po so so'i ngo bo'o/ /'di la lnga ste/ rnam smin gyi 'bras bu/ rnam smin/ rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu/ rgyu mthun/ bral ba'i 'bras bu/ bral ba/ skyes bu'i byed pa'i 'bras bu/ gang gis/ bdag po'i 'bras bu'o/ sngon byung / /gsum pa rgyu 'bras thun mong gi chos la gnyis te/ rgyus 'bras bu 'dzin 'byin gyi dus dang / lnga po/ 'bras bu gang rgyu gang las skyes dpyad pa'o/ nyon mongs/ /gnyis pa rkyen bshad pa la gnyis te/ mdor bstan/ rkyen ni/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /'di la bzhi ste/ rkyen bzhi so so'i rang bzhin/ rkyen gang dus gang la bya ba byed pa/ rgyu gnyis/ dngos po gang rkyen du las skye ba/ bzhi yis/ de ma thag rkyen bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po la bzhi ste/ rgyu'i rkyen/ rgyu zhes/ de ma thag pa'i rkyen/ sems dang / dmigs pa'i rkyen/ dmigs pa/ bdag po'i rkyen no/ byed rgyu/ /bzhi pa la gsum ste/ sems bcu gnyis kyi de ma thag rkyen skye tshul/ de'i sems nyi shur bshad pa/ bcu gnyis/ sems bcu gnyis gang la dur rnyed pa'o/ khams gsum/ /dang po la gnyis te/ sems bcu gnyis su dbye ba/ 'dod yid/ de ma thag rkyen byed pa'i tshul lo/ /'di la gnyis te/ zag bcas kyi dbang du byas pa/ zag med kyi dbang du byas pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ 'dod pa'i sems kyi/ 'dod sems/ gzugs kyi sems kyi/ gzugs na/ gzugs med pa'i sems kyi dbang du byas pa'o/ gzugs med/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ slob pa'i dbang du byas pa/ slob pa/ mi slob pa'i dbang du byas pa'o/ mi slob/ /gsum pa 'jig rten bstan pa la gnyis te/ sems can gyi 'jig rten/ snod kyi 'jig rten no/

/dang po la lnga/ sems can skye ba po 'gro ba'i dbye ba/ skye tshul rten 'brel gyi rang bzhin/ skyes pa gnas pa'i rten/ gnas pa 'chi 'pho ba'i sems/ sems can gyi tshogs gsum du bsdu ba'o/ 'phags dang / /dang po la gsum ste/ khams gsum du dbye ba/ 'gro ba lngar dbye ba/ skye gnas bzhir dbye ba'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ 'dod pa'i dbye ba/ dmyal ba/ gzugs kyi dbye ba/ gong ma'i/ gzugs med kyi dbye ba'o/ gzugs med/ /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ dbye ba dngos/ der ni/ de'i rang bzhin/ nyon mongs/ de dag gi khyad par bstan pa'o/ /'di la bzhi ste/ rnam shes gnas pa bdun bshad pa/ lus dang / sems can gyi gnas dgu bshad pa/ srid rtse/ rnam shes gnas pa bzhi bshad pa/ gnas pa/ bdun dang bzhi'i mu bzhi bshad pa'o/ bsdu na/ /gsum pa skye gnas bzhir dbye ba la gsum ste/ gang du 'jug pa'i skye gnas kyi dbye ba/ der ni/ gang gis 'jug pa'i bar srid bshad pa/ de nyid skye gnas su 'jug pa'i tshul lo/ /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ bar srid kyi ngo bo/ 'dir gang / de'i sgrub byed/ de nyid gtan la dbab pa'o/ de ni/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ rigs pa'i sgrub byed dang / 'bru yi/ lung gi sgrub byed do/ mgur nas/ /gsum pa de nyid skye gnas su 'jug pa'i tshul la gsum ste/ bsam pa gang gis 'jug tshul/ blo ni/ dbyibs gang gis 'jug tshul/ dmyal ba/ mngal du 'jug pa'i rab dbye'o/ gcig ni/ /gnyis pa skye tshul rten 'brel gyi rang bzhin la gsum ste/ bdag med kyang phung po nying mtshams sbyor ba/ bdag med/ phung po'i rgyun thog ma med par bstan pa/ ci ltar/ de rten 'brel bcu gnyis su bzhag pa'o/ /'di la gsum ste/ nyon mongs gsum gyis bsdus pa'i rten 'brel/ nyon mongs gsum po dpes bstan pa/ 'dir ni/

de rnams srid pa bzhir bstan pa'o/ srid pa/ /dang po la gnyis te/ gnas skabs pa'i rten 'brel bstan/ skabs su babs pa'i ngo bo bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ dbye ba mdor bstan/ der ni/ yan lag rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /'di la bzhi ste/ tshe gsum la rdzogs pa'i tshul/ nyon mongs pa gsum du bsdu ba/ nyon mongs/ tshe gnyis kyis yan lag mdor bsdus pa'i rgyu mtshan/ gnyis ni/ yan lag bcu gnyis kyi grangs nges pa'o/ /dang po la lnga ste/ tshe gsum la bzhag pa'i tshul/ sngon/ de ltar bzhag pa'i yan lag ngos bzung / ma rig de nyid gnas skabs par bstan pa/ 'di ni/ yan lag gtso bo'i sgo nas bzhag pa/ gtso bo'i/ tshe gsum la bzhag pa'i dgos pa'o/ sngon dang / /bzhi pa yan lag bcu gnyis kyi grangs nges pa la gnyis te/ grangs nges dngos/ nyon mongs/ 'byung ba dang byung ba'i khyad par ro/ 'dir ni/ /gnyis pa skabs su babs pa'i ngo bo la gnyis te/ yan lag bzhi dngos su bstan/ lhag ma bshad 'chad la ltos pa'o/ bshad dang / /dang po la bzhi ste/ ma rig pa/ ming / ming ni/ reg pa/ reg drug tshor ba bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ ngo bo ngos bzung / rig pa'i/ de shes rab ngan par 'dod pa dgag pa'o/ gal te/ /bzhi pa la gnyis te/ dbye ba spyir bstan/ de las/ sems tshor bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /'di la gsum ste/ mdor bstan/ de yid/ rgyas par bshad/ don bsdu ba'o/ bco brgyud/ /bar pa la gsum ste/ 'dod pa na/ 'dod na/ gzugs khams na/ bsam gtan/ gzugs med na du yod pa'o/ gzugs med/ /gsum pa skyes pa gnas pa'i rten la gsum ste/ mdor bstan/ 'gro ba/ rgyas par bshad/ zas bzhir nges pas mjug bsdu ba'o/ 'di la/ /bar pa la gsum ste/ kham zas bshad pa/ kham gyi/ zas lhag ma bshad pa/ reg dang /

zhar la bar srid kyi rnam grangs so/ yid las/ /bzhi pa gnas pa 'chi 'pho ba'i sems la bzhi ste/ spyir bstan/ 'chad/ bye brag tu bshad/ rnam shes gang du 'gag 'og ma'i/ gnad gcod pa'i rgyu'o/ gnad gcod/ /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ tshor ba'i khyad par/ 'chi 'pho/ sems kyi khyad par/ rtse gcig lhag med du 'jug tshul lo/ mya ngan/ /gnyis pa snod kyi 'jig rten la gsum ste/ rten snod kyi gnas lugs dngos/ zhar la brten pa sems can gyi tshad/ de dag 'jal byed kyi tshad bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ snod kyi gnas lugs spyir bstan/ nang tshan gyi gnas lugs bye brag tu bshad/ gling bzhi/ stong gsum ngos bzung zhing 'byung 'jig mnyam du bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ rten dkyil 'khor gsum bshad/ de la/ brten pa ri mtsho bshad pa'o/ /'di la gnyis te/ ri dgu bshad/ de la/ mtsho brgyad bshad pa'o/ de dag /gnyis pa nang tshan gyi gnas lugs bye brag tu bshad pa la gsum ste/ mi'i gnas/ dmyal ba'i gnas/ lha'i gnas so/ /dang po la gnyis te/ gling bcu gnyis spyir bstan/ 'dzam gling bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ 'di nas/ /dang po la gnyis te/ gling bzhi bshad/ de la ni/ gling phran brgyad bshad pa'o/ de yi/ /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ 'di 'og tsha dmyal brgyad bshad/ nye 'khor bcu drug bshad/ brgyad po/ grang dmyal gyi gnas bshad pa'o/ chu bur/ /gsum pa lha'i gnas bshad pa la gnyis te/ gnas dngos/ zhar la der gnas pa'i sems can gyi khyad par ro/ /dang po la gnyis te/ sa gzhi dang 'brel ba dang / ma 'brel ba'o/ de steng / /dang po la gnyis te/ rgyal chen ris bzhi pa'i gnas/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i gnas so/ /dang po la gnyis te/ gzhal med khang la brten pa'i gnas/ ri la brten pa'i gnas so/ 'di la/ /dang po la bzhi ste/ nyi zla'i bar thag gi tshad/ nyi zla/

nyi mas gling bzhir bya ba byed tshul/ nam phyed/ de la brten pa'i dus tshigs kyi khyad par/ dbyar gyi/ zla ba 'phel 'grib kyi rgyu mtshan no/ nyi ma/ /gnyis pa sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i gnas la gnyis te/ mdor bstan/ lhun po'i/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /'di la lnga ste/ grong khyer/ dbus na/ skyed tshal/ phyi rol/ de dag sa gzhi/ ljon shing / byang shar/ 'dun ma'o/ lho nub/ /gnyis pa der gnas pa'i sems can gyi khyad par la lnga ste/ 'dod pa spyod pa'i/ 'dod pa/ lha'i bu skye ba'i/ byis pa/ 'dod bde skye ba'i/ 'dod pa/ bar thag gi khyad par/ gnas nas/ gong du bgrod tshul lo/ rdzu 'phrul/ /gnyis pa zhar la der gnas pa'i sems can gyi tshad bshad pa la gnyis te/ lus tshad dang / tshe tshad do/ /dang po la gsum ste/ mi'i dang / 'dzam bu'i/ 'dod lha'i dang / 'dod dang / gzugs khams pa'i lus tshad do/ gzugs can/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ tshe tshad dngos/ sgra mi/ bar du 'chi ba yod med dpyad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ bde 'gro'i tshe tshad/ ngan 'gro'i tshe tshad do/ yang sos/ /dang po la gsum ste/ mi'i/ sgra mi/ 'dod lha'i/ mi rnams/ khams gong ma'i tshe tshad do/ /'di la gsum ste/ gzugs can gyi tshe tshad/ gzugs can/ gzugs med kyi tshe tshad/ gzugs med/ tshe tshad kyis bskal pa ngos bzung ba'o/ 'od chung / /gsum pa de dag 'jal byed kyi tshad la gnyis te/ brtsam gzhi/ gzugs ming / brtsam pa 'jal byed do/ /'di la gnyis te/ rdul gyi tshad/ phra rab/ dus kyi tshad do/ /'di la gnyis te/ lo'i tshad/ skad cig bskal pa'i tshad do/ /'di la gsum ste/ bskal pa ngos bzung ba/ ya thog ring mo'i 'grib tshul/ 'jig pa'i bskal pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po la gnyis te/ mdor bstan/ bskal pa/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/

/'di la lnga ste/ 'jig pa'i/ 'jig pa'i/ 'chags pa'i/ 'chags pa'i/ gnas pa'i/ zhig nas 'dug pa'i bskal pa/ 'chags pa/ bskal pa chen po'o/ /gsum pa la lnga ste/ thog ma'i ya thog bar gyi/ bar gyi khug pa/ de nas/ mtha'i ma thog yar skye/ yar 'phel bcu dgu'i mtshams/ de dag de rnams gnas pa'i bskal par/ bstan pa'o/ da ltar/ /lnga pa la gnyis te/ dngos dang / de dag zhar la gang zag gsum gyi 'byung tshul lo/ /'di la gsum ste/ sangs rgyas/ rang rgyal/ 'khor los sgyur ba 'byung tshul lo/ /dang po la gnyis te/ tshogs kyi tshad/ de grangs/ 'byung ba'i dus so/ mar na/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ 'byung ba'i dus/ rang sangs/ tshogs kyi tshad do/ bse ru/ /gsum pa la gsum ste/ 'byung ba'i dus/ 'khor los/ 'khor los sgyur tshul/ gser dngul/ mtshan gyi khyad par ro/ thub mtshan/ /gnyis pa ya thog ring mo'i 'gribs tshul la gsum ste/ bskal pa dang po pa'i khyad par/ sngar byung / de las ji ltar 'grib tshul/ de nas/ 'grib pa'i mthar ji ltar 'byung ba'o/ bskal pa/ /gsum pa 'jig pa'i bskal pa'i tshul la gsum ste/ 'jig pa gsum gyi rtse mo/ me dang / 'jig pa yod med kyi rgyu mtshan/ de yi/ ji ltar 'jig pa'i go rim mo/ me yis/ /bzhi pa las bstan pa la gsum ste/ mtshams sbyar ba'i tshul gyis mdor bstan/ las las/ las dngos rgyas par bshad/ zhar la chos kyi rnam grangs kha cig bstan pas mjug bsdu ba'o/ bsod nams/ /bar pa la gnyis te/ las kyi ngo bo/ mdo las byung ba'i las kyi rnam grangs bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ mdor bstan/ de ni/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /'di la gsum ste/ lus ngag gi las kyi rang bzhin/ las gsum gyi spyi'i chos kyi khyad par/ rig byed ma yin pa bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/

gnyis su dbye ba/ de dag so so'i rang bzhin no/ /'di la gnyis te/ rig byed bshad/ rig byed min par bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ lus kyi rig byed/ ngag gi rig byed do/ ngag rnam/ /dang po la gnyis te/ bye brag tu smra ba'i lugs/ mdo sde pa'i lugs so/ gnyis bzung / /dang po la gnyis te/ ngo bo ngos bzung ba/ lus rnam/ log rtog dgag pa'o/ 'gro min/ /gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ sgrub byed/ rnam gsum/ rgyu 'byung ba'i dus dang sa'i khyad par/ 'dod gtogs/ ngo bo'i khyad par/ rnam rig rgyu 'byung ba'i chos kyi khyad par ro/ rgyu mthun/ /gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ dge sogs gsum gyi khyad par/ rnam rig khams gsum gyi khyad par/ mi dge ni/ zhar la dge sogs gsum gyi dbye ba/ kun slong bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /gsum pa la gsum ste/ dge ba'i/ thar pa/ bzlog pa/ mi dge ba'i/ lung ma bstan gyi dbye ba'o/ don dam/ /bzhi pa la bzhi ste/ dbye ba/ kun slong / gnyis las/ so so'i ngo bo/ mtshan gzhi/ mthong bas/ 'jug tshul lo/ /'di la gnyis te/ spyir btang / rab tu/ dmigs kyis bsal ba'o/ rnam smin/ /gsum pa rig byed ma yin pa bye brag tu bshad pa la gnyis te/ mdor bstan/ rnam rig rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /'di la gnyis te/ sdom pa khyad par du bshad/ thams cad thun mong du bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ /mdor bstan/ sdom pa/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /'di la gsum ste/ so thar gyi sdom pa/ bsam gtan dang zag med/ zhar la yid dang dbang po'i sdom pa bshad pa'o/ shes bzhin/ /dang po la lnga ste/ dbye bsdu/ so sor/ mtshan nyid/ spang bya/ rnam grangs/ tshul khrims/ nges tshig dang po'i/ gang zag go so sor/ /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ gang la ldan pa/ bsam gtan/ sems kyi rjes 'brang / tha ma/

spong ba'i sdom pa'o/ bar chad/ /gnyis pa thams cad thun mong du bshad pa la bzhi ste/ dus ji srid ldan/ tshul ji ltar thob/ rgyu gang gis gtong / rten gang la ldan pa'o/ za ma/ /dang po la gsum ste/ rig byed min pa'i ldan tshul/ rig byed kyi ldan tshul/ de dag gi mu bzhi brtsi ba'o/ bar ma/ /dang po la gsum ste/ so thar dang sdom min gyi ldan tshul/ so so/ mnyam par bzhag pa'i ldan tshul/ bsam gtan/ bar ma'i ldan tshul/ bar gnas/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ ldan tshul dngos/ rnam rig gi zhar la sdom min gyi rnam grangs so/ sdom pa/ /gnyis pa tshul ji ltar thob pa la gsum ste/ sdom pa'i/ sdom min gyi/ bar ma'i thob tshul lo/ lhag ma'i/ /dang po la gnyis te/ thob tshul dngos/ gang las thob pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ bsam gtan/ bsam gtan/ zag med zag med/ so thar thob tshul lo/ /'di la gnyis te/ thob tshul thun mong du bstan/ so sor/ khyad par bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /'di la gsum ste/ dus kyi khyad par/ bsnyen gnas kyi khyad par/ dge bsnyen gyi khyad par ro/ /dang po la gnyis te/ sdom pa'i dus kyi khyad par/ ji srid/ zhar la sdom min gyi dus kyi khyar par ro/ nyin zhag /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ ji ltar nod pa'i tshul/ dma' bar/ yan lag gi grangs nges/ tshul khrims/ gzhan la'ang rten kyi khyad par ro/ /gsum pa la lnga ste/ lung gi don bshad pas dge bsnyen thams cad sdom ldan du bstan/ dge bsnyen/ gal te/ de la nang 'gal spong ba/ zhar la sdom pa che chung gi khyad par/ chung ngu / gang zhig skyabs gnas kyi khyad par/ yan gal gi khyad par ro/ /'di la gsum ste/ log g.yem/ log g.yem/ brdzun/ bslab pa/ bcas pa'i/ myos 'gyur spong ba yan lag du 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan no/ /gnyis pa gang las thob pa la gnyis te/

sdom pa gsum gyi khyad par/ 'dod gtogs/ sdom pa/ de'i nang gses kyi khyad par ro/ /gnyis pa sdom min thob tshul la gnyis te/ gang las thob pa/ sdom pa/ ji ltar thob pa'o/ sdom pa/ /gsum pa rgyu gang gis gtong ba la bzhi ste/ sdom pa'i/ sdom min gyi/ sdom min/ bar ma/ bar ma'i/ de gsum las gzhan pa'i gtong rgyu'o/ 'dod gtogs/ /dang po la gsum ste/ so thar gyi/ bslab pa/ bsam gtan/ bsam gtan gyi/ zag med kyi gtong rgyu'o/ 'phags pa/ /gnyis pa mdo las byung ba'i las kyi rnam grangs bshad pa la gnyis te/ thun mong du bshad pa/ so sor bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ ngo bo rgyu 'bras kyi dbye/ rten gyi sgo nas dbye/ rgyu 'bras nyid kyi sgo nas dbye ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ las gsum du gsungs pa'i don/ las bzhir gsungs pa'i don no/ /dang po la gsum ste/ dge sogs kyi/ bsod nams sogs kyi/ yon po sogs kyi don no/ yon skyon/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ mdor bstan/ bsod nams/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /'di la gnyis te/ bsod nams sogs dang / bsod nams/ bde ba myong / las bde/ 'gyur sogs so/ /'di la gsum ste/ myong 'gyur gsum bshad/ de myong 'gyur lngar bstan/ ngo bo/ skabs kyi myong 'gyur gtan la dbab pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ rang lugs dang / bsam gtan/ gzhan lugs so/ 'og na'ang / /gsum pa la gnyis te/ mdor bstan/ de yang / rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /'di la gsum ste/ dbye ba spyir bstan/ mthong ba'i/ de dag khyad par du bshad/ bye brag myong nges kyi don gtan la dbab pa'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ las gang gis ris mthun 'phen pa/ gsum gyis/ khams gong na las 'phen du yod pa'o/ /'di la gsum ste/ spyir bstan/ thams cad/ gang las/ dmigs kyis bsal/ bar srid na las 'phen du yod pa'o/ srid pa/

/gsum pa bye brag myong nges kyi don gtan la dbab pa la gsum ste/ myong nges spyir bstan/ nyon mongs/ mthong chos myong 'gyur bye brag tu bshad/ las 'bras myong tshul gzhan bstan pa'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ dngos dang / mthong chos/ zhing gi khyad par ro/ gang dag /gsum pa la gsum ste/ sems tshor myong tshul/ rnam par/ lus tshor myong tshul/ mi dge sems g.yengs rgyu rten dang bcas pa'o/ g.yengs pa'i/ /gnyis pa la bzhir gsungs pa'i don la gnyis te/ mdor bstan/ dkar nag rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /'di la gsum ste/ las bzhi spyir bstan/ mi dge zag med bye brag tu bshad/ chos bzod/ gzhan lugs dgag pa'o/ gzhan/ /gnyis pa rten gyi sgo nas dbye ba la gnyis te/ las gsum du bstan/ de las bcur dbye ba'o/ /dang po la bzhi ste/ thub pa gsum/ mi slob pa'i/ gtsang byed gsum/ legs spyad/ nyes spyad gsum/ lus kyi/ legs spyad gsum mo/ bzlog /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ mdor bstan/ de las/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /'di la gsum ste/ las lam dngos/ las lam gyi 'bras bu/ thams cad/ lus dang / log 'tsho logs su smos pa'i rgyu'o/ /dang po la drug ste/ rig byed yin min du dbye/ rtsa ba gsum gsum du bstan/ sbyor ba/ mthar 'byin sogs gsum du bstan/ mi dge ba'i las lam so so'i mtshan nyid/ las lam du dang sems pa lhan cig 'jug pa/ 'gro ba gang na las lam du yod pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ dngos gzhi'i/ mi dge nyer bsdogs/ sbyor ba'i/ mjug gi khyad par ro/ bzlog pa/ /gsum pa la gsum ste/ nyon mongs gang gis mthar 'byin pa/ gsod dang / gang gi gzhi gang yin pa/ gzhi ni/ snga dang / dngos gzhir 'gyur ba'i tshad do/ /bzhi pa la gsum ste/ mtshan nyid dngos/ las lam gyi sgra don/ 'di la/

log lta'i byed las so/ /dang po la gsum ste/ lus kyi/ ngag gi yid las kyi mtshan nyid do/ bsnab sems/ /dang po la gsum ste/ srog gcod/ srog gcod/ ma byin len/ ma byin/ 'dod log go bsgrod min/ /gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ rdzun/ phra ma/ phra ma/ tshig rtsub/ tshig rtsub/ nyon mongs/ kyal pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis ste/ las lam dngos/ rdzun tshig zhar byung mthong sogs mig rna/ dpyad pa'o/ /gsum pa log lta'i byed las la gsum ste/ chad ltas dge rtsa gcod/ med par/ chad pa'i ngo bo/ de ni/ mtshams ni/ chad pa mtshams sbyor tshul lo/ /lnga pa la gnyis te/ mi dge ba dang / mi dge dge ba du dang las lam lhan cig 'jug pa'o/ dge ba/ /drug pa la gnyis te/ 'gro ba gang na mi dge ba dang / dmyal ba/ dge ba du yod pa'o/ dge ba/ /gsum pa rgyu 'bras nyid kyi sgo nas dbye ba la gsum ste/ las gang 'bras bu gang dang ldan pa/ las gang rgyu gang gis byed pa/ rig min/ las 'phen rdzogs kyi khyad par ro/ gcig gis/ /dang po la gnyis te/ las gang 'bras bu du dang ldan/ phan tshun las 'bras du dang ldan pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ drir bcas/ spong lam du ldan/ spong lam min pa du dang ldan pa'o/ zag bcas/ /gnyis pa la lnga ste/ dge ba sogs/ dge ba'i/ 'das pa sogs/ 'das pa'i/ rang sa sogs/ rang gi slob pa sogs/ slob pa'i/ mthong bas/ mthong spang sogs du dang ldan pa'o/ /gnyis pa las so sor bshad pa la gsum ste/ spang bya sgrib pa gsum/ bsten bya bsod nams bya ba'i gzhi gsum/ cha mthun dge ba gsum bshad pa'o/ bsod nams/ /dang po la gsum ste/ mtshams med/ sgrib pa gsum gyi ngo bo/ /gang na sgrib pa gang yod pa/ mtshams med/ las sgrib bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /'di la gnyis te/ mtshams med bshad/

de dang nye ba bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ mtshams med dngos/ de'i las 'bras/ las 'bras kyi zhar byung ngo / 'jig rten/ /dang po la gsum ste/ dge 'dun gyi dbyen/ mtshams med kyi grangs nges/ phan 'dogs/ mtshams med gzhan gyi gzhi ngos bzung ba'o/ mtshan ni/ /dang po la bzhi ste/ gang zag gang la ldan pa/ 'khor lo'i dbyen bshad/ bskal pa/ las kyi/ las kyi dbyen bshad/ 'khor lo'i dbyen mi 'byung ba'i dus so/ dang po/ /dang po la gnyis te/ dbyen gang la ldan/ dge 'dun/ brdzun gang la ldan pa'o/ de yi/ /gnyis pa de'i las 'bras la gnyis te/ 'bras bu thob mi thob kyi khyad par/ mtshams med/ dge 'dun/ las lci yang gi khyad par ro/ /gnyis pa de dang nye ba bshad pa la gsum ste/ nye ba lnga'i ngo bo/ ma dgra/ zhar la las gsum gyi gegs su bstan pa/ bzod dang / yul gyi khyad par nges gnas bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /'di la gnyis te/ nges gnas spyi'i rnam gzhag bye brag ston pas sngon ji ltar mdzad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ dris te bstan/ gang nas/ de nyid bshad pa'o/ /'di la gsum ste/ ci tsam nas yon tan gang dang ldan/ bde 'gro/ de ni/ mtshan rnams smin pa'i tshul/ mtshan gyi rgyu'o/ re re la/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ rnam gzigs/ grangs med gang gi thog mar sangs rgyas gang byung tshul/ phar phyin gang dus gang la rdzogs pa'o/ kun la/ /gnyis pa bsten bya bsod nams bya ba'i gzhi la gsum ste/ thun mong gi nges tshig gsum po/ so so'i rang bzhin/ chos sbyin bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ chos sbyin/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ sbyin byung bshad/ gzhan gnyis bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ sbyin pa'i ngo bo/ gang gis/ dbye ba/ bdag gzhan/ khyad par ro/ /'di la gnyis te/ mdor bstan/ de yi/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/

/'di la gnyis te/ khyad par dngos/ de las 'phros pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ sbyin bdag gi sbyin bdag kha dog dngos po'i/ zhing gi khyad par ro/ /'di la gsum ste/ spyir bstan/ 'gro dang / sbyin pa'i mchog mchog ni/ zhing gi bye brag go 'phags pa/ gnyis pa la gsum ste/ lci yang gi khyad par/ mjug dang / bsags ma bsags kyi khyad par/ bsam bzhin/ log rtog dgag pa'o/ /'di la gnyis te/ len pa med kyang bsod nams 'byung ba/ mchod rten/ zhing ngan yang 'bras bu 'byung bar 'dod pa'o/ rgyu las/ /gnyis pa gzhan gnyis bstan pa la gsum ste/ so so'i rang bzhin/ gnyis ka'i 'bras bu/ mtho ris/ bskal par/ tshangs pa'i bsod nams so/ /dang po la gnyis te/ tshul khrims dang / 'chal ba'i/ sgom pa'o/ mnyam par/ /lnga pa phra rgyas bstan pa la gsum ste/ spang bya phra rgyas kyi rang bzhin/ spong byed gnyen po'i rang bzhin/ spangs pa'i 'bras bu yongs shes so/ /dang po la gnyis te/ mtshams sbyor ba'i sgo nas mdor bstan/ srid pa'i/ phra rgyas nyid gtan la dbab pa'o/ /'di la gsum ste/ phra rgyas kyi dbye ba/ phra rgyas kyi skye tshul/ rnam grangs sogs bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ ngo bo'i dbye ba/ rnam pa'i dbye ba/ sems nyon mongs pa dang bcas pa'i dbye ba'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ dbye ba dngos/ spang bya gnyis kyi nges pa/ lta ba dang nga rgyal bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po la bzhi ste/ rtsa ba'i sgo nas drug drug chags pa'i dbye bas bdun/ de drug lta ba'i dbye bas bcu/ lta ba/ de dag khams bcas grangs kyi sgo nas brgyad du dbye ba'o/ /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ mthong spang kho na yin pa/ srid rtse/ lhag skyes/ spang bya gnyis ka yin pa/ bsgom spang kho na yin pa'o/ bsgom pas/ /gsum pa la gnyis te/ lta ba'i dbye ba/

nga rgyal gyi dbye ba'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ lta ba lnga'i ngo bo/ bdag dang / mchog 'dzin gnyis pa la rtsod pa spong ba/ dbang phyug 'phros don phyin ci log gi rnam gzhag go lta ba/ /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ dbye ba dngos/ nga rgyal/ mthong dang / spang bya gang yin pa/ ma spangs kyang mngon du mi 'gyur ba'i khyad par ro/ 'phags pa/ /rnam pa'i dbye ba la lnga ste/ kun 'gro yin min gyi/ zag bcas zag med la dmigs pa'i/ gang gis rgyas par 'gyur ba'i/ mi dge ba dang lung ma bstan gyi rnam pa'i dbye ba/ dus gsum la phra rgyas gang ldan pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ skal ba mnyam pa'i/ sdug bsngal/ skal ba mi mnyam pa'i/ de las gzhan pa'i kun 'gro'i dbye ba'o/ de dag /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ mdor bstan/ 'gog dang / rgyas par bshad/ rang gi rtsod pa spang ba'o/ 'dod chags/ /gsum pa la gnyis te/ dmigs pas dang / phra rgyas/ mtshungs ldan gyis rgyas pa'o/ gang zhig /bzhi pa la gsum ste/ ngo bo'i dbye ba/ gong ma/ de dag gi rtsa ba'i dbye ba/ de las 'phros pa'o/ mgo gcig /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ mi dge ba'i dang / 'dod na/ lung ma bstan gyi rtsa ba'o/ /'di la gnyis te/ gsum du bstan pa/ lung ma/ bzhir bstan pa'o/ bzhi zhes/ /lnga pa la gsum ste/ ldan tshul dngos/ spangs pa ldan par bzhag tshul/ sdug bsngal/ chos gang la sems gang gi dmigs pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ rang gi mtshan nyid pa'i ldan tshul/ spyi'i mtshan nyid pa'i ldan tshul/ lhag ma/ ldan pa dus gsum dpyad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ dus gnyis kyi dang 'das dang / ma 'ongs pa'i ldan tshul lo/ yid kyi/ /gsum pa la gsum ste/ 'dod pa brjod/ de dgag de'i lan no/ chos nyid/ /dang po la gsum ste/ dam bca' dang rtags dgod/ dus rnams/ de yod/ yod smra'i dbye ba/

dbyig bshes kyi lugs 'thad pa'o/ gsum pa/ /gnyis pa de dgag pa la gnyis te/ gegs su/ gnod byed brjod/ sgrub byed dgag pa'o/ 'di la gzhung med/ /gsum pa chos gang la sems gang gis dmigs pa la gnyis te/ khams gsum gyi chos lnga la dang / zag med la sems gang gis dmigs pa'o/ zag med/ /dang po la gnyis te/ chos gsum la dang / dang po'i/ chos gnyis la sems gang gis dmigs pa'o/ 'gog dang / /gnyis pa phra rgyas kyi skye tshul la gnyis te/ skye ba'i rim pa/ rmongs las/ phra rgyas/ skye ba'i rgyu'o/ /gsum pa rnam grangs sogs bshad pa la gsum ste/ rnam grangs dngos/ de rnams gang dang mtshungs par ldan/ sgrib pa lnga 'dod khams par bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ zag pa sogs bzhir bstan/ kun sbyor sogs lngar bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ dbye ba dngos/ nges tshig go /dang po la gsum ste/ zag pa/ chu sbyor/ nyer len no/ /dang po la gsum ste/ 'dod pa'i zag pa/ 'dod na/ srid pa'i zag pa/ gzugs dang / rtsa ba/ ma rig pa'i zag pa'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ dngos dang / chu bo/ rtsod pa spong ba'o/ zag par/ /gsum pa la gnyis te/ dngos dang / ji skad/ ma rig rtsod pa spong ba'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ phra rgyas spyi'i dang / gang phyir/ de dag bye brag zag pa sogs kyi nges tshig go /gnyis pa kun sbyor sogs lngar bstan pa la gnyis te/ mdor bstan/ de dag rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /'di la bzhi ste/ kun sbyor/ 'ching ba/ tshor ba'i/ nyon mongs/ nye nyon/ kun dkris so/ /dang po la gnyis te/ kun sbyor dgur bstan/ cha mthun lngar bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ lta ba gsum dang / rdzas dang / gang phyir/ phrag dog ser sna kun sbyor du bzhag pa'i rgyu'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ tha ma'i dang / gong ma'i cha mthun lnga'o/ gong ma'i/

/dang po la gnyis te/ ngo bo byed las dang bcas pa/ tha ma'i/ sgo dang / kun sbyor gsum gyi rgyu mtshan no/ /bzhi pa kun dkris la gsum ste/ dngos kyi don/ zhar la dri ma bshad pa/ de'i khyad par bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ kun dkris sogs kyi dbye ba/ ngo tsha/ de nye nyon du bzhag pa'o/ 'dod chags/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ dri ma'i dbye ba/ gzhan yang / rgyu dang / de nye nyon du bzhag pa'o/ /gsum pa la gsum ste/ mthong spang dang sgom spang gi khyad par/ de las/ 'dod na/ mi dge ba dang lung ma bstan gyi khyad par/ khams dang sa'i khyad par ro/ 'dod dang / /gnyis pa de rnams gang dang mtshungs par ldan pa la gnyis te/ sa pa gnyis su dbye ba/ mthong spang / tshor ba gang dang mtshungs par ldan pa'o/ /'di la gnyis te/ rtsa nyon dang / nye nyon tshor ba gang dang mtshungs par ldan pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ 'dod pa'i sa dang / gong ma'i ldan tshul lo/ sa gang / /dang po la gnyis te/ so so gang dang ldan pa/ bde ba/ btang snyoms/ kun 'gro gang dang gang ldan pa'o/ /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ so so'i dang / 'gyod dang / btang snyoms/ kun gyi dang / sa mang bzhi'i ldan tshul lo/ bzhi po/ /gsum pa sgrib pa lnga 'dod khams par bstan pa la gnyis te/ dngos dang / 'dod na/ mi mthun/ grangs nges so/ /gnyis pa spong byed gnyen po'i rnam gzhag la lnga ste/ tshul ji ltar spang ba/ gnyen po/ spong byed gnyen po'i dbye ba/ gang las phye nas spong tshul/ dmigs pa/ mtshan nyid/ spangs pa thag bsring tshul/ spangs pa'i thob pa yang yang du bstan pa'o/ lan cig /dang po la gnyis te/ mthong spang dang / dmigs pa/ gnyen po/ sgom spang spong tshul lo/ /gsum pa spong ba'i 'bras bu yongs shes la lnga ste/ yongs shes kyi dbye ba/ gang gi 'bras bu gang yin pa/

grangs nges/ bral ba'i/ ldan tshul/ thob gtong ngo / la la/ /dang po la gnyis te/ mthong lam gyi drug dang / yongs su/ sgom lam gyi gsum du dbye ba'o/ yongs su/ /gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ mthong bsgom dang / drug bzod/ sa dang / mi lcog lam dang / thams cad/ shes pa gang gi 'bras bu gang yin pa'o/ rjes kyi/ /bzhi pa la gnyis te/ mi ldan pa'i/ gcig min/ ldan pa'i gang zag go /'di la gnyis te/ dngos dang / rtsod spang ngo / khams las/ /dang po la gnyis te/ mthong lam pa dang / mthong la/ bsgom la/ sgom lam pa la du ldan no/ /drug pa lam dang gang zag bstan pa la gsum ste/ bden pa mngon par rtogs pa'i lam/ bden pa mngon par rtogs pa'i gang zag bshad/ lam nyid kyi khyad chos bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ mtshams sbyar ba/ bden pa/ lam dngos so/ /'di la gsum ste/ lam gyi ngo bo/ sgom pa'i/ dmigs pa/ skye tshul lo/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ bden pa bzhi/ bden pa gnyis so/ gang la/ /dang po la gsum ste/ dbye ba/ bden pa/ rtogs pa'i go rim/ de ltar/ zag bcas sdug bsngal du bstan pa'o/ yid 'ong / /gsum pa skye tshul la gnyis te/ 'jug tshul mdor bstan/ sgom tshul rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ bya ba'i rim pa/ tshul gnas/ blo'i ngo bo'o/ thos sogs/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ rten snod du rung ba sgom pa po'i khyad par/ des bsgom bya'i lam gyi rim pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ mdor bstan/ bsring gnyis/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /'di la gnyis te/ gnyis ldan bkag mchog ming / bzlog pas blang ba'o/ /'di la gnyis te/ bzlog pa gnyen por bstan/ bzlog pa/ de 'phags rigs su bstan pa'o/ /'di la gnyis te/ dngos dang / 'phags rigs/ de'i khyad par dpyad pa'o/ /'di la gnyis te/ des don gang bstan pa/ gsum gyis/

de ltar bstan pa'i dgos pa'o/ sred pa/ /gnyis pa des bsgom bya'i lam gyi rim pa la gnyis te/ zhi gnas sgom tshul/ lhag mthong sgom tshul lo/ /dang po la gnyis te/ mdor bstan/ de la/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /'di la gnyis te/ mi sdug pa sgom pa/ dbugs 'byung rngub dran pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ mdor bstan/ keng rus/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /'di la gnyis te/ rnal 'byor bsgom tshul/ rus pa/ de nyid nges par bya ba'o/ mi sdug /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ thun mong du bstan/ dbugs rngub/ khyad par du bshad pa'o/ /'di la gsum ste/ sgom tshul gyi dbye ba/ bgrang las/ yul gyi ngo bo/ dbugs rdub/ 'og ma/ yul can gyi khyad par ro/ /gnyis pa lhag mthong sgom tshul la gsum ste/ tshogs lam gyi dang / sbyor lam gyi dang / bden pa rtogs pa'i lam gyi skye tshul lo/ mngon par/ /dang po la gnyis te/ mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ gang zag zhi gnas/ bsgom tshul lo/ lus tshor/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ thun mong gi bsgom tshul/ chos dran pa nyer bzhag gi sgom tshul lo/ de ni/ /dang po la gsum ste/ ngo bo/ shes rab/ rim ni/ go rim/ grangs nges so/ phyin ci/ /gnyis pa sbyor lam gyi skye tshul la bzhi ste/ skye tshul/ ngo bo/ bsgom byung / khyad par/ sngon 'gro'o/ de yi/ /dang po la gsum ste/ skye ba'i rim pa/ de las/ de phung po lngas bsdus pa/ thams cad/ don bsdu ba'o/ de ltar/ /gsum pa la lnga ste/ sa'i dang / mi lcogs/ rten gyi dang / 'dod rten/ thob gtong gi dang / 'phags pas/ yon tan gyi dang / rtse mo/ rigs kyi khyad par ro/ gnyis slob/ /gsum pa bden pa mngon par rtogs pa'i lam gyi skye tshul la lnga ste/ sems bcu drug gi skye tshul/ 'jig rten/
