gang zag log lta can gyi lus ngag yid kyi las ni mi 'dod pa dang mi sdug pa la sogs par 'gyur ro zhes pas kun 'gro'i rgyu dang / ched du bsam pa'i las bsam zhing bsags pa'i rnam smin zhes pas rnam smin gyi rgyu bstan pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ ci'i phyir rgyu drug tu grangs nges zhe na/ 'bras bu'i rigs la ltos nas thun mong gi rgyu dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyu gnyis las/ dang po ni byed rgyu/ gnyis pa la dus mnyam pa'i rgyu dang / dus tha dad pa'i rgyu gnyis las/ dang po la spyir lhan cig 'byung ba dang / bye brag mtshungs par ldan pa'i rgyu gnyis/ gnyis pa la 'dra bar skyed pa'i rgyu dang / mi 'dra bar skyed pa'i rgyu gnyis las/ dang po la spyir skal mnyam dang / bye brag kun tu 'gro ba'i rgyu gnyis/ phyi ma ni rnam smin gyi rgyu'o/ /lnga pa la drug po re re yang mtshan nyid dang / mtshan gzhi gnyis gnyis kyi sgo nas nges par bya ba las/ dang po byed rgyu la mtshan nyid ni/ 'dus byas kyi chos gzhan skye ba la gegs mi byed pa'am/ bya ba byed pa'i sgo nas rgyur bzhag tu rung ba/ mtshan gzhi la byed rgyu nus med dang nus bcas gnyis las/ dang po ni/ 'dus ma byas kyi chos thams cad 'dus byas kyi byed rgyu yin pa dang / 'dus byas la yang mi skye ba'i chos can rnams 'dus byas gzhan rnams kyi byed rgyu dang / skyes zin pa la yang bum pa snam bu'i byed rgyu yin pa sogs so/ /byed rgyu nus bcas ni mig dang gzugs la brten nas mig gi rnam shes skye ba sogs rgyu gzhan lnga po thams cad do/ /gnyis pa la mtshan nyid ni/ rang dang dus mnyam pa'i 'bras bu de dang phan tshun rgyu 'bras su 'gyur ba'o/ /mtshan gzhi ni tshogs pa gcig pa'i 'byung ba lta bu gzugs phung phan tshun dang / sems dang sems kyi rjes 'jug lta bu rnam par shes pa'i phung po dang /

phung po bar pa gsum phan tshun dang / mtshan gzhi 'dus byas dang / mtshan nyid skye sogs bzhi lta bu phung po lnga char dang / mi ldan pa'i 'du byed phan tshun rgyu 'bras su 'gyur ba gsum gsungs so/ /gsum pa la mtshan nyid ni/ rang gi 'bras bu phyi ma rang dang rigs 'dra bar bskyed pa'i rgyu'o/ /mtshan gzhi la zag bcas dang / zag med gnyis las/ dang po la rgyu 'bras rigs 'dra ba'i tshad/ rgyu 'bras gnyis ka yang dge ba dang / nyon mongs pa can dang / ma sgrib pa gsum po gang rung du 'dra ba ste de yang sa gcig pa'i spang bya ris lnga po gang rung du 'dra ba'o/ /de yang sa bon gyis myu gu bskyed pa dang / rnga dang dbyug gus rnga sgra bskyed pa dang / chus chu sgra bskyed pa sogs rgyu 'bras gnyis ka 'dod pa lta bu'i sa gcig gis bsdus pa'i sgom spangs su rigs 'dra bas skal mnyam gyi rgyur 'gyur ba'o/ /'di'i 'bras bu rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bur 'og 'bras bu'i skabs su bshad pas sgra la rgyu mthun las byung ba yod pa'i gnad kyang 'di nyid yin no/ /tshul 'di ma shes par ṭīk+ka gsar pa byed pa dag gis sgra la rgyun med pas rgyu mthun las byung ba mi 'thad ces rtsa ba sun 'byin par grag go /zag med kyi dbang du byas pa ni sa gcig pa mi dgos te/ zag med sa dgu la brten pa'i lam bden ni phan tshun skal mnyam gyi rgyur 'gyur ba yod pa'i phyir ro/ /'di la yang / mthong lam skad cig dang po rang gi rgyun phyi ma dang / bsgom lam dang mi slob pa'i lam gsum gyi skal mnyam gyi rgyu yin pa dang / de bzhin du bsgom lam gnyis kyi dang / mi slob lam gcig gi dang / de bzhin du dbang rtul gyi lam gnyis kyi dang / dbang rnon gyi lam gcig gi dang / dus sbyor dang po'i lam drug gi dang / mi g.yo ba'i chos can gyi lam gcig gi skal mnyam gyi rgyu yin pa sogs mnyam pa dang khyad par can gyi yin gyi dman pa'i skal mnyam gyi rgyu ni ma yin no/

/bzhi pa la mtshan nyid ni/ rang dang dus mnyam pa'i 'bras bu de dang phan tshun rgyu 'bras su 'gyur ba gang zhig mtshungs ldan yin pa/ mtshan gzhi ni/ dmigs pa dang / rnam pa dang / rdzas dang dus mtshungs pa tsam mtshungs ldan gyi rgyur 'jog na gang zag phan tshun gyi sems sems byung rnams kyang mtshungs ldan gyi rgyur 'gyur bas rten dbang po gcig la brten pa'i sems sems byung rnams so/ /lnga pa la mtshan nyid ni/ kun 'gro zhes bya ba'i nyon mongs can gang zhig rang 'bras rang sas bsdus pa'i nyon mongs can phyi ma bskyed pa ste/ gang zhig gis skal mnyam gyi rgyu gzhan rnams gcod/ rang sas bsdus pa'i nyon mongs can gyis rnam smin gyi rgyu gcod/ phyi ma zhes pas lhan cig 'byung ba dang mtshungs ldan gyi rgyu gcod do/ /mtshan gzhi la gang zhig gi don ni sdug bsngal mthong spang gi lta ba lnga/ kun 'byung mthong spang gi log lta dang / lta ba mthar 'dzin gnyis/ de gnyis kyi the tshom gnyis/ de dang mtshungs ldan dang / ma 'dres pa'i ma rig pa ris gnyis te bcu gcig go /de dag kyang rang dang dus mnyam la rgyu gnyis dang / phyi ma rnams la rnam smin gyi rgyur 'gyur ba yod kyang 'dir ni rang sas bsdus pa'i nyon mongs can phyi ma bskyed pa'i cha'o/ /de ltar na 'di dang skal mnyam gyi rgyu gnyis la mu bzhi las gnyis ka yin pa ni sngar gyi spang bya ris gnyis pa rang gi ris phyi ma bskyed pa'i cha'o/ /skal mnyam gyi rgyu yin la kun 'gro'i rgyu ma yin pa ni de las gzhan pa'i skal mnyam gyi rgyu rnams so/ /ldog pa ni sngar gyi spang bya ris gnyis po rang sas bsdus pa'i ris gzhan gyi nyon mongs can gyi rgyur 'gyur ba lta bu'o/ /gnyis ka min pa ni lhan cig 'byung ba dang / mtshungs ldan dang / rnam smin gyi rgyu lta bu'o/ /drug pa la mtshan nyid ni/ rang gi 'bras bu'i gtso bo rnam smin gyi phung po bskyed par byed pa'o/

/mtshan gzhi ni mi dge ba dang dge ba zag bcas kho na yin gyi lung ma bstan min te/ mthu chung ba'i phyir/ sa bon rul pa bzhin no/ /zag med ni ma yin te/ sred pa'i rlan dang bral ba'i phyir/ sa bon rlan dang bral ba bzhin no/ /'dus byas bral bcas 'bras bu yin/ /zhes pa'i skabs su 'bras bu'i mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ mtshan gzhi/ de las 'phros pa'i brgal lan dang bzhi las/ dang po ni/ rgyus bskyed par bya ba'am thob par bya ba'i ris su gnas pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ lnga ste/ rnam smin/ rgyu mthun/ bral ba/ skyes bu/ byed pa/ bdag po'i 'bras bu ste 'di dag la drug po gang gi 'bras bu gang yin pa dang / so so'i ngo bo rnams ni gzhung na gsal lo/ /gsum pa ni/ 'dus byas thams cad dang / so sor brtags 'gog go /bzhi pa ni/ 'dus ma byas gsum char rgyu dang bral ba'i 'bras bu yin kyang / 'dus ma byas la rgyu dang 'bras bu ni med de/ de la rgyu drug dang 'bras bu lnga mi srid pa'i phyir ro/ /gal te rgyu gzhan lnga med kyang byed rgyu ci phyir med ce na/ de yang med de/ byed rgyu'i don ni/ chos gzhan skye ba la gegs mi byed pa yin la/ 'dus ma byas la skye ba med pa'i phyir ro/ /des na lam bden yang bral ba'i byed rgyu ma yin no/ /'o na bral ba'i lam gyi 'bras bu ji ltar 'jog ce na lam gyi stobs kyis thob pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na thob pa'i rgyur 'gyur ro zhe na/ nus pa mi gcig ste/ lam gyis thob pa ni skyed par byed la/ bral ba ni thob par byed pa'i phyir ro/ /'bras bu gzhan bzhi po med kyang bdag po'i 'bras bu ci phyir med de/ 'dus ma byas chos gzhan gyi byed rgyur 'gyur ba'i phyir dang / bdag po'i 'bras bu dang po'i yin zhes bshad pas so zhe na/ chos gzhan gyi rgyur 'gyur yang 'di'i 'bras bu med de/ dus kyis ma bsdus pas 'bras bu 'dzin 'byin las grol ba'i phyir ro/

/des na/ sngon byung ma yin 'dus byas ni/ /'dus byas kho na bdag po'i 'bras/ /zhes pa yang legs par grub bo/ /mdor na lugs 'di la khyod chos de'i rgyu yin na/ chos de khyod kyi 'bras bu ma yin pa bud ces dang / khyod rgyu yin na/ khyod kyi 'bras bu med pa bud ces dang / khyod chos de'i 'bras bu yin na/ chos de khyod kyi rgyu ma yin par bud ces dang / khyod 'bras bu yin na khyod kyi rgyu med pa bud ces pa bzhi la khyab pa khas mi len pa ni gnad kyi don to/ /'dir mdo sde pas 'dus ma byas rgyu ma yin pa dang / rdzas su med pa dang / dngos po med pa'i lung rigs mang du bkod pa dang / bye brag tu smra bas de las bzlog pa'i brgal lan rnams ni 'grel par blta bar bya'o/ /'dod yid dge dang mi dge dang / /zhes pa'i skabs su/ de ma thag rkyen du 'gyur ba'i sems bcu gnyis su dbye ba/ tshe'am gnas skabs brgyad du dbye ba/ 'gyur tshul gcig la dper mtshon pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ spyir sems la 'dod pa'i bzhi/ khams gong ma gnyis kyi gsum gsum/ zag med gnyis te bcu gnyis su dbye ba ni gzhung na gsal lo/ /gnyis pa ni/ tshe'am gnas skabs brgyad shes par bya ste/ ris 'dra snga ma las phyi ma 'byung ba rgyun gyi tshe'am/ sa gcig pa'i ris mi 'dra ba dag kyang 'byung bas mtshungs pa'i tshe dang / khams gsum gyi sems las shi yang skyes sems nyon mongs can kho na 'byung ba nying mtshams sbyor ba'i tshe dang / khams gsum gang rung gi dge bas zag bcas zag med kyi mnyam gzhag la sbyor ba snyoms par 'jug pa'i tshe dang / mnyam gzhag de las langs pa na sngar gyi dge ba gsum po gang rung 'byung ba snyoms 'jug las ldang ba'i tshe dang / sa gong ma'i ting nge 'dzin sgom pa na gal te nyon mongs can du 'gyur na/ 'di las 'og ma'i dge ba'ang bla'i/ gong sa'i nyon mongs pa ni mi bla'o snyam nas/

'og sa'i dge bas ldang bar gyur cig ces 'phangs pa na 'og sa'i dge ba la gnas pa snyoms mjug nyon mongs can gyis gzir ba'i tshe dang / zag bcas kyi dge ba la 'dod gzugs kyi sprul sems lung ma bstan 'byung ba sprul pa la 'jug pa'i tshe dang / sprul pas sems de dag las langs pa na gzugs kyi dge ba kho na 'byung ba sprul pa las ldang ba'i tshe'o/ /gsum pa ni/ 'dod pa'i sems dge ba las mjug thog tu sems dgu 'byung ste/ rgyun gyi tshe rang sa'i dge ba dang / sa mtshungs pa'i tshe rang sa'i gzhan bzhi dang / nying mtshams sbyor ba'i tshe gong ma'i sgrib pa gnyis dang / dge ba sbyor byung la snyoms par 'jug pa'i tshe gzugs kyi dge ba dang zag med gnyis 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /gong ma'i ma bsgribs pa gnyis tshe brgyad po gang yang ma tshang bas mi 'byung ngo / /snyoms par 'jug pa'i tshe gzugs med kyi dge ba mi 'byung ngam snyam na/ rten dang / rnam pa dang / dmigs pa dang / gnyen po ste ring ba bzhi yis ring bas mi 'byung ngo / /de bzhin du gzhan rnams la'ang zhib tu sbyar bar bya'o/ /slob pa bzhi las zhes gsungs pas na lugs 'di la dgra bcom gyi 'bras bu las nyams pa yod pas mi slob pa'i sems kyi rjes su'ang slob pa 'byung ba ma yin nam snyam na/ de ni ma yin te/ 'dir ni de ma thag rkyen byed tshul 'chad pa'i skabs yin la/ 'bras bu las nyams pa'i tshe dang por mi slob pa'i zag med kyi rjes su rjes thob 'byung / de'i tshe nyon mongs mngon du gyur nas slob par 'gyur bas na shes pa rigs mi mthun gyis bar du chod pa'i phyir ro/ /de na slob pa bzhi'i rjes su 'byung zhing / mi slob pa ni bsgom lam tha ma'i rjes su zad pa shes pa 'byung bas lnga'i rjes su 'byung ba legs par grub bo/ /dbang po bstan pa'i gnas kyi dka' ba'i gnas rnams bshad zin to// ༈ //dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro dang /

/zhes pa'i skabs su shes par bya ba'i dngos po dang / shes par bya ba'i don gnyis las/ dang po ni/ bcud kyi 'jig rten no/ /gnyis pa ni/ bsod nams ma yin pas der khrid pas sam/ yi ge bsnan pa'i nges tshig gis na dgag tshig gi ra ri dga' ba/ ka ra byed pa ste dga' bar byed pa med pas na dmyal ba'o/ /slob dpon 'dus bzang ni sa ra ka ni ma rnyed pa'i don can yin pas skyabs mi rnyed cing med pas dmyal ba'o zhes gsungs so/ /mi ltar 'grengs te mi 'gro yi dud de 'gro bas dud 'gro'o/ /phyir mi ldog par song bas sam skam sar 'gro bas yi dwags so/ /yid shas che bas sam/ skye rgu'i bdag po shed kyi bu yin pas mi'o/ /rgyal po chen po bzhi'i ris su gtogs pas sam bzhi'i gnas na yod pas de'o/ /legs byas lhan cig byas pa rnams der skyes pas sam/ 'chi med mdzod kyi 'grel par/ dbang po 'dzin byed yang gzhan dang / /'jog po rgyas byed bstan bya dang / /cha can rnams gnas khyab 'jug dang / /'od chen bsgrod byed bshes gnyen nyid/ /ces pa nyi ma'i ming can bcu gnyis dang / gcig pur ma skyes 'ching byed dang / /'jog po drag po brtson 'grus ldan/ /'phrog byed nyid dang bde 'byung dang / /mig gsum gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ /dbang ldan dang ni sa gsum pa/ /drag po bcu gcig rnams su bshad/ /ces dang / yid rtsugs nges byed zla ba can/ /'dzin pa nyid dang rlung dang me/ /tho rangs dang ni rab gsal byed/ /ces pa de brgyad nor lhar bshad/ /ces pa dang / tha skar gyi bu gnyis te sum cu rtsa gsum yod pas de'o/ /la la ni byang chub dang / stobs mchog dang / dge ba sogs nor lha brgyad/ khyab 'jug dang / tshogs bdag dang / gshin rje dang / tsa ra dang / ma hā kā la dang / bhṛng gi ri ṭi dang / ka ra sogs drag po bcu gcig dang / dga' ba dang / nye dga' dang / dbang phyug dang / 'dod byed dang / 'od skyong dang /

thabs chen dang / seng ge dang / gang po dang / bde ba dang / shes chen dang / legs chen dang / lha mchog ni nyi ma bcu gnyis rnams su smra'o/ /lha dang lha min 'thab pa dang bral bas sam/ bsod nams kyis song bas sam/ lha mtshe mar brdzus te skye bas sam/ mel tshe thun re la bskul ba'i skad 'byung bas ya ma'o/ /chos kyi bde ba dang dga' ba lhag par che bas dga' ldan no/ /rang gi sprul pa'i longs spyod la dga' bar byed pas 'phrul dga' 'o/ /gzhan gyis sprul pa'i longs spyod la dbang bsgyur bas gzhan sprul dbang byed do/ /sa 'grel du sdig pa spong ba la spyod pa'i phyir sdig pa'i chos bsal bas na tshangs pa ste de'i ris su gtogs pas de'o/ /tshangs pa chen po'i mdun du 'dug ste tshig 'don pas de'o/ /tshe dang kha dog sogs tshangs pa gzhan pas che bas tshangs chen no/ /rang gi sa pa gong ma dag la ltos nas 'od chung bas 'od chung ngo / /tshad gzung bar mi nus pas tshad med 'od do/ /gnas gzhan kun snang bar byed pas 'od gsal lo/ /yid kyi sa pa'i bde ba la dge bar btags te de rang gi sa pa gong ma las chung ba yod pas dge chung ngo / /bde ba sa 'og ma las tshad gzung du med pa yod pas tshad med dge'o/ /bde ba cher rgyas pas dge rgyas so/ /sa gzhi sprin chags pa lta bu 'dabs chags pa med pas de'o/ /mi g.yo ba'i las las byung bas bsod nams skyes so/ /gnas gzhan dang 'brel ba'i byis pa kun las 'bras bu che bas 'bras bu che'o/ /tshogs drug gi 'khor gyi 'du shes rgyun bcad de gnas pas 'du shes med pa'o/ /so so'i skye bo dang ma 'dres pa'i gnas gtsang ma gong ma rnams las mi che bas de'o/ /ting nge 'dzin khyad par can thob pas nyon mongs pa'i gdung ba med pas mi gdung ba'o/ /rab tu zhi zhing mig sngar mdzes pas gya nom snang ngo / /mthong ba'am blta ba rnam par dag cing bzang bas shin tu mthong ngo / /gnas yod pa la 'di las chu zheng la sogs pa'i yon tan mchog gzhan med pas 'og min no/

/yang na gzugs kyi mtha' yin pas bsags mtha' 'o/ /snyoms 'jug gi sbyor ba'i dus su nam mkha' mtha' yas pa'o snyam pa'i rnam par byed cing lam de nyid skyed byed yin pas 'bras bu skye ba la'ang de zhes bya'o/ /de bzhin du rnam shes mtha' yas so snyam pa dang / ci yang med do snyam pa rnam par byed pas de dag go /'du shes ni 'bras dang zug rngu lta bu'o/ /'du shes med pa ni kun tu rmongs pa'o snyam nas 'du shes gzhan las 'byung bas de'o/ /gnyis pa shes par bya ba'i don la sar/ grangs dang gnas dang tshad rnams dang / /tshe yi tshad dang longs spyod dang / /skye ba dang ni lus rnams dang / /rgyu dang rkyen rnams rgya cher ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar brgyad las/ dang po grangs ni/ 'gro ba rigs drug gam/ rgyud dang / lam lnga ste/ der ni dmyal sogs 'gro ba lnga/ /rang gi ming gis bstan de rnams/ /nyon mongs can min lung bstan min/ /sems can zhes byar bar srid min/ /zhes so/ /lha ma yin ni lha'i 'gro bas bsdus par sar gsungs shing / don gsang du 'phen byed mi dge bas 'phangs par bshad pa ni brtag dgos la/ dran pa nyer gzhag gi mdor/ lha ma yin dud 'gro yin no zhes pa ni mi blun po la ba lang zhes 'thab pa ltar smad pa tsam mo/ /yang grul bum dang / sha za dang / 'byung po dang / srul po dang / lus srul po dang / smyo byed dang / brjed byed dang / skem byed dang / grib gnon dang / srin po dang / nam gru'i gdon dang / bya'i gdon dang / tshangs pa'i srin po rnams ni yi dwags su 'du ba yin pa bye brag tu rtogs byed chen mor 'chad cing / 'chi med mdzod du ni/ rig 'dzin lha yi smad 'tshong ma/ 'dir tshig bzhi mi tshang / ྎgnod sbyin dang / /srin po sha za mi 'am ci/ /sha za gsang ba grub pa dang / /'byung po lha yi skye gnas can/ /zhes kyang bshad do/ /bar do ni rigs drug tu ma 'dus par rgya mtsho sprin du'ang bshad cing /

gdags par yang srid pa bar ma ni 'gro ba lngas ma bsdus pa'o zhes bzhed do/ /lto 'phye chen po dud 'gro'o/ /gnyis pa la 'dod khams na gnas sum cu rtsa drug ste/ tsha dmyal brgyad/ grang dmyal brgyad/ yi dwags lha min rnams dang / gling bzhi gling phran brgyad/ 'dod lha drug rnams so/ /'dir ni/ dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro dang / /mi rnams dang ni lha drug dang / /'dod pa'i khams yin dmyal ba dang / /gling dbye ba las de nyi shu/ /zhes gsungs te/ dmyal ba brgyad dang gling bzhir dbye bas so/ /gzugs khams la gnas bco brgyad de/ gzhung gi bcu bdun dang / dbang phyug chen po'i gnas zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa' sa bcu pa la gnas pa kho na bzhugs pa'o/ /de nyid la 'og min chen po zhes kyang zer ro/ /nyi 'og bye brag tu smra ba bcu bdun du smra la/ kha che ba ni/ tshangs chen pa mdun na 'don gyi dgon pa lta bu yin pas na bcu drug tu smra'o/ /gzugs med khams ni gnas bzhi'am gnas med pa ste/ gzugs med khams na gnas med do/ /skye ba las ni rnam pa bzhi/ /zhes so/ /de nyid las dgu ste/ 'dod pa'i sa dang / gzugs khams bsam gtan sa bzhi dang / gzugs med sa bzhi'o/ /khams gsum gyis ni sa dgu ma bsdus te/ bsam gtan dang po nas ci yang med pa'i skye mched kyi bar la mthong lam sogs brten pa na sa bdun po de zag med du skyes pas so/ /des na bsdu bar/ dbang po kun shes pa gsum sogs khams gsum gyis ma bsdus shing sa yis bsdus par bshad do/ /sa dgu ni chags bral gyi rim pa dgu'o/ /gsum pa lus tshad la dngos dang / 'jal byed kyi tshad gnyis las/ dang po ni/ chos mngon par/ ngan song gsum gyi lus tshad nges pa med par bshad cing / rgyal ba'i yum du'ang dam pa'i chos spong ba dmyal bar skyes pa'i lus tshad bshad du mi rung bar bka' stsal to/ /bzang skyong gis zhus par dmyal ba 'ga' zhig ma gtogs pa la rang gi khru brgyad yod ces dang /

dran pa nyer gzhag tu mtshams med gcig byas pa'i mnar med kyi lus dpag tshad gcig nas lnga byas pa la dpag tshad lnga'i bar yod ces dang / mya ngan las 'das pa'i mdor/ mtshams med brgyad byas pa'i lus la dpag tshad brgyad khri yod kyang gcig la gcig mi thogs zhes dang / dkon mchog ta la'i mdor/ theg chen la skur ba btab pa'i dmyal ba'i lce la dpag tshad 'bum yod ces dang / nyi ma'i snying po'i mdor/ yi dwags chung ba la mtho gang dang / che ba la dpag tshad stong yod pa dang / dud 'gro chung ba la skra rtse'i lnga bcu'i cha dang / glang po rab brtan dang sa srung gi bu la mtha' skor du dpag tshad bdun dang / rgya mtshor gnas pa'i klu'i rgyal po rnams kyis de las lus ma 'phags par ro stod kyis sum cu rtsa gsum du phyin te thub pa la chos nyan zhes dang / las brgya par chu srin che ba la dpag tshad nyis stong bdun brgya yod ces dang / rnam par shes pa 'pho ba'i mdor/ klu dga' bo dang nye dga' bo'i lus kyis ri rab kyang g.yo zhing dbugs kyi dug gis rgya mtsho'ang btung du mi rung bar byed ces dang / lung gzhir/ klu gnyis kyis ri rab la lan gsum dkris par bka' stsal te/ klu'i lus rnams ni sprul pa yin pa yang srid do/ /'dzam bu gling pa'i mi lus res che zhing res chung yang rang gi khru phyed bzhi'o/ /'dzam bu gling pa rnams kyi tshad/ /khru bzhi pa dang phyed dang bzhi/ /shar dang ba lang spyod dang byang / /zhes bya phyi ma nyis 'gyur bskyed/ /ces te lus 'phags sogs kyang rang rang gi khru phyed dang bzhir gsungs so/ /bskal pa dang po'i mi 'ga' zhig ni brgya byin dang mnyam ste/ yab sras 'jal bar spyi bo skyes dang / brgya byin stan gcig la 'dug pa na mig 'byed 'dzum yod med ma gtogs pa khyad par med par bka' stsal bas so/ /sar/ lha ma yin rnams kyi lus dang tshe tshad sum cu rtsa gsum dang 'dra bar gsungs so/

/'dod dang ldan pa'i lha yi lus/ /bzhi cha nas ni rgyang grags ni/ /phyed dang gnyis kyi bar du bskyed/ /ces pa dga' ldan pa la rgyang grags te go sla'o/ /gzugs can dang po dpag tshad phyed/ /de yi gong ma phyed phyed bskyed/ /'od chung rnams kyi ltag yan chad/ /lus ni nyis 'gyur nyis 'gyur te/ /sprin med dpag tshad gsum dor ro/ /zhes te tshangs ris pa'i dpag tshad phyed dang / 'od chung ba'i gnyis dang / tshad med 'od pa'i bzhi nas dge rgyas pa'i drug cu rtsa bzhi dang / sprin med pa'i gsum dor bas brgya nyer lnga dang / 'og min pa'i khri drug stong gi bar ste bar pa rnams rang gi brtsis pas shes so/ /gzugs med na gzugs med pas lus tshad med do/ /de na'ang dge 'dun phal chen sde pa dang gos dmar can gyi sde pa gzugs phra ba yod par 'dod de/ de 'gog pa'i brgal lan ni mdzod 'grel du rgyas par bshad pas der blta'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ gzugs ming dus mtha' rdul yig dang / /skad cig phra rab rdul dang ni/ /rdul phran dang ni de bzhin du/ /lcags chu ri bong lug dang glang / /nyi zer rdul dang sro ma dang / /de las byung dang de bzhin nas/ /sor tshigs zhes bya gong bdun bsgyur/ /sor mo nyi shu bzhi la khru/ /khru bzhi la ni gzhu gang ngo / /de ni lnga brgya rnams la ni/ /rgyang grags de la dgon par 'dod/ /de brgyad dpag tshad ces bya'o/ /zhes pa la/ nyi zer gyi rdul bzhi bcu rtsa dgu la rdul phra rab bo zhes gsungs pa ni mi 'thad de/ de ni lug rdul yin pas so/ /lung rnam 'byed du snga phyi rnams drug 'gyur dang / gdags par rdul phran bdun la nyi zer gyi rdul du bshad pa'ang yod do/ /khru ni dang po chos mngon pa bshad dus tsam gyi mi yi khru yis brtsi'o zhes slob dpon rgyal po'i sras so/ /dus 'khor du gzhu nyis stong la rgyang grags dang / de bzhi la dpag tshad du bka' stsal to/

/bzhi pa tshe tshad la'ang gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sgra mi snyan na tshe stong ste/ /gnyis na phyed phyed spangs pa'o/ /'di na ma nges tha mar ni/ /lo bcu dang po dpag tu med/ /ba lang spyod pa'i lnga brgya dang / /lus 'phags nyis brgya lnga bcu'o/ /mi rnams tshe lo lnga bcu la/ /'dod pa yi ni lha rnams las/ /'og ma rnams kyi nyin zhag ste/ /de yi tshe lo lnga brgya'o/ /gong ma gnyis ka nyis 'gyur ro/ /zhes te/ nyin zhag de yis bgrangs pa'i zhag sum cu la zla ba dang / de bcu gnyis la lo gcig tu byed pa ste/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa sogs lnga'i rim pa bzhin mi lo brgya dang / nyis brgya dang / bzhi brgya dang / brgyad brgya dang / stong drug brgyas rang gi nyin zhag dang / des bgrangs pa'i rang rang gi lo stong nas khri drug stong bar tshe tshad do/ /yang sos la sogs drug rim bzhin/ /'dod lha'i tshe dang nyin zhag mnyam/ /des na de dag rnams kyi tshe/ /'dod pa'i lha dang 'dra ba yin/ /zhes pa ste/ rim pa bzhin grangs ni 'dra'o/ /mdzod 'grel du gnya' shing 'dzin yan chad na/ nyi zla med kyang nyin mtshan ni ku mud dang / pad+ma sogs me tog kha 'byed 'dzum dang / bya rnams skad 'byin mi 'byin dang / gnyid sangs pa dang bro ba las bzhag ste/ snang ba'i bya ba ni rang gi 'od kyis so/ /rab tu tsha phyed mnar med ni/ /bar gyi bskal pa'o dud 'gro rnams/ /mchog ring bskal pa'o yi dwags rnams/ /zla ba nyin zhag gis lnga brgya/ /zhes te/ mi'i zla bas nyin zhag byas pa'i lnga brgya ni/ bshes pa'i spring yig tu/ lnga stong dag dang khrir yang 'chir mi 'gyur/ /zhes pa dang don gcig go /grang dmyal rnams kyi tshe tshad/ sar/ tsha dmyal rnams kyi phyed phyed thub par gsungs la/ 'dir ni/ til rdzang nang nas lo brgya zhing / /zhes sogs gsungs so/ /nye 'khor ba dang nyi tshe ba'i sems can dmyal ba la ni tshe tshad ma nges par gsungs so/ /tshangs ris pas bar gyi bskal pa nyi shu dang /

mdun na 'don pas bzhi bcu dang / tshangs chen pas drug cu dang / 'od chung bas bskal pa chen po gnyis dang / tshad med 'od pas bzhi nas/ dge rgyas pas drug cu rtsa bzhi dang / sprin med pas brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga dang / 'og min pas khri drug stong thub pa'i bar te/ gzugs can nyin mtshan med tshe ni/ /rang lus gzhal ba'i bskal pa yis/ /'od chung nas bzung bskal chen te/ /de yi 'og ma phyed yin no/ /zhes so/ /gzugs med pa bzhis nyi khri dang / bzhi khri dang / drug khri dang / brgyad khri thub ste/ gzugs med bskal pa stong phrag ni/ /nyi shu lhag pas lhag pa yin/ /zhes so/ /tshe tshad ma rdzogs par 'chi ba ni/ sgra mi snyan ma gtogs par 'chi/ /zhes so/ /gzhan yang bar skabs su mi 'chi ba byang sems skye ba gcig gis thogs pa dang / srid pa tha ma pa dang / rgyal bas lung bstan pa dang / rgyal ba'i thad du btang ba'i pho nya dang / dad pa dang chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba dag dang / byang chub sems dpa' tha ma pa dang / 'khor los bsgyur ba dang / de dag mngal na yod pa'i yum sogs so/ /gnyis pa 'jal byed bshad pa ni/ 'dir/ skad cig ma brgya nyi shu la/ /zhes sogs gsungs so/ /skad cig gi tshad ni rnam 'grel las/ rdul gcig bsgres rdul chung ba yi/ /mthar thug dus ni skad cig 'dod/ /ces dang / mdzod 'grel du/ chos mngon pa ba rnams na re/ skyes bu stobs dang ldan pas se gol gtogs pa tsam gyis skad cig drug cu rtsa bzhi 'da' 'o zhes zer ro zhes pa ltar ro/ /zhag mi thub pa ni lo gcig la drug ste/ mdzod 'grel du/ dgun dang dpyid dang dbyar rnams kyi/ /zla ba phyed dang gnyis 'das nas/ /zla ba phyed ni lus pa na/ /mkhas pas zhag mi thub pa dor/ /zhes te/ dus de gsum la zla ba bzhi bzhi'o/ /thub pa'i dgongs rgyan du/ de nas rgyal ba can dang / dbo dang / sa ga dang / chu stod dang / khrums dang / smin drug can rnams kyi gnam stong chad pa na zhag nyer dgu zla ba'o/

/dgun ni smin drug can gyi nya nas rtsom mo/ /lnga pa la duḥkha dang bde ba dang kha zas dang 'khrig pa'i longs spyod ci rigs par te/ dmyal ba'i duḥkha ni/ lcags kyi sa bzhi 'bar ba me lces khyab pa lcags kyi rwa bas kun nas bskor ba na yang sos ni las las byung ba'i mtshon cha sna tshogs kyis dgra'i 'du shes kyis phan tshun btab pas brgyal te sa la 'gyel ba na nam mkha' las khyed rnams yang sos par gyur cig ces sgra 'byung ba'am/ rlung grang mo langs pas yang sos te/ snga ma lta bur yang yang las ma zad bar du myong ngo / /bskal pa 'jig dus kyi me bas yang sos kyi me tsha zhing de bas 'og ma 'og ma bzhi 'gyur gyi tsha bar bshad do/ /thig nag ni lus la dmyal srung gis thig cha bzhi'am/ brgyad dam du mar btab ste/ gshegs cing 'jog pa dang / bsdus 'joms pa gcig tu tshogs pa na dmyal srung gis lcags kyi ri ra'i gdong lta bu gnyis dang / lug dang / rta dang / glang po che dang / seng ge dang / stag gi gdong lta bu gnyis gnyis kyi bar du gtsags ma thag tu btsir bas sgo kun nas khrag rgyun 'bab pa dang / yang 'dus pa na lcags kyi 'khrul 'khor chen pos bud shing ltar 'tshir zhing khrag rgyun 'dzag pa dang / yang 'dus pa na lcags kyi pha bong gi char pas sa gzhi la ja jir du rdung ba na khrag rgyun 'bab pa'o/ /ngu 'bod pa gnas tshol ba na lcags kyi khang par zhugs pa der me btang ba 'bar zhing 'tshed de bsregs pas ngu zhing sdug skad 'byin pa'o/ /ngu 'bod chen po ba de dang 'dra ba las khang sbrum du 'dug pa'o/ /tsha ba pa lcags kyi phru ba dpag tshad du ma yod pa me 'bar ba'i nang du nya bzhin bsreg pa dang / lcags kyi gseg shing 'bar bas rkub nas phug pas spyi bor phyung zhing lus kyi bu ga rnams dang ba spu'i khung bu kun nas me 'bar ba dang / lcags bsregs kyi sa gzhi la lcags kyi tho ba 'bar bas brdung ba'o/ /rab tu tsha ba pa lcags kyi gsal shing rtse gsum pas rkub nas phug pa phrag pa gnyis dang spyi bor byung zhing bu ga rnams nas me lhab lhab 'bar ba dang /

lcags leb 'bar bas lus la kun tu 'khri ba dang / bshes pa'i spring yig tu/ kha cig lcags las byas pa'i zangs chen du/ /'bras kyi bcud 'phen bzhin du bskol zhing 'tshed/ /ces pa ste/ der keng rus tsam lus pa na srung mas sa la bkram pas sha lpags dang khrag slar skyes pa yang nang du 'jug pa'o/ /mnar med pa phyogs bzhi nas sa chen po me 'bar ba 'ong bas 'di'i lus mar me'i sdong bu ltar bsregs pa na me nyid kyi phung por snang zhing / sdug skad las sems can yod par shes pa tsam dang / lcags kyi zhib mar lcags kyi mdag ma 'bar bar 'khrab pa dang / lcags bsregs kyi ri chen po la 'bab 'dzeg byed du 'jug pa dang / kha nas lce phyung ste lcags phur brgyas brgyangs nas gnyer 'khum med par byed pa dang / sa la gan rkyal du bzhag ste kha lcags kyi 'byed spyad kyis phye nas lcags kyi tho lum me 'bar ba dang zangs bskol ba blugs pas kha dang lkog ma dang / nang khrol kun tshig ste ro smad nas phyir 'byung ba sogs las ma zad bar du myong ngo / /'di rnams kyi duḥkha 'ga' zhig yan man du yod par gsal lo/ /nye 'khor gyi gnas ni/ brgyad po kun las lhag bcu drug /de rnams kyi ni phyogs bzhi na/ /me ma mur dang ro myags dang / /spu gri'i lam sogs chu bo yin/ /zhes te/ brgyad po'i phyogs re re na me ma mur pus mo nub pa tsam la gnas tshol du 'gro ba na rkang pa 'degs 'jog gi sha skye 'jig byed pa dang / ro myag gi phyi sa'i 'dam dri nga ba 'bu mchu rnon gyis rus pa'i bar du 'bugs pa dang / spu gris gtams pa'i lam dang / ral gri lo ma'i nags tshal du grib ma la 'khod pa na ral gri lhung bas gcod cing 'gyel te khyi sre bo rnams kyis bshul sha gcod cing za ba dang / lcags kyi shing shal ma ri'i nags tsher ma rnon po sor bcu drug tu yan man kha lta ba la 'dzegs pa dang 'bab pa na lus 'bigs shing /

khwa lcags kyi mchu can gyis mig 'byin pa gsum mtshon char 'dra bas gcig tu byas pa dang / chu bo rab med 'gyur byed kyi chu khol bas gang ba la lhung ste/ ngos gnyis nas skye bu mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs pas bsrung zhing 'tshed la mchil pas phyungs nas sa la gan rkyal du bzhag ste/ ci 'dod dris pa na bdag gis mi shes mi mthong ste 'on kyang bkres so skom mo zer ba na thu lum dang zangs khu mnar med ltar bsnyod pa'o/ /'o na dmyal srung rnams sems can yin nam min zhe na/ sar sprul pa lta bu 'byung bar 'gyur ro zhes gsungs so/ /mdo sde pas/ las kyi mthus 'byung ba chen po sa sogs kyi bye brag tu 'dod cing / bye brag smra ba 'ga' zhig sems can du smra'o/ /de dag gi brgal lan rgyas pa nyi shu pa rtsa 'grel du blta ste/ gal te de yi las kyis der/ /'byung ba rnams ni 'byung ba dang / /de ltar 'gyur bar 'dod na go /rnam par shes pa cis mi 'dod/ /ces sogs so/ /grang dmyal ni nyi zla'i 'od kyi snang ba med pa'i mun khrod 'khyags pa'i srubs na grang bas nyen nas chu bur 'byung ba dang / chu bur brdol te 'khums pa dang / grang nas so tham tham pa dang / a chu zer ba dang / kyi hud zer ba dang / ut+pal ltar gas pa lpags pa sngon po kha lnga'am drug tu gas pa dang / pad+ma ltar gas pa dmar po kha bcu'am de las lhag par gas pa dang / pad+ma ltar gas pa chen po shin tu dmar ba kha brgya'am de las lhag par yang gas pa'o/ /nyi tshe ba ni rgyal po'i khab kyi ba glang gi shan par skyes pa khang pa brtsegs pa tsam nyan skad kyis ngu shing nam mkha' la 'ong ba dang / ba lang gi shan pa'i slob ma rus gong dri nga ba la bya rog sogs kyis 'thogs par skyes pa dang / bshes ma skyes pa thal gong dang kha sna la bya rogs sogs kyis 'thogs pa dang / nya ba skyes pa lus lcags kyis dkris pa dang / gzhal ba la sgyu byed pa rlig pa rdza ma tsam du gyur pa mdo sder gsungs pa'am/

dge 'dun srung gis rtogs pa brjod pa las bshad pa lta bu myong ngo / /de ltar dmyal ba la duḥkha dpag med de/ bshes pa'i spring yig tu/ 'di na nyin gcig mdung thung sum brgya yis/ /rab tu drag btab duḥkha gang yin pa/ /des ni dmyal ba'i duḥkha chung ngu la'ang / /'ol yang mi bgyi char yang mi phod do/ /zhes gsungs shing / rgyas par dam chos dran pa nyer bzhag sogs su blta'o/ /yi dwags la zas skom la phyi'i sgrib pa can ni bkres skom gyis nyen pas lus dang kha skom shing chu mig sogs su rgyug pa la mtshon cha thogs pas bsrung shing chu yang rnag khrag tu mthong ba'o/ /nang gi sgrib pa can ni de nyid du/ kha cig kha ni khab kyi mig tsam la/ /lto ba ri yi ltos tsam bkres pas nyen/ /mi gtsang gyi nar bor ba cung zad kyang / /'tshal ba'i mthu dang ldan pa ma lags so/ /zhes dang / kha cig lba ba smin ma'i rnag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang / zas skom nyid kyi sgrib pa can ni/ me lce'i phreng ba can zos 'thungs kun gyis 'tshigs pa dang / ljan ljin za ba bshang gci dang dri nga ba smad pa za nus la rang gi sha za zhing / zas bsod pa za mi nus pa'o/ /yang dran pa nyer bzhag tu bka' stsal pa/ lto gug kha khab ltar phra dang / /bshang za kun ston dri za dang / /chos za sbyin pa za ba dang / /chu 'thung bsam pas 'tsho ba dang / /mchil ma za dang phreng ba za/ /khrag za sha za bdug pa za/ /drag shul spyod dang glags lta dang / /sa 'og gnas dang mthu bo che/ /mtshan mo lus 'bar mi lpags lta/ /'dod gzugs gling bar gnas pa dang / /gshin rje dbyug pa byis pa za/ /tshangs srin 'bru yi shun pa za/ /mi gtsang za dang lam chen gnas/ /mang du za dang me mdag za/ /dug za dgon par gnas pa dang / /dur khrod gnas dang shing la gnas/ /lam gyi bzhi mdor gnas pa dang / /bdud kyi sde ste sum cu drug /ces pa so so'i gdung ba myong ngo / /dud 'gro che bas chung ba mid de za ba dang /

des che ba'i lus phug ste za ba dang / bya mchu can gyis ri dwags sogs za ba dang / klu rnams ni nyin re bzhin bye tshan gyis sha rus pa la thug par bsregs pa dang / mkha' lding gis za ba ste/ gsum la skyabs su 'gro bas de dag bzlog par bshad do/ /kha 'thor ba rnams ni rang dbang med par bsad pa dang / brdegs pa dang / bkol btsogs sogs kyis mnar ba ste/ bshes pa'i spring yig tu/ kha cig mu tig bal dang rus pa khrag /sha dang lpags pa'i ched du 'chi bar 'gyur/ /dbang med gzhan ni rdog pa lag pa dang / /lcag dang lcags kyus gdab pas btab ste bkol/ /zhes so/ /mi la bkres skom dang / tsha grang dang / 'dod pas phongs pa dang / sems can dang de ma yin pa'i gnod 'tshe dang / kha zas ngan pa dang / 'gro ba dang / tshol khro dang / ngal ba dang / thang nyal dang / mun pa sogs kyis sgrib pa dang / thang chad pa dang / skye ba sogs kyis mnar ro/ /'dod lha ni/ lus kyi kha dog mi sdug 'gyur ba dang / /stan la mi dga' me tog phreng rnying dang / /gos la dri ma chags dang lus las ni/ /sngon chad med pa'i rngul 'byung zhes bgyi ba/ /mtho ris 'chi 'pho sbron byed 'chi ltas lnga/ /zhes dang / nye ba'i 'chi ltas mdzod 'grel du rgyan dang gos la sgra mi snyan pa 'byung ba dang / 'od chung ba dang / khrus kyi chu thigs lus la chags pa dang / blo yul gcig la mi chags pa dang / mig 'byed 'dzum ste de lnga bzlog shing / snga ma lnga mi bzlog par bshad cing / de yis lha mo rnams lha gzhan dang dga' mgur spyod pa mthong bas gdung ba dang / lha mthu che ba chung bas mthong na spa bkong ba dang / 'og ma gnyis la lha ma yin dang 'thab pa na rtsod 'brel dang / mgo bcad pas bsad pa dang spyugs pas nyen to/ /de dag ni lha lha ma yin gyi bu mo 'dod pa dang / lha min lha'i bdud rtsi bzang po 'dod pas zhe 'gras te/ lha ma yin rnams ri rab kyi khong gseng nas gser/

dngul/ shel/ man shel/ bai ḍūr+ya'i mtshon thogs shing go cha gyon te chas pa na dmag gi ber gyis brgya byin gyi gdan 'gul bas dmag 'ong bar shes so/ /de rnams klu dang 'thab pas pham na rang gi gnas su ldog la/ dkar po'i klu rnams pham na chu mtshams nas 'thon nas rdzu 'phrul gyis nam mkha' la 'phags nas bang rim gyi lha sogs dang 'thab bo/ /dran pa nyer bzhag tu/ lha'i gnas mi gsal bar bya ba'i ched du sgra gcan gyis nyi zla lag pas sgrib cing / rgyal pham skye dgu'i bde sdug 'dzam bu gling pa'i dge sdig la rag las pa dang / zla ba'i mdor/ zla ba zin pa na dge ba 'bum 'gyur dang / nyi ma zin pa na dge ba bye 'gyur du bka' stsal to/ /lha pham na pho nya rgyu zhing song ste/ lha'i dbang po mkhyen par mdzod cig lha ma yin gyi dpung tshogs rgyal chen ris bzhi pas ma thub pas/ rtsa gsum pas bzlog par mdzod cig ces smras pas dbang pos gzhan rnams la bsgo'o/ /glang po che rab brtan yang dbang po'i bsam pa shes te der phyin nas lha rnams rtsub 'gyur gyi tshal du phyin pas 'thab par mos te ri rab kyi nub kyi steng du 'thab bo/ /dran pa nyer bzhag tu/ lha min rnams ri 'phen cing de kun dbang po'i rdo rjes bcom pa'i dum bu rol mtsho sogs su lhung bas srog chags du ma shi ste mtsho dmar por 'gro bar gsungs so/ /lha'i mgo dang rked pa chad na 'chi la yan lag bcad kyang skye ste duḥkha chen po 'byung ngo / /lha ma yin mi bzhin du gnad du phog na 'chi la/ de'ang gser gyi sa gzhi'i steng du mtsho kun snang la shi ba dang / rkang lag chad pa la sogs gzugs brnyan shar te dmag ma log pa'i gong du mya ngan byed par bshad do/ /gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mdor/ thags bzang ris kyi shing rta dpag tshad bdun brgya pa drag tu 'gro ba'ang dbang po'i lag pa g.yon pas 'dzin nus pa bka' stsal to/ /de dag su pham pa rang gi grong khyer du zhugs pas bde ste phan tshun mi tshugs so/

/khams gong ma dag re zhig duḥkha yi duḥkha las 'das kyang nyon mongs pa dang sgrib pa dang ldan cing / 'chi 'pho dang skye ba la rang dbang med pas gnas ngan len gyi duḥkha can te/ rgyud bla mar/ mi gtsang ba la dri zhim med bzhin 'gro lnga rnams la bde ba med/ /ces pa ltar ro/ /bde ba'i longs spyod la dmyal ba bzhin bde ba myong ba med do zhes gsungs pa ni/ bde ba rnam smin skyes kyi dbang du byas kyi rgyu mthun skyes yod ces kha cig gsungs la/ kha cig ni de ston pas dge slong dag reg pa'i skye mched drug zhes bya ba'i sems can dmyal ba yod de/ gang der skye ba ni shin tu duḥkha ba kho na nyams su myong bar 'gyur ro zhes bka' stsal pa de'i dbang du byas pa'o zhes smra'o/ /mdzod 'grel du ni mnar med na bde ba gtan med la/ gzhan du yang sos na rlung grang mos sos pa sogs yod pa dang rgyu mthun skyes yod pa'i lugs gnyis bshad do/ /yi dwags rdzu 'phrul che ba chos kyi rgyal po gshin rje dang / klu'i rgyal po la la la lha'i dpal lta bu'i bde ba yod cing rab brtan dang sa bsrungs kyi bu dang / rta rin po che la sogs la bde ba ci rigs pa yod do/ /mi'i 'jig rten na gdags par 'dzam bu'i gling na gser dngul nyo btsong byed cing shar na ras dang be'u ras dang / nub na ba glang dang / nor bu la ste/ byang na med do/ /'di na kha zas 'bras chan dang 'khur ba dang / zan dang / phye dang sha chang yod pa ltar shar nub na'ang yod cing / byang na ma rmos ma btab pa'i 'bras sā lu za'o/ /'di na char 'bab mkhas mi mkhas dang lo legs nyes dang mu ge dang mi dge ba dang 'jigs pa dang / tsha grang dang / nyo tshong dang / kha dog du ma dang khang pa ched du byas pa dang / bal gos dang / gos stan lji ba dang / bag ma gtong len dang / rje khol dang / de rnams la zhen pa yod pa ltar shar nub na'ang yod la byang na kha dog dkar po kho na dang /

ched du ma byas pa'i khang pa dang / dpag bsam gyi shing las byung ba'i gos srang gcig pa yod cing / gang la'ang yongs 'dzin med de/ bu tsha rnams kyang skyes ma thag mas 'dor zhing rang gi mthe bong las nu zho 'byung bar bshad do/ /gling bzhi ka na bkres skom dang / pho mo'i dbang po tha dad dang / pha ma dang / nyin mtshan dang / dus bzhi dang / bshang gci dang / zla mtshan dang / sbrum ma dang / bu btsa' ba yod do/ /de'ang dran pa nyer bzhag tu/ blun pos dge ba byas pas sgra mi snyan du skye/ /zhes dang / mya ngan las 'das pa'i mdor gzhan gyis mi 'dod bzhin du tshul khrims bsrung du bcug pa shar nub gnyis su skye bar bka' stsal to/ /mi'i nang na 'khor los sgyur ba'i bde ba ni mchog ste/ 'khor los bsgyur ba 'byung ba ni/ stong phrag brgyad cu las mi phyi/ de man chad du phun tshogs mi rdzogs pas tshe lo dpag med nas brgyad khri'i bar la 'byung ngo / /stobs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba ni de las phyis kyang yod do/ /de la rin po che sna bdun yod de/ sa 'grel du mdo drangs pa/ de la tshes bco lnga la ngo gdong dang bcas pa bkrus nas bsnyen gnas byas shing blon po'i tshogs kyis bskor te 'dug pa na/ shar phyogs nas lha'i 'khor lo brgya byin gyi tshig gis las thams cad pas byas pa rgyal po chen po bzhis rgyal po la bstan pa 'byung ngo zhes so/ /dran pa nyer bzhag tu gser las byas pa dpag tshad lnga brgya pa rtsibs stong yod pa mdzes pa nam mkha' la dpag tshad 'bum du nyi ma gcig gis 'gro ba gling bzhi dang / lha'i ris su glang po sogs kun mkha' la 'gro ba/ rgyal pos mi thob pa des thob par byed pa 'gran pa su yang med par byed pa'o/ /rgyal po shi nas sgo khang du zug nas sdod de bu la mi phan no/ /nor bu ni mi chen po'i brla tsam pa zur brgyad pa ste/ mtshan mo dpag tshad brgyar 'od 'byung ba/ nyi ma tsha na bsil ba 'byung ba/

skom na chu yan lag brgyad ldan 'byung ba/ rgyal pos ci bsam pa 'byung ba/ dpag tshad brgyar nad med par byed cing las kun la ji ltar 'dod pa'i 'bras bu 'byung ba/ klu ngan pas ser ba sogs 'bebs mi nus pa/ mya ngam dang g.yang sa'i yul kun ljon pa mtshe'u phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ba/ mi dus min du mi 'chi zhing / dud 'gro gang gis kyang mi gnod pa/ sbrul dang ne'u le lta bu'i mi mthun pas kyang mi gnod pa zhig dbang pos ster ro/ /btsun mo ni lus las tsan+dan dang / kha nas ut+pa la'i dri 'byung ba/ reg na nyon mongs pa med par 'gyur ba gling de'i bkres skom dang mya ngan bral bar byed pa/ rgyal pos mthong na grang dus dro zhing / dro dus su bsil bar byed pa/ mi kun gyis ma dang sring mo ltar mthong ba/ bsam pa dang mthun cing bu mang po btsas pa/ khyim thabs bud med gzhan la 'gro na phrag dog med pa'am/ khyim thabs med kyang 'dod yon lnga'i dbang du mi 'gyur ba zhig blon pos 'bul te/ de nas shi nas lhar skye'o/ /blon po ni bya ba rnams ma bslabs kyang shes nas byed pa/ mi dge ba spangs zhing nyon mongs pa med pa sems can kun la pha ma ltar phan pa'o/ /glang po ni cang shes shing bka' nyan pas pha rol las rgyal bar byed pa/ glang po che stong gi stobs yod pa/ chu dang skam dang bar snang gsum du g.yul 'gyed pa/ nyin gcig la 'dzam bu'i gling lan gsum 'khor ba/ skud pas kyang bkrir rung zhing rgyal pos zhon pa'i tshe bskul mi dgos pa/ dal gyis 'gro ba zhig dbang pos ster ro/ /sa 'grel du rab brtan gyi bu tha chung ngo zhes so/ /rta mchog ni ku mu ta dang / dung ltar dkar ba glang po dang stobs mtshungs pa zhig dbang pos ster ro/ /sa 'grel du rta'i rgyal po sprin gyi shugs can gyi bu tha chung lus sngo la mgo nag pa'o zhes so/ /khyim bdag ni mdzod gser dngul sogs kyis 'gengs zhing rgyal po'i bka' nyan pa skye bo kun la mi gnod pa'o zhes so/

/rgyal po'i sras ni khyim bdag ni mdzod kyi spyan dang / blon po ni dpung gi spyan lta bu'o zhes 'chad do/ /nye ba'i rin chen sna bdun yang / ral gri yang rgyal po dang 'gal ba byed 'dod pa der song ste ma btab kyang kun gyis 'dud pa'o/ /dmag dpon ni dgra'i tshogs ma lus pa 'joms pa'i nus pa yod kyang gzhan la mi 'tshe ba'i skyes bu'o/ /lpags pa ni chur dpag tshad bcu gnyis zheng du dpag tshad lnga pa/ char gyis mi brlan zhing rlung gis mi bskyod pa/ grang na dro zhing / dro na bsil bar byed do/ /bud med ni mi sdug pa mi mthong ba nyi ma zla ba'i 'od snang ba/ klu'i lpags pa rgya mtsho nas 'byung ba gang 'gro sar blon pos khyer te/ khang pa'i bya ba byed pa zhig ste tshangs pas 'bul lo/ /khang pa ni chur dpag tshad bcu gnyis/ zheng du dpag tshad bdun pa/ rin po che dang zla ba dang rgyu skar rnams blta bar 'dod na khang pa der 'ong ba/ rmi lam dge bar mthong ba/ grang na dro zhing tsha na bsil ba'i rlung ldang ba/ der lha mo 'ong nas rol mo byed pa'o/ /gos ni 'jam la dri mas mi gos pa gyon na tsha grang bkres skom ngal dub kyis mi gnod pa/ mes mi 'tshig cing mtshon gyis mi chod pa'o/ /tshal ni rgyal pos der phyin pa dang tshal gyi mthus lha'i bu mo dang bya sogs 'ong ste 'dod yon la spyod pa'o/ /mal cha ni bsam gtan byed na rnam par grol zhing blo gsal ba dang / kun nas nyon mongs mi skye ba'o/ /l+h+wam ni gyon na chu la mi 'bying ba yud tsam gyis dpag tshad brgyar 'gro ba la'ang ngal ba med pa'o/ /mi stong thub pa'i bu stong dang dgra zil gyis gnon pa'i mda' gzhu'ang 'byung ngo / /de'i khyad par ni/ gser dngul zangs lcags 'khor lo can/ /de rnams gling gcig gling gnyis dang / /gsum dang bzhi la mas rim bzhin/ /lhan cig gnyis min sangs rgyas bzhin/ /phas bsu rang 'gro g.yul bshams dang / /mtshon brtsams pas rgyal gnod pa med/

/ces bshad pa ste/ mtshon brtsams ni gzas pa'o/ /rgyal yang gsod pa med cing rgyal nas sems can rnams dge ba bcu la 'god pas de rnams nges par lhar skye'o/ /de rnams skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis kyang rgyal po gzhan las khyad par du 'phags te rin chen phreng bar/ 'khor los bsgyur ba thams cad la/ /'di rnams yod par 'dod mod kyi/ /dag dang mdzes dang gsal ba ni/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi char mi phod/ /ces so/ /gling 'di'i nye 'khor na 'khor los bsgyur ba'i lam gser gyi rang bzhin rgyal chen bzhi'i ris pa'i pus nub tsam rgya mtshor nub pa yod de/ de byung ba na chu skam mo/ /'di'i rgyu ni byams pa bsgom pa sogs te/ mdzangs blun du/ seng ge yi dam brtan pas rang nyid gsod pa'i mngon pa la byams pa bsgoms pas bskal pa 'bum du 'khor los bsgyur bar skye bar gsungs pa'o/ /'on kyang byis pa der skyes pa du kha phyi ma gnyis kyis gtses pa ste/ 'phags pas/ 'khor los bsgyur ba nyid du gyur nas kyang / /'khor ba na ni yang bran nyid du 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /'dod lha'i bde ba ni lha drug na gos srang phyed dang / srang bzhi cha dang / brgyad cha dang / bcu drug cha dang / sum cu rtsa gnyis cha dang / drug cu rtsa bzhi'i cha'o/ /rje khol dang bag ma btang len dang / pha ma dang pho mo'i dbang po dang / bkres skom dang / dus bzhi dang / nyin mtshan rnams yod la/ mu ge dang / nyo tshong dang / nad dang rga ba med cing / tsha grang ni dang po na yod kyi de las gong na med do/ /lus kyi phyi nang gtsang zhing rdul dang dri ma dang rus pa dang / nang khrol dang bshang gci med do/ /gser dngul shel bai ḍūr+ya las grub pa'i gzhal med khang dang ba gam dang bsil khang stegs bu dang skar khungs drwa ba can nyams dga' ba nor bu sna tshogs pas spras shing snang ba 'gyed pa mdzes pa yod do/ /bza' ba 'byung ba'i ljon shing dang /

de bzhin du btung ba sbrang rtsi dang sbrang chang 'byung ba'i dang / bzhon pa dang / gos 'byung ba'i dang / rgyan 'byung ba'i dang / dri bzang dang / bdug pa dang / me tog phreng ba 'byung ba'i dang / bzhad gad dang / gar dang / glu dang rol mo'i sgra 'byung ba'i dang / snod spyad yod byad sna tshogs 'byung ba'i ljon shing rnams yod do/ /yan lag brgyad ldan gyi chus gang ba'i rdzing bu dang / mtsho me tog sna tshogs dang bya sna tshogs kyis skad snyan 'byin pa can dang / dus dus su bag med las bskul bar byed pa'i rnga sgra dang / lam srang kun tu sil snyan dang / pheg rdob pa'i sgra sgrogs pa'i lha mo mdzes mas gang ba dang / sa la me tog man+da ra ba pus nub tsam gyis khebs pa'i rnying pa rnams rlung gis gtor zhing gsar pa rnams legs par 'grems te/ dran pa nyer bzhag tu/ lha rnams bsod nams dbang rkyen gyis/ /lha yi drung du rlung chen ldang / /me tog rnying pa 'dor byed cing / /me tog gsar pa legs par 'grems/ /zhes so/ /sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i brtsi tshul ni/ gdags pa dang / dkon mchog ta la'i gzungs su/ shing rta sna tshogs kyi tshal na glang po sa bsrung gi bu gzugs bzang shing mdzes pa dkar ba yan lag legs par gnas pa/ mgo dmar ba mche ba drug pa/ srid du dpag tshad gcig pa/ khor yug tu bdun yod pa 'khor glang po brgya stong dang ldan pa gnas te/ lha rnams skyed mos tshal du 'gro ba na/ des mgo sum cu rtsa gsum du sprul zhing / mgo re re la mche ba drug drug dang / de re re la rdzing bu bdun bdun dang / de re re la pad+ma'i sdong bu bdun re dang / pad+ma re re la lha mo bdun re dang de re re la g.yog mo bdun bdun dang / de re re la sil snyan khrol ba bdun bdun sprul te/ mgo dbus ma la dbang po dang / gzhan la nye dbang sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / glang po gzhan rnams la 'khor rnams zhon nas 'gro ba mi mngon pa lta bu mgyogs pas lha rnams drangs nas skyed mos tshal du skyel la/

de nas rdzu 'phrul de btang nas lhar sprul te 'dod pa la spyod par gsungs so/ /de bas kyang gong ma gong ma 'dod pa'i yon tan lhag cing / dga' ldan pa ni sa bcu'i dbang phyug gi drung na theg pa chen po'i chos la spyod pas lhag ste/ dran pa nyer bzhag gi tshig le'ur byas pa las/ thos pa mang dang chos 'dzin dang / /shes rab ldan cing thar par 'dod/ /yon tan rnams la dga' ba'i mi/ /de rnams dga' ldan nye bar 'gro/ /zhes bshad cing / nyi khri snang bar ni/ 'phags pa kho nar der skye bar gsungs so/ /khams gong ma'i bde ba ni mnyam par bzhag pa'i ste/ de'ang sar/ bsam gtan sa bzhi po btang snyoms dang / dran pa yongs su dag pa dang / zhi ba'i bde ba can mi g.yo ba myong ba dang / gzugs med pa zhi ba'i rnam par thar pa'i bde ba can myong ngo / /zhes gsungs so/ /kham zas kyi longs spyod ni dmyal ba na rlung rgyu ba'i kham zas phra bas gnas par sar gsungs shing / mdzod 'grel du ni thu lum dang zangs zhun dag gis bkres skom 'joms nus pas zas su nyi tshe ba'i sems can dmyal ba la kham zas mi dang 'dra bar yod par bshad do/ /dud 'gro yi dwags mi rnams kyi kham zas rags shing / mer mer po sogs kyi sems can dang / lha dang bar do dang / bskal pa dang po'i mi rnams kyi phra ba ste/ khams gong ma na med do/ /'khrig pa'i longs spyod ni/ dmyal ba kho nar duḥkha drag po rgyun du myong bas ye med do/ /dud 'gro dang yi dwags dang mi la yod cing khu ba'ang 'byung ngo / /'dod lha drug la/ gnyis gnyis 'khyud dang lag bcangs dang / /dgod dang blta bas 'khrig pa yin/ /khu ba 'byung ba med kyi/ mtshan gyi sgo nas rlung nyi tshe ba 'byung bas gdung ba dang bral lo/ /bye brag tu smra ba ni/ drug char gnyis kyi gnyis sprod kyang / /gdags par de skad 'byung ba ni/ /'khrig pa'i dus kyi tshad yin zhes smra'o/ /gling gsum dang yi dwags rdzu 'phrul che ba dang /

lha 'og ma bzhi la chung ma 'chang ba dang / bag ma btang len yod kyi/ sgra mi snyan dang gong ma gnyis na med cing / lha mo rnams la mngal gyi gnas med ces par ro/ /pha dang ma'i phrag pa'am pang par 'dod lha drug po byis pa lo lnga lon pa nas/ /lo bcu lon pa lta bu'i bar/ /de rnams su skye gzugs can rnams/ /kun rdzogs gos dang bcas pa nyid/ /ces te/ 'dod khams pa ni ngo tsha khrel yod shas chung bas gcer bur skye zhing / rgyal bu don grub dang / dge slong ma dkar mo dang / dge tshul ma snar ma ni gos dang bcas par ro/ /gzhan rnams lus myur du rdzogs shing / brgya byin lus rdzogs pa skye bas snga phyi brje ba'ang gzhan gyis mi tshor te/ shākya seng ge bzhugs dus kyi brgya byin ni ko'u shi ka zhes bya ba'o/ /lha kun kyang saṃ skṛ ta'i skad du smra'o/ /drug pa skye ba la/ 'dod pa skye ba gsum po ni/ /'dod pa'i lha dang mir bcas rnams/ /bde ba skye ba gsum po ni/ /bsam gtan gsum las sa bzhi dgu/ /zhes te/ mi dang lha dang po bzhi 'dod pa ji ltar skyes pa la longs spyod pa'i dang / 'phrul dga' ba 'dod pa rang gi sprul pa la dbang byed pa'i dang / gzhan sprul dbang bsgyur ba gzhan gyis sprul pa la'ang dbang byed pa'i skye ba ste/ bsam gtan dang po na dben pa las skyes pa'i bde ba can/ gnyis pa na ting nge 'dzin las skyes pa dang / gsum pa na dga' ba med pa'i bde ba can gyi skye ba'o/ /yang de nyid ni sgo nga las skyes sogs ni/ sems can skye gnas bzhi rnams so/ /mi dang dud 'gro rnam pa bzhi/ /dmyal ba rnams dang lha rnams dang / /srid pa bar mar brdzus te skye/ /yi dwags mngal nas skye ba'ang yin/ /zhes te/ mi sgong skyes ni khrung khrung mo las skyes pa brag dang / nye brag dang / ri dwags 'dzin gyi ma'i bu sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / rgyal po lnga len gyi bu lnga brgya lta bu'o/ /drod gsher skyes ni rgyal po gso sbyong 'phags kyi spyi bo las nga las nu dang /

de'i brla g.yas pa las mdzes pa dang / g.yon nas nyer mdzes skyes pa dang / rgyal po tshangs pas byin gyi brang gi sha 'bur ba las thi ba'i phreng can ma dang / a mra skyong ma chu shing gi sdong po las skyes pa lta bu'o/ /brdzus skyes ni bskal pa dang po rnams dang / slob dpon 'phags pa'i lha seng ga la'i gling gi rgyal po'i ldum rar pad+ma las skyes pa lta bu'o/ /dud 'gro rdzus skyes ni klu dang / mkha' lding sogs te gdags par mkha' lding brdzus skyes kyis klu bzhi ka dang / drod gsher skyes pas gsum dang / mngal skyes kyis gnyis dang / sgong skyes kyis sgong skyes kho na za bar bshad do/ /'o na brdzus skyes la ro med pas ji ltar za zhe na/ ma shes nas bza' ba'i ched du 'dren pa'am ma shi'i bar du za bas so/ /yi dwags ni brdzus skyes dang / mngal skyes kyang yod de/ lung du/ mau'u mgal gyi bu la yi dwags mos smras pa/ bdag gis mtshan mo bu lnga dang / /de bzhin nyin mo bu lnga rnams/ /bskyed nas de rnams za mod kyi/ /'on kyang bdag ni tshim pa med/ /ces so/ /bzhi las brdzus skyes bzang ngo / /'o na rgyal bu don grub mngal nas skyes pa ji ltar zhe na/ nye du'i 'brel bas shākya'i rigs chen po chos la gzud pa dang / 'di 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rigs so zhes gus pa bskyed du gzhug pa dang / mir gyur kyang grub pa 'di thob ces gdul bya spro ba bskyed pa dang / mu stegs rnams na re/ bskal pa brgya na sgyu ma mkhan gyi sgyu mas 'jig rten 'tsho'o zhes zer ba de lta bu dogs pa spongs ba'i ched du'o/ /bdun pa ni lus thob pa gang rang nyid kyi sems kyis 'chi yi gzhan gyi sems kyis min pa 'dod lha rtsed mos myos pa dang / yid 'khrugs par byed pa dang / gzhan gyi sems kyis 'pho yi rang gi yid ma yin pa ni mngal dang sgo nga na gnas pa rnams dang / gnyis ka yin pa 'dod pa na spyod pa gzhan phal cher dang /

gnyis min ni gzugs dang gzugs med pa dang / rgyal bas gtang ba'i pho nya dang / mthong lam pa dang / byams pa dang / nyon mongs pa med pa dang / 'gog pa dang 'du shes med pa'i snyoms 'jug dang / bar do dang 'khor los bsgyur ba dang rab tu byung ba sogs dang / sngar bar skabs su mi 'chi bar bshad pa rnams so/ /brgyad pa rgyu rkyen ni bshad zin 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /don tshan brgyad po 'di dag ni dpang lo chen po'i legs bshad ltar bris pa'o/ /de la snod kyi 'jig rten gyi zhes pa'i skabs su shes par bya ba'i don/ shes par bya ba'i dngos po gnyis/ dang po ni/ snod kyi 'jig rten gyi gnas tshul lo/ /gnyis pa la lnga ste/ gling bzhi pa dang / stong spyi phud dang / stong gnyis pa dang / stong gsum pa dang / phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten bshad pa'o/ /dang po la chags tshul dang / tshad dang bkod pa rnams ni gzhung nyid las shes par bya zhing / gnas bye brag tu bshad na/ 'dzam bu gling dang / rgyal chen ris bzhi pa'i gnas dang / sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i gnas dang / lha ma yin gyi gnas bye brag tu bshad pa bzhi las/ dang po ni/ 'di nas byang du ri nag po/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis ston te/ mchims kyis rdo rje gdan 'di nas zhes gsungs pa la phyi ma dag de ni legs sbyar dang mi mthun pas 'dzam bu gling 'di nas zhes 'chad dgos zhes gsungs kyang / 'dzam bu gling 'di nas zhes pa'i don mtshan gzhi bzung na/ ston pas chos mngon pa gsungs pa'i gnas rdo rje gdan 'di nas zhes pa las 'os med de/ lung pa 'di nas zhes smos kyang gong du smos pa'i de nyid la ngos bzung dgos pa bzhin no/ /de nas ri nag po dgu ni ba ri ba rin po che'i ri ma yin pa sa nag po zhes smos te/ kha dog nag po ma yin par bzhed la/ de ltar na ri bo gangs can dang / spos ngad ldang ba yang nag por 'chad par 'gyur bas kha dog nag po zhes ma hā bzhed do/

/de ltar dgu 'das pa'i pha rol na ri bo gangs can yod la/ de'i byang ngos na ri spos ngad ldan pa yod pa'i tshu rol na klu'i rgyal po ma dros pa'i gnas mtsho ma dros pa zhes bya ba yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i chus gang ba/ chu dang / zheng dang / zabs su dpag tshad lnga bcu yod pa/ mtha' nyis brgyas 'khor ba gru bzhi pa/ chu bo chen po bzhi 'bab pa yod de gdags pa las/ gaṅgā dang ni sin+dhu pak+ṣū dang / /sit+tā rba rlabs lbu ba'i phreng ba can/ /thams cad 'bab cing gsal ba'i chu yin te/ /phyogs bzhir 'khor ba 'khor yug dag nas 'byung / /gaṅgā shar phyogs rgya mtshor 'gro ba ste/ /sin+dhu lho phyogs rgya mtshor 'gro ba yin/ /pak+ṣū yang ni nub phyogs rgya mtshor 'gro/ /de yi byang phyogs rgya mtshor sit+tā 'gro/ /chu klung rab mchog bzhi po 'di dag ni/ /mchog tu bzang zhing yid 'ong 'bab pa ste/ /re re yang ni lnga brgya khyer nas ni/ /chu bo'i rgyun rnams rgya mtsho chen por 'gro/ /zhes dang / gaṅgā glang po'i kha nas shar/ /sin+dhū khyu mchog kha nas lhor/ /pak+ṣū rta yi kha nas nub/ /sit+tā seng ge'i kha nas byang / /dngul dang bai ḍūr shel gser gyi/ /bye ma 'dren cing 'bab pa yin/ /zhes so/ /de dag kyang chu bran lnga brgya dang bcas nas mtsho la bskor ba lan gsum byas nas phyi'i rgya mtshor 'bab par bshad la/ phal po cher ni lan bdun bdun bskor bar bshad do/ /de'i 'gram na shing 'dzam bu bṛk+ṣa zhes bya ba 'bras bu mngar po rdza ma tsam dang ldan pa de smin pa chur lhung ba las 'dzam bu zhes pa'i sgra dang / 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser dri ma med pa 'byung ste/ des mtshon pa'i gling la 'dzam bu'i gling zhes bya'o/ /sngon ser skya'i grong khyer na yang shing de yod de/ byang chub sems dpa' 'dzam bu'i grib ma la bsam gtan mdzad pas 'dzam bu'i grib mas khyab pa ma btang bar bshad do/ /mtsho ma dros pa'i byang ngos na brag gser gyi bya skyibs can zhes bya ba chu zheng du dpag tshad lnga bcu gyen du phyed dang bzhi pa g.yog lnga brgya dang bcas pa dang /

rdzing bu dal gyis 'bab pa zhes pa'i chu yan lag brgyad dang ldan pas gang ba de'i nang na pad+ma'i 'dab ma ba glang gi ko ba tsam/ sdong bu shol 'dab tsam/ me tog shing rta'i 'phang lo tsam ro sbrang rtsi lta bu skye ba rdzing g.yog lnga brgya dang ldan pa/ shing sā la'i rgyal po rab brtan zhes pa gzhu 'dom bzhi bcu thur du zug pa/ 'ob rim pa bdun gyi dang po dpag tshad bcu gsum nas tha ma bdun gyi bar du 'phags pa rnams yod pa/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin la glang po gnyis yod pa'i g.yul ngor spyad pa'i rab brtan ni lus me tog ku mu ta ltar dkar ba/ mgo bo nor bu chu shel ltar dmar ba mche ba drug dang ldan pa/ dpangs su dpag tshad phyed dang gnyis/ srid du phyed dang gsum/ zheng du gcig mthar bdun gyis 'khor ba yod de/ de rnams su dgun dang dpyid dang dbyar zla ba bzhi bzhir gnas shing / bla ma kha cig ni gsum gsum dang / gsum sum cu rtsa gsum du'o zhes gsungs te/ thob thang brtsis pa 'dra'o/ /gzhan yang gling 'di'i dbus su byang chub sems dpa' srid pa tha ma pas rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin skyed pa'i gnas rdo rje gdan gyi spo zhes pa me la sogs pas ma 'jig par mngon par grub pas gling gzhan du sangs rgyas mi 'byung ba dang / shar du ri bo rtse lnga zhes pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi gnas dang / lho ru ri bo gru 'dzin zhes pa sgrol ma'am spyan ras gzigs kyi gnas dang / nub tu u rgyan zhes pa rigs gsum mgon po'i gnas dang / dus 'khor ba ltar na byang du sham+bha la zhes pa rigs ldan gyi rgyal po'i gnas rnams yod do/ /gzhan yang gling 'dir tho dkar dang / rgya yul dang / hu lu na dang / skam po rtse dang / sha kha dang / sbal pa dang / khyi gdong dang / kri wa sha ri ka dang / gnam gdong dang / phyir phyogs gdong dang / bshog thog gcer bu dang / rgur te 'gro ba dang / sna med dang / klo kha kra la sogs pa yul chen po bcu drug dang /

yul phran stong phrag dang bcas pa dang grong khyer chen po drug gis brgyan pa'i yul dbus dang mtha' 'khob kyis rab tu phye ba'i mi rigs dang / skad rigs sna tshogs pa dang / lho phyogs na ri rgyal ma la ya zhes pa dug gsum shas che ba'i rtags su rtse mo na phug ron dang / rked pa na sbrul dang / rtsa ba na phag gnas pa dang / gzhan yang ri bya rkang dang / 'bigs byed dang / man+da ra ba la sogs pa du mas brgyan pa'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ ri la brten pa'i gnas dang / gzhal med khang la brten pa'i gnas so/ /dang po ni/ ri rab la bang rim bzhi yod pa'i dang po la lag na yol go thogs pa dang / khrag thogs pa dang / rtag myos dang / phreng thogs rnams gnas par sa las bshad la/ 'dir ni/ de la lag na gzhong thogs dang / /phreng thogs dang ni rtag myos dang / /rgyal chen bzhi pa'i lha rnams gnas/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de yang bang rim bzhi pa'i shar phyogs na yul 'khor srung gi pho brang yul 'khor srung dang / lhor 'phags skyes po'i pho brang 'phags par skyes pa dang / nub tu mig mi bzang gi pho brang sna tshogs gzugs dang / byang du rnam thos sras kyi pho brang lcang lo can te/ 'di na gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje bzhugs par gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mdo las gsungs so/ /sar ni ri gnya' shing 'dzin gyi ngos bzhi na yod par gsungs so/ /de rnams ni gdags par chu zhing du dpag tshad nyis brgya lnga bcu pa/ khor yug tu dpag tshad stong gis 'khor ba/ gru bzhi pa lam srang dang / skyed mos tshal dang / dpag bsam gyi shing / rdzing bu dang / gser gyi rwa ba dang / zam pa rgyun ma dang / gser gyi bye ma brdal ba dang / tsan+dan gyi chus chag chag btab pa dang / tshon sna brgya rtsa gcig gis mig mang ris su bris pa sogs khyad par can du ma bshad do/ /ri bdun dang lcags ri la yang de dag gi grong dang / grong rdal yod do/ /gnyis pa ni/ nyi ma dang /

zla ba dang / skar ma rnams te/ de dag la yang rgyal chen ris bzhi pa'i lha gnas shing / gzhan yang chu klung dang ljon shing dang / nags tshal dang / sa bla dang / nam mkha' dang / rgya mtsho rnams la yang de dang de yi lha gnas te/ mdzod 'grel du de nyid kyi phyir lha'i ris thams cad sas phye ba'o zhes gsungs pas so/ /gsum pa ni/ 'dir ni/ lhun po'i rtse na sum cu gsum/ /de yi ngos la brgyad khri'o/ /zhes sogs gsungs so/ /dbus na grong khyer blta na sdug 'dir ngos la nyis stong lnga brgya par gsungs shing / sar ni chu zheng du dpag tshad khri khri yod par gsungs so/ /gdags par de gser gyi rwa ba dang dpag tshad phyed gsum pas bskor ba/ rtsig skyabs gser/ dngul/ bai ḍūr+ya/ shel las byas pa/ mda' yab bzang po bzhi dang ldan pa/ sgo stong du gcig gis ma tshang ba/ sgo la dpangs su dpag tshad phyed dang gsum dang / zheng du phyed dang gnyis yod pa/ rin po che'i rgyan du mas spras pa/ sgo re re la yang srung ma go mtshon thogs pa lnga brgya lnga brgya yod pa/ lam srang zheng du dpag tshad bcu gnyis dang / ring bar nyis stong lnga brgya pas mdzes pa/ gser gyi bye ma brdal ba'o zhes bshad/ de'i dbus na brgya byin gyi pho brang rnam par rgyal byed ngos re la dpag tshad nyis brgya lnga bcu pa/ grong las dpag tshad phyed dang lngas gyen du 'phags pa/ rmang rin po che bzhi las byas pa/ them skas bzhi dang ldan pa/ ka ba bzhi gser/ dngul/ bai ḍūr+ya/ shel las byas pa/ ka rten dang / ka gzhu dang / bre phul dung la sogs pas byas pa/ ba gam brgya rtsa gcig pa/ ba gam re re la khang pa rtsegs pa bdun bdun/ de re re la khang mig bdun bdun/ de re re la lha mo bdun bdun/ de re re la g.yog mo bdun bdun/ de re re la sil snyan 'khrol ba bdun bdun yod pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol du tshal bzhi ni/ shing rta sna tshogs pa dang / rtsub 'gyur dang / 'dres pa'i tshal dang /

dga' bas brgyan pa bzhi yod la/ de'i phyi rol dpag tshad nyi shus bcad pa na sa gzhi bzang po tshal la 'gran pa lta bu dang / grong khyer gyi phyi'i byang shar mtshams na shing yongs 'dus sa brtol zhes bya ba dpag tshad lnga bcu thur du zug pa/ brgya gyen du 'phags pa/ yal ga dang 'dab mas brgyad cu'am lnga bcur khyab pa/ me tog gi dri rdzi phyogs su dpag tshad brgya dang / rdzi phyogs min par lnga bcu ldang ba'o/ /grong khyer de'i lho nub mtshams na chos bzang lha'i mdun sa yod la/ de'i 'dabs na ar mo ni ka lta bu'i rdo leb dkar po chu zheng du dpag tshad brgya dang / rngams su drug dang bco brgyad kyi cha yod pa/ dbus na brgya byin gyi seng ge'i khri dang / nye 'khor na nye dbang rnams kyi khri yod pa'o/ /bzhi pa lha ma yin gyi gnas ni ri rab chu la nub pa'i khong seng na yod de/ dran pa nyer gzhag las/ dpag tshad sum khri na 'od ldan gyi grong na sgra gcan dang / de nas bzhi stong na dkar phreng gi grong na mgu phreng dang / de nas bzhi stong na brtan pa'i grong na rab rnon dang / de nas bzhi stong na zab pa'am gser ldan gyi grong na thags bzang ris gnas so/ /de rnams dma' shos bzang zhing bzhi pa'i gser gyi sa gzhi la blta na sdug gi dod gser ldan dang / rnam rgyal gyi dod sdom pa can/ chos bzang gi dod nor bzang dang / yongs 'du'i dod tsi tra pa tra ba/ zla ba dkar po'i dod rdo leb bzang po dang / tshal bzhi ni/ shar sogs na kun dga' dang / rab dga' dang / dga' ba dang / kun dga' rwa ba'o/ /sa gzhi bzhi ni kun dga' can nas kun dga' rwa ba can gyi bar ro/ /glang po che rab brtan gyi dod bzod par dka' ba dang / sa srung gi bu'i dod ti se gangs brtsegs dang / rta sprin gyi shugs can gyi dod brag 'jings zhes bya ba'o/ /gnyis pa stong spyi phud ni/ gling bzhi pa dang nyi ma dang / /ri rab dang ni 'dod lha dang / /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten stong la ni/

/stong ni spyi phud yin par 'dod/ /ces gsungs shing / tshangs pa'i 'jig rten ni bsam gtan dang po'o zhes slob dpon rgyal po'i sras dang / a bh+ya 'chad la/ kha cig mi dge ba las tshangs pas na gzugs khams pa kun yin te/ phal po cher stong gsum la 'og min bye ba phrag brgya yod par bka' stsal pas so zhes gsungs/ dpang los de dag gdul bya'i bsam pa dang mthun pa'i mdo so so'i bshad par mngon no zhes bshad do/ /'di la chu dang rlung gis 'jig tshul dang bstun na phal po che'i mdo ltar dag gam snyam mo/ /gsum pa stong gnyis pa ni/ de stong la ni stong gnyis pa/ /bar ma'i 'jig rten khams yin no/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /bzhi pa stong gsum ni/ de stong la ni stong gsum mo/ /mnyam du 'jig cing 'byung ba yin/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'jig pa ni me la sogs pas 'jig pa'o/ /'byung ba ni snod bcud chags pa'o/ /stong gsum gyi 'jig rten khams la khor yug chen pos bskor bar mngon pa gong mar bshad do/ /lnga pa phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten bshad pa ni/ phyogs bcu'i zhing thams cad mnyam du 'jig cing chags pa ma yin te/ char gyi rgyun gnya' shing tsam babs pa na bar mtshams mi mngon pa bzhin/ phyogs bcu'i zhing la la chags pa dang / la la 'jig pa'i bar mtshams mi mngon par mngon pa gong mar gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'di la bye brag smra bas snod gcig gi steng 'og na snod med kyi thad kar mtha' med du gnas te/ mdor 'chags 'jig phyogs bzhir bar mtshams med par gsungs kyi/ steng 'og tu ma gsungs pa'i phyir ro zhes smra'o/ /phal po cher zhing rab 'byams de rnams ni nam mkha' dang / nor bu'i rgya mtsho dang / pad+ma'i rgya mtsho dang / sangs rgyas kyi sku'i byin pa la sogs pa la gnas shing / dbyibs ni zlum po dang / zur gsum dang / grub bzhi dang / nor bu dang / pad+ma dang / 'khor lo lta bu dang / zur brgyad pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi mtshan lta bur bshad do/

/sangs rgyas ri rab 'od yang dag par 'phags pa'i zhing yid rab tu dga' ba na 'dzam bu gling la dpag tshad bye ba dang / gling gzhan gsum la brgyad khri re yod par gsungs pa dang / da ltar gyi sangs rgyas mngon sum du bzhugs pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mdor/ 'das pa'i dus su sangs rgyas seng ge'i blo gros byon pa na 'dzam bu gling 'di la dpag tshad stong phrag drug cu rtsa brgyad yod pa dang / yab sras mjal bar/ rgyal po grags pa mtha' yas kyi dus su 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir ni rgyar dpag tshad khri brgyad stong par 'gyur zhes bka' stsal pa dang / mngon par dga' ba'i zhing na gser dngul gyi skas la 'dzegs nas sum cu rtsa gsum du 'gro ste mi rnams lha la mi smon cing / lha rnams 'dzam bu gling na sangs rgyas bzhugs so zhes smon par mi 'khrugs pa'i zhing gi bkod par 'byung ba sogs so/ /yang 'jam dpal gyi zhing gi bkod par sangs rgyas nor bu brtsegs pa'i zhing na nyi zla med par sangs rgyas kyi nor bus gsal bar byed pa bka' stsal pa dang / sangs rgyas kun tu bzang po'i zhing mig mi 'dzum pa na stong gsum ril po nyi zla zung gcig gis gsal bar byed ces 'byung ba dang / phal po che'i le'u dgu par/ zhing rnams la la 'od med de/ /bdun pa'i 'jigs pa shin tu che/ /reg na sdug bsngal spu gri 'dra/ /blta na mi bzad ci yang g.ya'/ /zhing rnams la la lha 'od can/ /la la khyim gyi 'od can te/ /la la nyi zla'i 'od dang ldan/ /zhing rnams la la rang gi 'od/ /shing gi 'od can dri ma med/ /la la ri bo'i 'od can ste/ /zhing rnams la la nor bu'i 'od/ /la la mar me'i 'od can ste/ /zhing rnams la la sangs rgyas 'od/ /zhing rnams la la pad+ma'i 'od/ /spos chu'i 'od dang ldan pa'ang yod/ /smon lam dbang gis rnam par sbyangs/ /zhes dang / yang rgyan gyi khyad par yang / zhing gi rgyan mangs bye ba yis/ /zhing rnams la la rnam par bris/

/rgyan dang tshul rnams tha dad par/ /sna tshogs mig g.yor lta bur snang / /zhes dang / yang sangs rgyas yod med kyi khyad par yang / zhing rnams la lar sangs rgyas med/ /zhing rnams la lar sangs rgyas bcas/ /la la'i zhing na sangs rgyas gcig /la lar sangs rgyas mang po'o/ /zhes dang / yang gnas pa'i yun yang / zhing rnams la la bskal pa tsam/ /la la bskal pa bcu pa ste/ /zhing rnams la la rdul mnyam pa'i/ /bskal pa bye bar brjod pa yin/ /zhes bka' stsal to/ /yang 'jig rten gyi khams thad ka ba 'di lta bu dang / snrel zhi la sogs la rkang pa btsugs pa dang / spyi'u gtsugs su 'gro ba gsum du 'chad de/ phyi ma gnyis ni sa bcu pa'i 'grel par/ 'chol ba go rim du mi gnas pa dang / steng g.yogs med par khyim gnas pa ma byas par bkral lo/ /nam phyed nyi ma nub pa dang / /nyi ma phyed dang 'char dus gcig /ces pa'i skabs su/ dus bzhi 'chol ba'i lugs/ dus bzhi gcig char ba'i lugs/ 'thad pa'i phyogs ngos bzung ba dang gsum las/ dang po la bzhi ste/ 'chol ba'i lugs brjod/ gzhung nas bstan pa'i dus bzhi gang la 'byung ngos bzung ba/ nyi ma myur bul gyi rgyu mtshan/ nyi mas gling du la bya ba byed ngos bzung ba'o/ /dang po ni/ sngon gyi mkhas pa kha cig na re/ 'dzam bu gling du dgun nyi thung ba mthar thug pa'i tshe byang sgra mi snyan du dbyar nyi ring ba mthar thug pa dang / shar lus 'phags gling du dpyid nyin mnyam mtshan mnyam dang / nub ba glang longs spyod du ston nyin mnyam mtshan mnyam 'byung ngo / /de'i tshe 'dzam bu gling du nyin mo la yud tsam bcu gnyis/ mtshan mo la yud tsam bco brgyad/ byang du de las ldog pa 'byung zhing / shar gyi snga dro la yud tsam dgu 'byung ste/ byang gi phyi dro la yud tsam dgu yod pa gang zhig de gnyis nyi ma'i bgrod pa gcig pa'i phyir ro/ /shar gyi phyi dro la yud tsam drug 'byung ste/ lho'i snga dro la yud tsam drug 'byung ba gang zhig

de gnyis nyi ma'i bgrod pa gcig pa'i phyir/ de'i tshe nub kyi snga dro la yud tsam drug 'byung ste/ lho'i phyi dro la yud tsam drug 'byung ba gang zhig de gnyis nyi ma'i bgrod pa gcig pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas zla ba gsum song ba na 'dzam bu'i gling du dpyid nyin mtshan mnyam pa dang / nub tu dgun nyi thung ba'i mthar thug dang / byang du ston nyin mnyam mtshan mnyam dang / shar du dbyar nyi ring ba'i mthar thug pa 'byung la de nas zla ba gsum song ba na 'dzam bu gling du dbyar nyi ring ba'i mthar thug pa dang / gzhan rnams des 'gre/ de nas zla ba gsum song ba na 'dzam bu'i gling du ston nyin mnyam mtshan mnyam dang / gzhan rnams des 'gre ste/ de rnams gling gang rung gcig gis lo gcig la 'khor ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ lugs 'di la 'dzam bu'i gling du nam phyed pa dang / nub tu nyi ma nub pa dang / byang du nyi ma phyed pa dang / shar du nyi ma shar ba rnams dus gcig pa zhag re bzhin du 'byung bas khyab bo/ /gsum pa ni/ 'o na nyi ma gling gi dkyil gyi thad kyi nam mkhar 'gro ba'i tshe lam thung yang 'gro ba bul ba dang / gling gi phyi rol rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i tshe lam ring yang bgrod pa myur ba'i rgyu mtshan ci zhe na/ rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i tshe rang 'dren byed kyi rlung gi steng du lcags ri kha'i rlung bsnan pas shin tu myur la/ de nas ri rab la thag nyer song ba'i tshe lcags ri kha'i rlung dang je 'gyang du song bas bgrod pa je bul du song la/ byang bgrod mthar thug pa'i tshe rang 'dren byed kyi rlung kho nas 'dren pas shin tu bul bar sngon gyi mkhas pa dag bzhed do/ /bzhi pa ni/ lugs 'di la nyi mas gling gnyis ni snang bar byed pa dang / gling gnyis ni mun par byed pa rgyun du 'byung ngo / /gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ cig char ba'i lugs brjod/ gzhung nas bstan pa'i dus bzhi gang nas 'byung ngos bzung / nyi ma myur bul gyi rgyu mtshan/

nyi mas gling du la bya ba byed bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ mkhas pa kha cig gling bzhi char du dgun dgun mnyam/ dpyid dpyid mnyam/ dbyar dbyar mnyam/ ston ston mnyam 'byung ngo / /gnyis pa ni/ gling bzhi la nam phyed nyi ma nub pa dang / nyi ma phyed dang 'char dus gcig pa/ ston nyin mnyam mtshan mnyam gyi dus nyin zhag gcig dang / dpyid nyin mnyam mtshan mnyam gyi dus nyin zhag gcig kho na la 'byung gi gzhan rnams la mi 'byung ngo / /gsum pa ni snga ma dang 'dra'o/ /bzhi pa ni nyi zlas gling gcig kho na la bya ba byed pa'i dus yod de/ dgun nyi thung ba mthar thug pa'i tshe gling gang rung gcig gi nyin phyed kyi dus su gling de kho na la bya ba byed pa'i phyir te/ gling gcig shos nas nyi ma nub nas yud tsam gsum song / gcig shos su nyi ma shar ba la yud tsam gsum lus pas de la bya ba mi byed pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas yud tsam gsum song ba na mdun phyogs kyi gling la nyi ma shar bas gling gnyis la bya ba byed cing / de nas yud tsam drug song ba na mdun phyogs kyi gling du nyi ma phyed pa'i tshe gling de kho na la bya ba byed pa'i tshul ni sngar bzhin no/ /yang nyi mas gling gnyis kho na la bya ba byed pa yod de/ ston dpyid kyi nyin mnyam mtshan mnyam gyi dus kyi zhag gnyis po de la gling gnyis kho na la bya ba byed pa'o/ /nyi mas gling gsum la bya ba byed pa yang yod de/ dbyar nyi ring ba mthar thug pa'i tshe/ gling gang rung gcig gis nyin phyed kyi dus su/ gling gcig shos nas nyi ma nub pa la yud tsam gyi gsum lus/ mdun phyogs kyi gling du nyi ma shar nas/ yud tsam gsum song ba'i phyir ro/ /lugs 'di la gling gang rung gcig gi dkyil du nyi ma yod pa'i tshe nyi ma'i 'od zer gyi mtha' zad ma zad kyi sgo nas nyi ma 'char nub 'jog pa yin gyi sgrib byed yod med kyi sgo nas 'char nub 'jog pa ma yin te/

thang chen po'i dkyil du mar me bzhag pa bzhin no zhes zer ro/ /gsum pa ni/ lugs de gnyis las gang zhig 'thad ce na/ lugs dang po la skyon 'di ltar gnas te/ 'dzam bu gling du dpyid nyin mnyam mtshan mnyam gyi dus kyi nyi ma 'char kha'i thad kyi nam mkha' de chos can/ khyod las nyi ma byang du cung zad kyang bgrod du med par thal/ khyod shar lus 'phags gling gi nyi ma byang bgrod mthar thug pa'i nyi ma gnas pa'i nam mkha' yin pa'i phyir/ rtags khas blangs te/ dus bzhi 'chol ba dang / nam phyed sogs bzhi po dus gcig pa rgyun du 'byung bar khas blangs pas so/ /rtsa bar 'dod na/ de nas bzung ste dbyar nyi ring ba mthar thug pa'i bar zla ba gsum du shar phyogs kyi nyi ma yang byang bgrod du 'gro ba mngon sum du mthong bas bsal lo/ /de bzhin du 'dzam bu gling du ston nyin mnyam mtshan mnyam gyi dus kyi nyi ma 'char ba'i tshe nyi ma gnas pa'i nam mkha' chos can/ khyod las nyi ma lhor cung zad kyang bgrod du med par thal/ khyod shar lus 'phags gling du nyi ma lho bgrod mthar thug pa'i dus kyi nyi ma gnas pa'i nam mkha' yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na de nas zla ba gsum gyi bar shar phyogs kyi nyi ma lho bgrod du 'gro bar mngon sum gyis mthong bas gsal lo/ /skyon 'di dag nyin phyed kyi dus la sogs pa gang la sbyar kyang 'dra'o/ /mdor na ston dpyid kyi nyin mnyam mtshan mnyam nas zla ba gsum gyi bar nyi ma 'char sa dang gnas pa'i nyi ma lho bgrod dang byang bgrod so sor 'byung na lugs 'di 'thad kyang de mi srid pas 'di mi 'thad pa kho na'o/ /des na lugs phyi ma de nyid 'thad par mthong ste/ nyi zla'i mtho dman ni gser ri dang po dang mnyam zhing / 'char sa ni gser ri bdun char brgal nas phyi'i rgya mtsho'i dkyil du gling dkyil phan chad du 'char bas nyi ma'i 'od zer gyi nus pa ma zad na gling gsum char gsal ba la sgrib byed cung zad kyang med pa'i phyir ro/

/phyogs 'di la'ang dbyar nyi ring ba mthar thug pa'i tshe/ nyin zhag gcig la yud tsam sum cu so drug yod par thal/ de'i tshe 'dzam bu gling gi nyin bar la yud tsam bco brgyad yod pa gang zhig byang sgra mi snyan gyi nyin bar la yang yud tsam bco brgyad yod pa de 'dzam bu gling gi mtshan mor bya dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes pa 'di gnod byed du 'jug go snyam na/ gtan tshigs phyi ma ma grub ste/ de'i tshe 'dzam bu'i gling du nyi ma 'char ba'i tshe byang sgra mi snyan du nyi ma nub pa la yud tsam gsum lus pa'i phyir dang / 'dzam bu'i gling du nyi ma nub pa'i tshe sgra mi snyan du nyi ma shar nas yud tsam gsum song ba de'i nyin mo lho'i 'dzam bu gling pa'i mtshan mo dang mi mnyam pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du lho bgrod mthar thug pa'i tshe nyin zhag gcig la yud tsam nyi shu rtsa bzhi las med par thal ba yang 'di nyid kyis gsal te/ nam phyed nyi ma nub pa dang / nyi ma phyed dang 'char dus gcig pa lo gcig la nyin zhag gnyis las med pa'i gnad 'di shes na thams cad rang grol du 'gyur ro/ /gzhung 'og ma dang yang 'di nyid 'brel te 'og tu bshad par bya'o/ /dbyar gyi zla ba gnyis pa yi zhes pa'i skabs su thun mong du mkho ba tha snyad kyi rnam gzhag de la brten nas dus tshigs kyi rnam gzhag bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ mgo dang rgyal dang mchu ni dgun/ /dbo dang nag pa sa ga dpyid/ /snron dang chu stod gro bzhin dbyar/ /khrum dang tha skar smin drug ston/ /zhes pa 'di rnams ni nya skar yin la/ zla bshol 'byung ba la nye ba'i tshe 'di la 'bab pa'i nges pa ni med do/ /tha skar bra nye smin drug dang / /snar ma mgo lag nam so rgyal/ /skag mchu gre dbo me bzhi dang / /nag pa sa ri sa ga dang / /lha mtshams snon snub chu stod smad/ /gro bzhin mon gre mon gru dang / /khrum stod khrum smad nam gru rnams/ /rgyu skar nyi shu bdun du 'dod/

/ces pa ste/ mgo dang rgyal gyi bar du lag dang nam so gnyis/ gro bzhin dang khrum stod kyi bar du mon gre dang mon gru gnyis/ khrum stod dang tha skar gyi bar du khrum smad dang nam gru gnyis/ gzhan rnams kyi bar du re re spel bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa la lnga ste/ dus tshigs kyi rab dbye/ de ltar phye ba'i dgos pa/ dus 'go gang nas 'dzin pa/ gso sbyong bcu bzhi pa gang la 'byung ba/ zla ba shol 'dor ba rgyu mtshan dang bcas pa'o/ /dang po la bzhi/ gsum dang / bzhi dang / lnga dang / drug tu dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ dgun gyi dus/ dpyid kyi dus/ dbyar gyi dus gsum du byas nas de re re la zla ba bzhi bzhir byed pa ni sangs rgyas pa'i lugs thun mong ma yin pa yin te/ 'dir yang / dbyar gyi zla ba gnyis pa yi/ /tha ma'i tshes dgu nas mtshan ring / /dgun rnams kyi ni bzhi pa la/ /thung du 'gyur ro nyin mo bzlog /ces dang / tshig ler/ kha ba sos ka dbyar rnams kyi/ /zla ba gnyis dang bzhi yi nyin/ /zhes dang / rgyal po'i sras su gsung rab las ni dus gsum kho na yin gyi 'jig rten pa'i lta bur drug ni ma yin te/ dgun stod ni grang bar 'dra ba'i phyir dgun du bshad do/ /sos ka ni tsha bar 'dra ba'i phyir dpyid du bshad do/ /ston smad ni char pa 'bab tu 'dra ba'i phyir dbyar du bshad do/ /de ltar na dgun dang dpyid dang / dbyar dag yin no zhes pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ dgun/ dpyid/ dbyar/ ston gyi dus dang bzhir phye nas de re re la yang ra ba/ 'bring po/ tha chung gsum gsum du byas pa ste/ mdo rtsar/ dbyar gnas/ dgag dbye/ sra brkyang gi skabs rnams su 'di'i tha snyad gsungs shing dge slong gi lo dri bar dgun gyi tshad ji tsam zhe na/ zla ba bzhi'o/ /bzhi po gang zhe na/ dgun zla ra ba dang / 'bring po dang / tha chung dang / dpyid ra ba dag go zhes dang / rgya cher 'grel las kyang / ston zla tha chung nya nas dgun zla 'bring po nya'i bar gyi zla ba gnyis ni zhes sogs dang /

de bzhin du bzhi 'grel las kyang 'di'i tha snyad gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa ni/ dgun/ dpyid/ dbyar/ dbyar thung ngu / dbyar ring po'i dus dang lngar phye ste/ dgun dang dpyid kyi dus la zla ba bzhi bzhi/ dbyar gyi dus zla ba gcig dbyar thung ngu'i dus nyin zhag gcig dbyar ring po'i dus zla ba gsum du nyin zhag gcig gis mchog pa ste/ 'di ni lung bzhi dang / karma shā tam dang / mdo rtsa'i dge slong gi dus brjod pa'i skabs rnams las gsungs so/ /bzhi pa ni/ dgun dang / dgun smad dang / dpyid dang / sos ka dang / dbyar dang / ston gyi dus drug tu phye nas de re re la yang zla ba gnyis gnyis su byas pa ste/ mdo rtsar nyin zhag gcig gis mi chog par bya'o/ /dus tshigs rnams kyi zla ba phyed lus pa nyid na'o zhes pa'i rgya cher 'grel las/ ston zla tha chung nya nas dgun zla 'bring po nya'i bar gyi zla ba gnyis ni dgun gyi dus tshigs so/ /dgun zla 'bring po'i nya nas dpyid zla ra ba nya'i bar gyi zla ba gnyis ni/ dgun smad kyi dus so/ /dpyid zla ra ba nya nas dpyid zla tha chung nya'i bar gyi zla ba gnyis ni dpyid kyi dus so/ /dpyid zla tha chung nya nas dbyar zla 'bring po'i nya'i bar gyi zla ba gnyis ni sos ka'i dus so/ /dbyar zla 'bring po'i nya nas ston zla ra ba'i nya'i bar gyi zla ba gnyis ni dbyar gyi dus so/ /ston zla ra ba nya nas ston zla tha chung nya'i bar gyi zla ba gnyis ni ston gyi dus so zhes gsungs pas so/ /gnyis pa ni/ de ltar dus tshigs du ma'i rnam gzhag la dgos pa ci yod snyam na/ dus tshigs gsum du phye ba'i dgos pa ni/ phyag dar khrod kyi gos ngos zin pa'i ched yin te/ phyag dar khrod la bor ba phyag dar khrod dang / dman pa phyag dar khrod gnyis las/ phyi ma ni gzhan gyis zla ba bzhir longs spyod pa la 'jog pa'i phyir te/ mdo rtsar dus tshigs su spyad pa la ni de gnyis 'gyur du'o zhes gsungs pas so/

/dus tshigs bzhir phye ba'i dgos pa ni/ 'jig rten pa dang tha snyad sgo bstun nas rtogs sla ba'i ched yin te/ 'jig rten na rab 'bring po sogs kyi tha snyad phyed pa'i phyir ro/ /lngar phye ba'i dgos pa ni dbyar thung ngu shi ba dang 'dra ba ngos zin pa'i ched yin la/ de yi dgos pa yang de las 'das na dbyar khas len pa mi chags zhes shes pa'i ched yin no/ /'di'i ngos 'dzin la/ phran 'grel las dbyar zla tha chung gi tshes bcu drug ni dbyar thung ngu yin no zhes dang / dge slong gi lo dri bar dbyar thung ngu'i dus nyin zhag gcig go /de gang zhe na ston zla ra ba tshes gcig gi nyin zhag go zhes ngos 'dzin gnyis byung ba'i dang po ni yar ngo sngon 'gro dang / phyi ma ni mar ngo sngon 'gro'i dbang du byas pa yin pas mi 'gal zhing gnad gcig tu 'byung ngo / /drug tu phye ba'i dgos pa ni/ gso sbyong bcu bzhi pa ngos zin pa'i ched yin te/ rtsa 'grel nyid na gsal lo/ /gsum pa la gsum ste/ zhag gi 'go gang nas 'dzin pa/ zla ba'i 'go gang nas 'dzin pa/ lo'i 'go gang nas 'dzin pa'o/ /dang po ni/ spyir zhag ni gsum ste/ tshes zhag dang / nyin zhag dang / khyim zhag go /dang po ni/ zla ba 'phel grib la sum cur byas pa'i cha gcig gam/ gza' bdun tshes la spyod pa'i yun no/ /gnyis pa ni/ nam langs pa nas sang nam langs kha'i bar ro/ /gsum pa ni/ lug glang 'khrig pa karka ṭa/ /seng ge bu mo srang sdig pa/ /gzhu dang chu srin bum pa nya/ /zhes pa'i khyim der nyi ma ji tsam gnas pa'i sum cu'i cha gcig go /lo re la de dag ji tsam 'byung na 'dir zla ba gnyis gnyis nas zhag mi thub dor ba'i rags rtsis kyi dbang du byas na tshes zhag sum brgya don gcig nyin zhag sum brgya dang re lnga/ khyim zhag sum brgya dang drug cu tham pa 'byung ste/ mdzod las/ zhag mi thub dang bcas pa yi/ /zla ba bcu gnyis la lo gcig /ces pa'i dbang du byas pa'o/
